embedded throughout the vehicle.

Combined with the attractive styling inside and out,
you have one very intriguing and capable sports sedan.
entries.zh:
第三代阿特兹的操控体验非常符合马自达的“人马一体”理念：
即车辆和驾驶者之间的和谐统一。

这款车型配备了一台2.2升涡轮增压直列四缸柴油引擎
和六速手动变速箱，

充足的扭矩让这台引擎的轰鸣声响彻云霄。

话说，您听说过马自达的创驰蓝天技术吗？

马自达的这套汽车工程技术贯穿了整辆车的每个部件，从车
身到引擎，再到底盘，无处不在。

可以毫不夸张的说，
第三代阿特兹就是集先进的创驰蓝天技术于大成的作品。

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo Gr.4 original race car is based on
the BMW M4.

At first glance, it might looks like an M Performance Edition,
but it has a few mods, like the spoilers and hood pin.

Its design is reminiscent of the safety cars used in today's
popular race series.
entries.zh:
这辆原创跑车浪漫旅组别4级别赛车以宝马M4为基础。

从外观上看，它更像是一辆装上了扰流板、引擎盖销和
其他调校件的M性能版。

其设计让人联想到如今在任何一场比赛中都能看到的安
全车。

entries.en:
The third-generation Focus ST's engine pumps out 250ps,
which is 25ps more than its predecessor.

This later version was produced after a minor change
to the model in 2015.

The suspension setting was revised, which improved
handling, most notably sharper turn-in response.

It also received a slight facelift, giving the car a leaner,
sportier overall appearance. q
entries.zh:
相比上一代，第三代福克斯ST的引擎将动力又推高了25ps，达
到了250ps。

这台车是2015年改款后的后期车型，

重新调校了悬挂的设置，操控性得到了改善，能够进行
更激烈的转向。

外观设计方面也得到了提升，使这台福克斯更轻薄，更具有
运动感。

entries.en:
The Peugeot VGT was the base model for this Gran
Turismo Gr.3 original race car.

To meet Gr.3 specs, the engine and chassis were
heavily modified.

On the outside, you'll notice that a rear wing and front
splitter were added to improve the car's aerodynamics.
entries.zh:
标致VGT是这款原创跑车浪漫旅组别3级别赛车的基础车型。

为了满足组别3规范，引擎、底盘以及其他部件都接受了大
量改装。

此外，车身上还增加了吸睛的天鹅颈尾翼和前定风翼，
以改善车辆的空气动力学特性。

entries.en:
The base model for this Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.4 race car
was none other than the Toyota 86.

With 346ps on tap and remarkable handling, this machine
had the power and grace of a GT3 racer.
entries.zh:
这款原创跑车浪漫旅组别4级别赛车的基础改装车型是
一台丰田86。

凭借346ps的动力和可圈可点的操控性，这辆车有能力在任
何弯道击败竞争对手。

entries.en:
This Vision Gran Turismo Gr.3 was based on the
GTI Roadster.

The front splitter and rear wing were designed to work
together to dramatically increase downforce.

This version is a rear-wheel driver, changed from
the base car's 4WD system.
entries.zh:
这款原创的跑车浪漫旅愿景组别3级别车型是以
GTI Roadster为基础开发的。

前定风翼和尾翼协同工作，极大地增加了车辆的下压力。

这款车将布局换成了中置后驱，而不是基础车型的四驱
布局。

entries.en:
Serving as the foundation for the Gran Turismo Gr.3 race car
was the Peugeot RCZ.

While the original came with an FF layout, we changed it to an
MR layout to suit Gr.3 specifications.

This was easily done, thanks to the base RCZ's long wheelbase,
which provides exceptional lateral stability.

We must say that the car's overall balance has been greatly
improved with the new engine location. %
entries.zh:
标致RCZ是这辆跑车浪漫旅组别3级别赛车的基础改装车型。

原车是前置前驱布局，赛车版本却改为使用中置后驱布
局，以满足组别3的规范。

基础的RCZ轴距较长，拥有较高的稳定性，

再通过将引擎中置，在性能提升方面获得最大的优势。

entries.en:
The prized qualities of Mitsubishi's famed AWD sports sedan
are on display in the Lancer Evolution's Final Edition.

At the heart of every Evo is the engine.

The one in this car produces 313ps and 43.7kgm of torque,
making it the most powerful Evo engine ever.

Not only are the suspension and brakes also impressive...

...the technically-advanced AWD system makes this a monster
on all types of terrain.
entries.zh:
这款蓝瑟翼豪陆神终极版完全彰显了
三菱赫赫有名的四驱轿跑车那屡获殊荣的冠军车品质。

它拥有一台无与伦比的引擎，

可以输出313ps的动力和43.7kgm的扭矩，是目前性能最强的翼豪陆神引擎。

它的悬挂系统和刹车也同样进行了增强。

毫无疑问，这就是翼豪陆神长达二十三年历史中的巅峰之作。

entries.en:
The Nissan Concept 2020 VGT was the culmination of
Nissan's storied involvement with motorsports.

Nissan Design Europe, based in London, England,
did most of the design work here...

...while all the technical stuff was undertaken by the
company's engineers based in Japan.

What made this car unique was its "performance hybrid FR-4WD"
layout that consisted of a twin-turbocharged V-6...

...combined with three electric motors, where the front
left and right motors worked independently.

Therefore, this car was, as its name suggested, an AWD vehicle.

With torque being distributed independently to each wheel, the
Nissan Concept 2020 VGT possessed remarkable handling.
entries.zh:
日产在制造GT和赛车方面拥有历史悠久的传统，而这款
日产Concept 2020 VGT 就是他们的集大成之作。

总部设立于伦敦的日产设计欧洲团队负责开发整车的外观
设计和风格……

而日本的日产工程团队则负责所有的技术细节。

这款车采用了独特的“性能混动前置后驱-四驱”布局……

并安装了一台V6双涡轮增压引擎，与三部电机搭配工作，

而且位于前部左右的两台电机可以独立工作。

这些革新让这辆车拥有了出神入化的操控性，即便在极
高速的情况下也体验非凡。\

entries.en:
The Audi R8 LMS was developed in accordance with
FIA GT3 regulations.

This second-generation model made its debut in 2015.

Shortly after its release, it ran in the Nürburgring
24 Hours, where it surprisingly won the race.

The downforce generated by its body, which provided stability
at high speed, was arguably its greatest strength.
entries.zh:
奥迪R8 LMS是按照国际汽联GT3规格所开发的。

这款第二代车型于2015年初次亮相，

不久之后就参加了纽博格林24小时耐力赛，并出人意料
地赢得了冠军。

强大的下压力毫无疑问是它的最大优势，为高速赛道的
行驶提供可靠的操控性能。:

entries.en:
The Toyota FT-1 VGT served as the base model for this
original Gran Turismo Gr.3 race car.

Its custom design included a large wing and
front splitter.

Under the hood was a cutting-edge technology engine,
making this machine a truly awesome Gr.3 racer.
entries.zh:
丰田FT-1 VGT是这款原创的跑车浪漫旅组别3级别赛车的基础
车型。

定制设计中包括了一套大尾翼和两侧的前定风翼。

在其引擎盖下，搭载了多项世界领先的科技，确保能够
打造出一辆具有竞争力的组别3赛车。

entries.en:
This FR sports car carried on the tradition of the
venerable AE86 of the 1980s.

The naturally-aspirated horizontally-opposed 4-cylinder engine
was developed in collaboration with Subaru.

With the engine in the middle, and a low center of gravity,
its cornering is very solid indeed.

In 2015, the body was stiffened to further improve its cornering.
entries.zh:
这辆典型的前置后驱跑车是在80年代声名鹊起的AE86的后
继者。

它的水平对置四缸自然进气发动机是与斯巴鲁联合开发的。

这部车的引擎置于车身中部，有效降低了车身重心，以此获
得可靠的过弯性能。

在2015款车型上，车身刚性也进行了强化。

entries.en:
The Subaru BRZ is a sports car introduced in 2012.

It comes equipped with a naturally-aspirated 2.0-liter
boxer engine that sends power to the rear wheels.

The handling balance of this car is superb, thanks in part
to the "flat" engine that lowers the center of gravity.

The BRZ was developed in collaboration with Toyota.
The Toyota version of this car is named the 86.
entries.zh:
这款斯巴鲁BRZ是一辆2012年推出的前置后驱跑车。

它采用了一台2升自然进气水平对置引擎，安装在专为支
持前置后驱布局特别定制的底盘上。

水平对置引擎可以降低车身重心，给予这款车极大的操
控优势。

这款BRZ由斯巴鲁和丰田联合打造，与丰田86是姊妹车款。

entries.en:
The Vulcan was developed with the goal of creating a true
race car for the street.

It boasts a full carbon-fiber body much like high-end
race cars you see on the track.

The front-mounted naturally-aspirated 7.0-liter V-12 produced
an astounding 811ps, which also was on par with a race car.

The use of a transaxle provided optimal weight distribution,
which resulted in excellent handling balance.
entries.zh:
Vulcan的设计思路旨在打破公路车和赛车之间的界线。

它采用了符合最高品质赛车标准的全碳纤维车身。

前置的自然进气7升V12引擎可以输出惊人的811ps！

后部的跨轴变速箱刚好平衡了引擎的重量，确保了最优
配重比。

entries.en:
Like the original, the second-generation R8, introduced in
2016, was practically built for the track.

After all, the R8 was developed by the same department
in charge of Audi's customer race cars.

Where the 2nd-gen model shined was its weight, or lack thereof.
It’s much lighter than the original model.

The base version came equipped with a 5.2-liter V-10 FSI engine.

But this V-10-plus model received special tuning, resulting in
a lot more power under the hood.(
entries.zh:
与第一代车型一样，2016年上市的第二代R8
也是专门为了赛道而打造。

毕竟R8一直是由奥迪负责客制赛车的部门所开发。

第二代R8真正的亮点是它的车重，
相比一代减重不少。

其基础版本配备了一台5.2升V10燃油分层喷射引擎……

不过这款V10 Plus版本经过特别调校，
拥有更澎湃的动力。

entries.en:
The BMW M4 served as the base model for this
Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.4 race car.

While the M4 was already a great handling car to begin with,
we made it even better by tuning the suspension system.

That said, we retained the predictability of the original car,
which makes it an enjoyable ride for drivers of all levels.
entries.zh:
宝马M4是这辆跑车浪漫旅组别4级别原创赛车的基础车型。

和大部分宝马一样，它非常擅长过弯，原本就非常出色的
稳定性更是得到了进一步提升。

无论驾驶水平高低，所有车手都会觉得这款前置后驱赛
车易于上手。

entries.en:
This race car used the BMW M6 as a base.

It was raced by Walkenhorst Motorsport.

Gran Turismo series producer Kazunori Yamauchi personally
tested the car out at the Nürburgring.

The long wheelbase of the M6 base model was retained to
preserve its exceptional aerodynamics.

That's why the car was as stable as a rock at high speeds.

Under its hood was a custom-tuned turbocharged 4.4-liter V-8.[
entries.zh:
这辆赛车以宝马M6作为改装的基础车型……

并由Walkenhorst Motorsport车队驾驶参赛。

跑车浪漫旅系列的制作人山内一典曾有幸亲自驾驶
它在纽博格林赛道上试车。

这辆车保留了原有车型的大尺寸车身和长轴距……

因而具有极高的稳定性和空气动力学性能。

一台定制调校过的4.4升V8涡轮增压引擎是它的强大核心。6

entries.en:
The Bugatti Veyron served as the foundation for this
Gran Turismo Gr.4 original race car.

Although the engine was detuned to meet Gr.4 regulations,
this 4WD vehicle went plenty fast in a straight line.
entries.zh:
布加迪Veryron是这辆原创跑车浪漫旅组别4
级别赛车的基础车型。

尽管为了符合组别4规范，我们不得不削弱它的动力，但这
辆四轮驱动机器依然可以跑出惊人的顶级车速。

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo Gr.4 original was based on the GT by
Citroën.

It was modified to meet Gr.4 standards by its designer,
Takumi Yamamoto.

The steering wheel and instrumentation really give it the
feel of a true race car.
entries.zh:
这款原创跑车浪漫旅组别4级别赛车基于雪铁龙GT开发。

由设计师山本卓一出手，按照组别4规范对其进行了改造。

其方向盘和显示仪表盘充满了赛车美学。8

entries.en:
The GT by Citroën served as the foundation for this original
Gran Turismo Gr.3 racer.

Takumi Yamamoto, the GT's designer, modified the exterior
so that it adhered to Gr.3 specifications.

The wide fenders with multiple air ducts was one of the
more notable additions.
entries.zh:
雪铁龙GT是这款原创跑车浪漫旅组别3级别赛车的基础车型。

GT的设计师山本卓一对原车的外形进行了调整，使其符
合组别3的规范。

其中最显著的改动是加宽、外扩的挡泥板和多条风道。

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo Gr.4 original was built with the
Corvette C7 as its foundation.

The car behaved like a true FR machine, with awesome
acceleration and great cornering prowess.
entries.zh:
这辆原创跑车浪漫旅组别4级别赛车使用科尔维特C7作为基础
车型开发而来。

其在直道上的加速性能非常扎实，操作性也相当优异，
使其成为一辆非常易于驾驶的前置后驱赛车。

entries.en:
The Corvette C7 served as the base for this
Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.3 race car.

In typical Corvette fashion, this thing was both fast in
a straight line and reliable on corners.

The large fog lamps and custom rear wing were just a few of
the modifications required for endurance racing.<
entries.zh:
科尔维特C7是这款原创跑车浪漫旅组别3级别赛车的基础车型。

它可以在直道上保持惊人的极速，同时兼具可靠的弯道
操控性能，

另外还为耐力赛进行了若干项针对性改装，例如大尺寸
雾灯和定制尾翼等。

entries.en:
The powertrain of this second-generation NSX was what Honda
called a sports hybrid SH-AWD system.

At its heart was a turbocharged 3.5-liter V-6 that was combined
with three electric motors to drive all four wheels.

Two of the motors managed the torque of the
front wheels independently.

This allowed for sharper cornering, with enhanced
steering response and feel.
entries.zh:
这辆第二代NSX的传动系统采用了跑车型混动超级控制全
轮驱动系统。

它通过一台中置3.5升涡轮增压V6引擎搭配三台额外的电机
来驱动全部四个车轮。

其中两台电机负责支持前轮独立运作，

车手可以在过弯时进行微调，而无需牺牲速度。

entries.en:
The Type R signaled a turning point in the Civic's history...

...especially this fourth-generation model that was
the first to get a turbocharged engine.

This 4-cylinder produced more than 300ps and 40kgm of torque,
putting the car on par with high-end sports cars.

This Civic was so fast that it set a new course record on
the Nürburgring Nordschleife for FF production cars.
entries.zh:
Type R的引入是思域历史上的重大转折点。

这辆第四代型号更是首次用上了涡轮增压引擎，

可以输出超过300ps的动力和超过40kgm的扭矩。

这款车在发售后刷新了纽博格林北侧赛道的量产前置前
驱车圈速记录。

entries.en:
The Honda S660 was a mid-engine sports car that was
classified as a "kei car" in Japan.

Its compact nature and low price made it one of the most
affordable MR sports cars in the world.

Thanks to its mid-engine layout, the S660 boasted a
front/rear weight distribution ratio of 45/55.

Its suspension system was also tuned to
provide a MR sporty feel.

Despite its diminutive size, I would challenge you to find
a more fun to car to drive than this one.
entries.zh:
本田S660是一辆中置引擎的跑车，其设计完全符合日式“轻
型车”的规范。

这款车的设计思路是打造一辆更易于驾驶的跑车。

其中置引擎布局使得前后重量分布比例达到了优秀的45/55。

其侧倾中心和重心也进行了调优……

让这辆车的驾驶体验非常顺滑、稳定，操控性也数一数二。

entries.en:
The second-generation NSX served as the base for this
Gran Turismo Gr.4 original racer.

The replacement of the rear bulkhead dramatically improved
the rigidity of the frame...

...making it more stable through corners. Also, it was converted
to rear-wheel drive to meet Gr.4 regulations.
entries.zh:
第二代NSX是这辆原创跑车浪漫旅组别4级别赛车的基础
车型。

它的后隔板进行了整体更换，以大幅增加车身框架的刚性……

另外为了符合组别4规则，改成了使用后轮驱动。0

entries.en:
This original Gran Turismo Gr.3 vehicle was created using
the second-generation NSX as the foundation.

A number of custom components were added to improve the car's
aerodynamic profile.

The large front splitter and rear wing are two of the
more noticeable additions.

The car was converted from all-wheel drive to rear-wheel drive
to adhere to Gr.3 regulations.
entries.zh:
这款原创跑车浪漫旅组别3级别赛车使用第二代NSX作为
基础车型。

并加入了若干项新部件，比如大尺寸的前定风翼和天鹅颈
尾翼。

这些定制化组件可以有效提升车辆的空气动力学性能，
为其赋予了极大的优势。

为了符合组别3规范，基础车型的四驱系统也被更改成一套
后驱系统。

entries.en:
The original Gran Turismo Gr.4 race car was based on
the Jaguar F-Type.

We made sure we kept the car's straight-line speed.

This is one of the prettiest cars you'll ever see. The company
did a great job on the design, wouldn't you agree?
entries.zh:
这辆原创跑车浪漫旅组别4级别赛车的基础车型是
捷豹F-type，

并且不折不扣地保留了F-type那惊人的直道速度！

灰色雾面漆和未经装饰的格栅带来极具侵略性的外形，
让它在所有竞争对手中鹤立鸡群。

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo original Gr.3 car was based on the
Jaguar F-Type.

What was already a striking design was made even more so by
the addition of wide fenders and other distinct tweaks.

A rear wing has been added to improve the car's aerodynamics,
which were pretty good to begin with, I might add.
entries.zh:
这辆原创跑车浪漫旅组别3级别赛车采用捷豹F-type作为
基础车型。

大量的改装，如安装宽大的挡泥板和其他特殊组件等，
依然无法掩盖捷豹的设计亮点。

这辆车还添加了大尺寸的天鹅颈尾翼，进一步提升了车
辆本就非常出色的空气动力学性能。

entries.en:
The Huracán served as the foundation for this
Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.4 race car.

The car cornered so well that not much was done in terms of
modifications. It still has that mid-engine AWD feel. Z
entries.zh:
Huracán是这辆原创跑车浪漫旅组别4级别赛车的改装原型。

作为一款中置引擎车，它的过弯性能非常出色，四驱系
统则确保了平顺丝滑的驾驶感。

entries.en:
The FIA Group GT3 series is one of the most popular forms
of racing around the world.

And usually in the spotlight these days is the Huracán GT3,
simply because its fast and really nice to look at.

Development of the car was undertaken by Lamborghini's
motorsports department called Squadra Corse.

Under the car's hood is a 5.2-liter V-10 engine specifically
tuned for the race track.

A 6-speed sequential gearbox transfers power
to the rear wheels. 8
entries.zh:
国际汽联GT3组别是在全世界范围内最受欢迎的赛车组别之一……

这辆Huracán GT3就是此组别内最深受车迷喜爱的一款车。

它的开发由兰博基尼的汽车运动部门Squadra Corse所负责。

这辆车安装了一台5.2升V10引擎，针对赛事要求进行了特别
优化，并采用了传统的后轮驱动布局，

此外还搭载了一套六速序列式变速箱。-

entries.en:
The foundation for this Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.4
race car was the Lexus RC F.

A few tweaks made this thing faster on the straights.

Not hard to do when you start with a powerful
V-8 that produces gobs of torque.

If you want to stand out in a crowd, like we do, we suggest
you go with the special orange paint job.
entries.zh:
这辆原创跑车浪漫旅组别4级别赛车采用雷克萨斯RC F作为
基础车型而开发……

它更适合在直道上飞速驰骋，

因为它的V8引擎可以输出强大的扭矩，提供犀利的瞬间
加速性能。

这辆标志性的雷克萨斯特殊车型还提供了炫酷的橙色版本。

entries.en:
The Lexus RC F GT3 is a race car specifically developed
to wage war in the popular FIA GT3 series.

While the car was expected to be competitive, it was still behind
the others in development...or so people thought.

This race car made a name for itself in Race 9 of the 2016
Nürburgring Endurance Series, surprising everyone.

Despite competing as a prototype, it finished first
in its class.

The victory was also the first of its kind for a Japanese
automobile in the series.

Needless to say, this model has become a major piece
in the history of Toyota racing.
entries.zh:
这辆雷克萨斯RC F GT3是一辆专为满足国际汽联GT3规则所开发的原型车。

它因为在某场比赛中的优异表现而一夜成名。

具体是哪场比赛呢？那当然就是2016年纽博格林24小时耐
力赛的第九场！

尽管是作为一款原型车参赛，却在所属组别中登上了冠
军的宝座。

这也是日本同类型车辆在纽博格林耐力赛中摘得的第一
个冠军。

无需我多言，它早已在历史上留下了光辉灿烂的一笔。

entries.en:
The third-generation Atenza served as the base for this
original Gran Turismo Gr.4 race car.

Like the production model, it comes with 4-wheel drive,
which gives the car excellent grip.

A hood scoop is attached to improve heat dissipation. Look
closely and you'll see plenty more tweaks to the body.
entries.zh:
第三代阿特兹就是这款原创跑车浪漫旅组别4级别赛车的基
础车型。

和量产版一样，这辆车也采用了四轮驱动布局，提供优
秀的牵引力。

车身前端加入了引擎盖进气口以优化散热性能，并安装
有多种不同的空气动力学部件。

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.3 used the
third-generation Atenza as a base.

It was converted to a rear-wheel-driver to meet
Gr.3 specifications.

A rear cockpit bulkhead was installed to improve the
overall rigidity of the body.
entries.zh:
这辆原创跑车浪漫旅组别3级别赛车采用了第三代阿特兹作
为其基础车型……

另外为了符合组别3规范，它还被改装成了前置后驱布局。

此外，驾驶舱后部增加了一块隔板，以提升车身的整体
刚性。

entries.en:
The 650S Coupe was the successor to the McLaren MP4-12C.

Mounted amidships in the lightweight carbon-fiber chassis
was a twin-turbocharged 3.8-liter V-8...

...that cranked out a massive 650ps, which is
reflected in the car's name.

McLaren's patented active suspension was refined even
further to provide neck-wrenching handling.
entries.zh:
这辆650S Coupe是迈凯伦MP4-12C的后继车型。

3.8升V8双涡轮增压引擎安装在一套轻量化碳纤维底盘的
中部……

可以输出最大650ps的动力，因此被命名为650。

迈凯伦还针对这一型号专门调校了其专利的主动式悬挂系统
的设置。

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo Gr.4 original race car is based on the
McLaren 650S.

Not only is it an extremely capable handling machine, it's also
as smooth as silk on the straights.

The fuel lid, jack points, and numerous other aspects are
inherited from the 650S GT3.
entries.zh:
这辆原创跑车浪漫旅组别4级别赛车基于迈凯伦650S开发。

它不仅响应灵敏、易于操控，直道加速也极其顺畅和稳定。

包括油箱盖、连接点在内的许多零部件都直接沿用了
650S GT3的零部件。

entries.en:
This racing version of the 650S was developed in accordance
with FIA GT3 specifications.

It burst onto the motorsports scene after winning the 2016
Bathurst 12 Hour race in Australia.

The car is technically better than its predecessor,
the MP4-12C, in nearly every way.

The front canards and large rear wing were some of the more
notable additions that enhanced the car's aerodynamics.
entries.zh:
这个赛车版本基于650S开发，符合国际汽联GT3的规范。

在2016年赢得了澳大利亚巴瑟斯特12小时耐力赛后，这辆
车收获了业界的广泛赞誉。

相较于MP4-12C时代，这辆车有了大幅的改进，例如扩宽了前
轮轮距。

此外，车身的空气动力学性能也有所提升，增加了前翼
和大尺寸尾翼等套件。

entries.en:
The AMG GT3 is an FIA GT3 class race car that succeeded
the SLS GT3.

First unveiled at the 2015 Geneva Motor Show...

...the car came equipped with a powerful AMG-tuned
naturally-aspirated 6.3-liter V-8.

In competition since 2016, it's still active in GT races around
the world, which serves as a testament to its longevity.
entries.zh:
这辆AMG GT3是一辆用于参与国际汽联GT3组别的赛车，也是SLS GT3的
后继车型。

它于2015的日内瓦车展上首次亮相……

这辆车搭载了梅赛德斯AMG自然进气6.3升V8引擎，这是一台性能与
其他赛车引擎不分伯仲的发动机。

它从2016年开始参加比赛，目前仍活跃于世界各地的超跑比赛中。

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo Gr.4 original vehicle is based on the
SLS AMG.

As you would expect from a race machine with AMG roots,
this thing is a beast on the race track.
entries.zh:
这辆原创跑车浪漫旅组别4级别赛车基于SLS AMG开发。

拥有扎实的弯道操控和超高的直道极速，是一辆各方面
性能都非常均衡的赛车。

entries.en:
The Lancer Evolution Final Edition served as the foundation
for this Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.4 race car.

The Lancer's electronically-controlled 4WD system is retained,
so expect amazing handling on all types of driving surfaces.@
entries.zh:
蓝瑟翼豪陆神终极版是这款原创跑车浪漫旅
组别4级别赛车的基础车型。

它保留了蓝瑟独有的电子控制四驱系统，其灵敏而犀利的
过弯性能令人叹为观止。

entries.en:
For this original Gran Turismo Gr.3 vehicle, the Lancer
Evolution Final Edition served as the base.

A few tweaks to the body significantly improved
the car's aerodynamics.

Also, for this version, the race car was converted to
rear-wheel drive to conform to regulations./
entries.zh:
这辆原创的跑车浪漫旅组别3赛车采用
蓝瑟翼豪陆神终极版作为基础车型。

车身的前挡泥板处嵌入了多块翼片，用于提高空气动力
学性能。

在这个赛车版本中，蓝瑟的四驱系统被改为更传统的前置
后驱布局。

entries.en:
The Peugeot RCZ was the foundation for this
Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.4 race car.

The front fenders are one of a number of custom parts that
were intended to improve aerodynamics.

Despite being front-wheel drive, it handled surprisingly well.
entries.zh:
这辆原创的跑车浪漫旅组别4级别赛车采用
标致RCZ作为基础车型。

车身安装了大量空气动力学定制部件，前挡泥板就是其
中之一。

这辆前置前驱车拥有引以为傲的顺滑操控。

entries.en:
This race version of the Renault Sport R.S.01 was tuned to
conform to FIA GT3 regulations.

Because the production car was developed for track use, it
didn't take much to make this car a potent GT3 machine.

After beginning life in a one-make series, the Sport R.S.01
now competes in GT races all over the world.
entries.zh:
这款车基于雷诺Sport R.S.01改装，完全符合国际汽联GT3规范。

由于其量产型号本就是一款赛车，改装版本更是青出于蓝。

它在各方面的表现都优于参加单一车种赛事的原型，现
在已经开始参与全球范围的各项GT赛事。

entries.en:
The Dodge Viper served as the base for this original
Gran Turismo Gr.4 race car.

Modifications include the addition of a front splitter,
canards, and a large rear wing.

The substantial increase in downforce means that the car
is super stable at high speed. E
entries.zh:
这辆原创的跑车浪漫旅组别4赛车使用
第三代道奇Viper作为基础车型打造。

车身改装包括前定风翼、前翼，以及大尺寸尾翼。

这些改动大幅增加了下压力，确保这辆车可以轻松过弯。

entries.en:
The Viper SRT GTS-R served as the starting point for this
FIA GT3 class vehicle.

The car is the product of a collaboration between two of the
leading experts at the top of their respective fields:

Chrysler's high-performance automobile division, SRT, and Riley
Technologies. Together they created a real track monster.

They reduced the car's weight to a mere 1200kg and enhanced
aerodynamics to provide more downforce.

It's a formula that'll always produce results, and this Viper
did not disappoint, running at the top in numerous GT races.
entries.zh:
Viper SRT GTS-R是这辆国际汽联GT3组别赛车的基础车型。

这台车由两个各自领域内顶尖的专家团队：

克莱斯勒的高性能汽车部门SRT
以及Riley Technologies携手打造。

总体车重被控制在1200kg以下，空气动力学性能也得到了进
一步加强。

这些改装取得了极大的成功，这辆车在GT赛事中的优异
表现就足以证明！

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo Gr.4 original was based on the WRX STI.

The car's AWD system enables the car to corner with the best
of them and keep it connected to the road in all conditions.

The custom front splitter and rear wing provide extra downforce
to enhance stability at higher speeds.
entries.zh:
这台原创跑车浪漫旅组别4级别赛车基于WRX STI打造。

四轮驱动系统可以提供强大的牵引力，在过弯时实现稳
定的操控。

定制的前定风翼和尾翼进一步增加了车辆的下压力。0

entries.en:
The foundation for this Gran Turismo Gr.4 original race car
was the Volkswagen Scirocco.

The small front splitter and rear wing, although modest,
make a huge positive impact on the car's aerodynamics.

Its compact size makes it extremely nimble, and despite being
a front-wheel-drive car, it can handle with the best of them.
entries.zh:
打造这辆原创跑车浪漫旅组别4级别赛车时使用的基础
车型是一台大众尚酷。

小尺寸的前定风翼和尾翼表明这款车在外形改装方面采
用了较为温和的做法。

无论是前置前驱布局的优秀稳定性，还是尚酷那指向明确
的过弯性能都在这台车上得到了保留。

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.1 race car was based on
the Dodge SRT Tomahawk VGT.

The compressed air system was removed so it conformed to
Gr.1 racing regulations.

Also, a fixed wing and shark fin were added to enhance
the car's aerodynamics.

But the biggest change of all was converting the once-all-wheel
drive car layout to rear-wheel drive.
entries.zh:
这是一辆基于道奇SRT Tomahawk VGT所打造的组别1赛车。

为了符合组别1赛事规范，它的空气压缩系统被移除。

另外还加上了固定式尾翼和鲨鱼鳍，以增加空气阻力。

最后，它的传动系统也从四轮驱动更换为后轮驱动。

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.3 race car was based on
the Subaru WRX STI.

The chassis was tweaked to lower the front end, making it
more aerodynamic.

The underbody was also modified to increase downforce,
which ensures high-speed stability.

Also, the original AWD drivetrain was converted
to rear-wheel drive.|
entries.zh:
这是一辆基于WRX STI改装而来的组别3赛车，专为跑车浪漫
旅所打造。

其车身高度进行了削减，进而缩小了前剖面面积，成为
了一款底盘极低的轿车。

车身底板方面的空气动力学优化则带来比双门车身更
强的下压力。

传动系统也被更换为前置后驱。

entries.en:
Audi was the first auto manufacturer to race a hybrid
at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

The cutting-edge technology of that revolutionary machine
was implemented on the Audi Vision Gran Turismo.

A rear-mounted turbocharged 3.4-liter V-6 teams with electric
motors that power the front wheels.

Combined, the total output is rated at an astounding 1295ps.

With that much power on tap, it'll not just keep up with LMP1
race cars, it might just leave them in the dust. m
entries.zh:
奥迪是第一家使用混动车型参加勒芒比赛的制造商。

他们为此赛事专门开发的技术在奥迪Vision Gran Turismo身上得到了充分的彰显。

它的后置3.4升V6涡轮增压引擎可以与电机完美配合，为前
轮提供驱动力。

引擎和电机总共可以输出让人望而生畏的1295ps动力。

这套组合的实力足可以与任何LMP1赛车匹敌。

entries.en:
The Roadster Shop is a hot-rod shop based in Illinois, U.S.A.

It's particularly famous for its
custom chassis offerings.

This Rampage is one of its main showpieces. It won
the Gran Turismo Award at the 2014 SEMA Show.

It's based on a 1970 Chevrolet Camaro SS.

In addition to a reworked frame, its body is equipped
with a roll cage for extra reinforcement.

Also, its engine is more centrally located, which means that
the car's handling balance is superb!
entries.zh:
跑车工坊是一家位于美国伊利诺伊州的改装车店，

尤其以定制底盘产品而闻名。

这台Rampage是他们的杰作，
也是2014年美国改装车协会展会上跑车浪漫旅大奖的得主！

它以1970年的雪佛兰科迈罗SS为基础。

除了重新制作的车身框架，
还增加了防滚架，以进行额外刚度加固……

而且它的引擎更靠近中间位置
——依我看，这是一个匠心独具的设计！

entries.zh: Buddy_ContentCar_BrandCentralOwner_normal_db3s_53_1020284

entries.en:
The sixth-generation Chevy Camaro SS is a high-end machine
with a 6.2-liter naturally-aspirated V-8 powerplant.

It pumps out 450ps and more than 60kgm of torque. It also
has custom suspension, 20-inch wheels and Brembo brakes.

This all means that the Camaro SS can really hustle around a race
track and leave more expensive sports cars in the dust.
entries.zh:
第六代雪佛兰科迈罗SS安装有一台6.2升自然进气V8引擎，是一台货
真价实的高性能机器。

它的动力输出最高可超过450ps，而且其前置后驱传动系统
也可以输出高达60kgm的扭矩。

仿佛是对这样的豪华配置还不满足，它甚至还配备了定
制的悬挂系统、20英寸轮胎和布雷博刹车。

entries.en:
Have you heard of the "LF-LC?" You might not have, because
it was a concept vehicle produced by Lexus in 2012.

That said, it probably looks familiar because it served as the
design-study model for the LS 500 luxury sports coupe.

Under its long hood is a 5.0-liter V-8, which also sees duty
in the Lexus RC F.

Because it's naturally aspirated, this engine delivers tons of
low-end torque and revs evenly through the RPM spectrum.
entries.zh:
您听说过“LF-LC”吗？这台绝美的概念赛车由雷克萨斯在2012年公布。

LC500在设计时也将之作为了参照。

它安装有一台5升自然进气V8引擎，和RC F跑车型号采用
的是同款。

这辆车在低转速时扭矩非常充足，达到高转速区间后也
没有牺牲任何性能。

entries.en:
The Renault Sport R.S. 01 was a powerful mid-engine race car
that was created to compete in a one-make race series.

It was developed with Nissan, so it should come as no surprise
that the twin-turbo V-6 in the car came from a Nissan GT-R.

Thanks to the folks at NISMO, the engine produced 550ps.

The Renault weighed only 1100kg, so be careful when stepping
on the throttle if you happen to drive one.
entries.zh:
这款雷诺Sport R.S. 01是一辆性能强大的中置引擎赛车，专门
设计用于参加单一车种赛事。

这款与日产合作开发的车型采用日产GT-R同款的双涡轮增压V6
引擎，

并接受了NISMO的精准调校，可以输出550ps。

而它的车重仅仅只有1100kg。从气质到血统，它都无可挑剔。

entries.en:
Called "SV" by Lambo aficionados, the LP750-4 SuperVeloce
represented a special version of the Aventador.

The first car to wear the "SV" badge was
the legendary Miura P400 SV.

Therefore, only the truly special cars receive
this designation.

The Aventador SV's engine pumps out 750ps,
which is 50ps more than the base model.

Lamborghini also enhanced the car's suspension,
brakes and chassis, making this thing one angry charging bull.
entries.zh:
这辆LP750-4 SuperVeloce通常被简称为“SV”，是一款非常特殊的
Aventador。

“SV”这个名号最初被用在经典的Miura P400 SV上。

兰博基尼可不会轻易将这个名字赐给一款车。

这款Aventador SV可以输出750ps，比基础车型提高了50ps。

各方面性能均有大幅改善，包括对刹车、底盘和悬挂的关
键性升级。

entries.en:
If you ask me who the preeminent tuner of Porsche cars is,
I will answer without pause that it's Ruf.

The German firm specializes in taking the cars of Stuttgart
and giving them more performance and exclusivity.

Among the company's more notable creations was the CTR3,
which started life as a Cayman.

Although it may still look a bit like the Cayman, the CTR3
was a different animal altogether.

Mounted amidships was a twin-turbocharged 3.8-liter flat-6...

...that allowed the car reach an incredible top speed of
<380km/h>. That's hyper car territory.
entries.zh:
如虎是一家在保时捷车主心目中地位极高的车厂，而且他们的
确配得上这份殊荣。

通过对保时捷基础车型进行趋近完美的改装，他们为自己赢
得了无上的赞誉。

在他们所有的作品中，这辆CTR3堪称最伟大的成就。

这款车基于专用独立平台研发打造，采用中置引擎布局，

其配备的3.8升双涡轮增压水平对置六缸引擎

拥有高达<380km/h>的最高时速，是一辆纯正的超级跑车。

entries.en:
This car was driven by Dai Yoshihara, the first Japanese
driver to win the Formula Drift championship.

It was his 2017 competition car, equipped with a turbocharged
7.0-liter V-8 engine that produced 1000ps.

The transmission, drivetrain and suspension were all tuned
for sliding the car sideways.

If you're looking to hone your drifting skills, why not
practice in Mr. Yoshihara's custom drift machine?
entries.zh:
吉原大二郎是第一名征服了美国漂移界的日本车手，而
这就是他在2017赛季驾驶的战车。

它搭载的7升V8涡轮增压引擎可以输出1000ps的动力。

其变速箱、传动系统和悬挂均针对漂移比赛进行了特殊
改装。

如果想要磨练您的漂移技术，何不试试吉原君驾驶过的
这部无敌机器呢？`

entries.en:
The RS is the top-of-the-line Focus and is
particularly popular with rally fans.

Previous RS models were front-wheel drive...

But this fourth iteration, which appeared in 2018, had
AWD for the first time in the model's history.

The torque distribution was adjustable from full FWD
to full RWD and everything in between.

This allows you to even drift the car if you wanted to. [
entries.zh:
这款RS傲立于整个福克斯产品线的巅峰，在拉力赛爱好者中
尤其受欢迎。

之前的RS型号都是前置前驱布局设计……

而这款于2018年亮相的第四代型号却破天荒地采用了四轮
驱动配置，

其扭矩分配可以进行从100%前轮到100%后轮的全面调整。

这项功能使其可以满足任何条件下的驾驶，甚至连漂移
也不例外。

entries.en:
This third-generation Ford GT continued the legacy
of the legendary GT40 race car.

It came equipped with a twin-turbocharged 3.6-liter V-6
that produced 656ps and 76kgm of torque.

These crazy numbers made it the most powerful road-going car
that Ford ever produced.

And in case you were wondering, this thing made for one
awesome race car.

It won its class at Le Mans in 2016, which was exactly 50 years
after the GT40 won its first Le Mans race.
entries.zh:
这辆第三代福特GT继承了传奇车款GT40在许多年之前开创的
优良传统。

它搭载有一台3.6升V6双涡轮增压引擎，可以输出656ps的动力，
最大扭矩为76kgm。

这些超乎想象的参数也让它成为了福特的量产公路车中动
力最强劲的型号。

其赛车版本更是早在2016年就在勒芒捧起了所属组别的冠
军奖杯，赢得了无尽的赞扬。

而在50年前，同样是一辆GT赢得了同一项赛事。这绝对
是不可小觑的伟大成就。

entries.en:
This is a modern-day take on the Shelby GT350, a legendary
performance car created by Carroll Shelby.

It's based on the sixth-generation Mustang.

To handle the naturally-aspirated 500ps V-8, the Mustang
chassis was strengthened to handle the extra power.

The power and performance of the car made it a monster on the
track, which of course, would gain Mr. Shelby's approval. S
entries.zh:
Shelby GT350是由卡罗尔·谢尔比一手打造的高性能跑车，而这一辆
则是它的现代版本。

它的开发基于第六代Mustang，

采用特别强化过的底盘，并搭载一台500ps的自然进气
V8引擎……

它专注于赛事的配置与设计足以让谢尔比本人都感到无比自豪。

entries.en:
The performance-oriented GT Line was added to Peugeot's
RCZ lineup in 2015.

The front-mounted turbocharged 1.6-liter inline-4 produced
156ps and 24.5kgm of torque.

The GT Line was also a great looking car, and its compact size
made it an ideal car for a jaunt through the twisties.
entries.zh:
这款GT Line在2015年加入到了标致的高档双门跑车RCZ产品
家族中。

其前置的1.6升直列四缸涡轮增压引擎最大可以输出156ps的动
力和24.5kgm的扭矩。

GT Line以其充满运动感的外形和紧凑的底盘而被车迷所熟识。

entries.en:
Are you familiar with Ferrari's XX Programs?

It's a where Ferrari asks its car owners to test drive its
various models to help develop new technologies.

The FXX-K was developed from this unique program.

The car was developed for track use and came equipped with a
1000ps-plus hybrid propulsion unit.

Testing from the XX Programs provided valuable data that
also helped the company's race car development.
entries.zh:
您了解法拉利的XX计划吗？

在这项计划中，法拉利车主可以参与试驾活动，为新的技术
研发提供帮助。

FXX-K就是专为XX计划的试驾活动而制造的。

这辆以赛道驾驶为目的的车型安装有超过1000ps的混动
动力单元。

通过FXX-K试驾活动取得的数据甚至在赛车开发中都起到了
巨大的作用。

entries.en:
The McLaren GTR needs little introduction.

The F1 GTR burst onto the scene when it took Le Mans
by storm in 1995.

The P1 GTR was developed to celebrate the 20th anniversary
of that legendary victory.

As you might expect, it's based on the P1, a hybrid supercar.

This track-only model had plenty of power, with total output
rated somewhere around 1000ps.
entries.zh:
这款迈凯伦GTR想来不需要我多做介绍了。

F1 GTR的狂潮在1995年席卷了勒芒，也俘获了汽车爱好者的心……

而P1 GTR正是为了庆祝这次伟大胜利20周年而开发的。

如您所预料，这辆车基于混动超跑P1开发，

是一辆血统纯正的赛道用比赛机器，足以称霸整个1000ps马
力级别。!

entries.en:
BAC is a newcomer to the sports car manufacturing scene, but
this British car maker has already developed a following.

The car that shot it to prominence was the single-seat Mono,
which has the look of a race car, but was totally street-legal.

It came powered by a naturally-aspirated 2.3-liter inline-4
that produced about 300ps.

With a curb weight of only 580kg, it had the power-to-weight
ratio that was comparable to a formula racer.

In fact, the lucky people who've driven say it
it feels like an F3 car!
entries.zh:
BAC是跑车制造领域中的新人，不过这家英国车厂已经在
全世界范围内聚拢了大量粉丝。

这辆单座的Mono是一部无比杰出的机器，帮助这家车厂进
一步巩固了他们的地位。

是的，它看上去仿佛是专为比赛所设计的，但出人意料
的是，它完全符合道路行驶的法规。

它结合了580kg的极低重量和300ps的超强动力输出。

懂行的人都说，它的驾驶感受非常类似Formula 3赛车！

entries.en:
The Fugu Z stemmed from the imagination of actor Sung Kang, who's
best known for his role in the "Fast and Furious" series.

The car is based on a 1973 Datsun 240Z.

The body kit was supplied by popular custom manufacturer
Rocket Bunny.

Under its hood is the RB26DETT from the GT-R sans turbos.

The combination of its stylish exterior and high-tech engine
makes the Fugu worthy of being in the next FF movie.

It certainly impressed us. It won the Gran Turismo's
Best in Show Award at the 2015 SEMA show.
entries.zh:
Fugu Z是《速度与激情》演员姜成镐心中的梦幻
车款。

它的改装原型是一台1973年的达特桑240Z。

车身套件则来自于人气很高的外观定制商火箭兔。

就连它的引擎都是一款独一无二的工程产物。

那是一台Skyline GT-R引以为傲的著名引擎RB26DETT，不过改造成了
自然进气模式。

难怪这辆小宝贝在2015年的美国汽车用品改装车展览会上
赢得了跑车浪漫旅的最佳巡展奖。

entries.en:
This Lexus au TOM'S RC F won the GT500 class of the
Super GT Series in 2016.

It was powered by a race-tuned 2.0-liter inline-4 engine.

This year marked the RC F's final year in the race series.

The LC500 flagship luxury coupe replaced the RC F
as Lexus' GT500 race car.!
entries.zh:
这辆雷克萨斯au TOM'S RC F是2016年日本Super GT系列赛的
GT500组别冠军，

拥有一台针对比赛调校的2升直列四缸引擎。

2016也是RC F参加Super GT系列赛的最后一年。

之后，它就被新旗舰车型LC 500取而代之，由后者继续参
与Super GT的角逐。

entries.en:
The Nissan MOTUL AUTECH GT-R was a familiar sight in the
2016 Super GT Series.

Its red paint scheme made it stand out among the other GT-Rs.

While it looks the same as the road-going car, underneath
the sheet metal things were very different.

It was adapted to conform to the requirements of the DTM,
the German Touring Car Masters series.

Therefore, it was rear-wheel drive, not AWD like the road car.
entries.zh:
日产MOTUL AUTECH GT-R参加了日本最高级别的GT系列赛，
Super GT。

我们的这一款车亮相于2016年。

虽然在外观上保留了经典的GT-R元素，但内在截然不同，
应用了单体车壳设计。

这项改动是为了符合DTM——也就是德国房车大师赛的规范
要求。

另外，这辆车采用的是前置引擎和后轮驱动布局。[

entries.en:
The RAYBRIG NSX CONCEPT-GT competed from 2014 to 2016
in the Super GT Series.

It waged war in the top GT500 category.

This particular model was based on the concept model
of the new NSX.

Its direct-injection turbocharged hybrid powerplant was
designed specifically for racing.
entries.zh:
这款RAYBRIG NSX CONCEPT-GT是在2014年到2016年之间
参与Super GT系列赛GT500组别比赛的赛车。

这个型号在初次亮相时就击败了NSX的第二代量产型号，成为
了备受关注的头条明星。

它的2升直列四缸直喷涡轮增压混动引擎也是专门为比赛
所设计的。

entries.en:
The MAZDA RX-VISION GT3 CONCEPT is a race car straight out
of fantasy.

It comes equipped with naturally-aspirated 4-rotor engine...

...that's based on the R26B, which was used to power
the legendary Mazda 787B.

And it produces 500ps!

The car that served as the foundation for this machine
was the RX-VISION, unveiled in 2015.

Ultra-high revs and a unique high-pitched rotary sound
combine to provide a truly thrilling ride.
entries.zh:
这辆马自达RX-VISION GT3 CONCEPT赛车诞生自马自达无穷无极的创造力。

它的自然进气四转子引擎基于R26B开发，

也就是最初用于马自达787B的那台引擎。

超高的转速和独特的高音转子声合二为一，为驾驶者提
供非比寻常的驾驶体验。

那么它的动力如何呢？轻轻松松就能超过500ps！

这款车的基础车型是RX-VISION，在2015年初次亮相。

entries.en:
The GR Supra possesses all the qualities of a typical
front-engine/rear-wheel-drive sports car...

...especially the top-of-the-line RZ that comes with a
turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-6.

This engine pumps out an impressive 340ps and
51kgm of torque.

The styling was fashioned after a formula race car, which
is evident by the car's front fascia.

Nearly 20 years after the last Supra, the new version has been
met with the approval of driving enthusiasts everywhere.
entries.zh:
这辆GR Supra是一款汇聚了高马力和前置后驱传动系统的完
美跑车。

作为最高配置的RZ版本，使用的是一台涡轮增压3升直列六
缸引擎……

可以输出惊人的340ps动力和51kgm的扭矩。

Supra时隔20年的新生引起了整个汽车世界的轰动。

全世界的赛车手、漂移车手和改装爱好者都对这款车趋
之若鹜。|

entries.sourceName: Peugeot L500R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo, 2017
entries.en:
Are you familiar with the legendary Peugeot L45?

If not, here's a crash course. It's one of the company's most
famous race cars, known for winning the Indy 500 in 1916.

It also served as the inspiration for this Peugeot L500R
HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo.

The styling of the rear, with its gently narrowing rear end,
was taken directly from the L45.

The drivetrain is a hybrid setup, consisting of a turbocharged
1.6-liter 4-cylinder and two electric motors.
entries.zh:
您对标致的传奇车型L45有多少了解？

它是这家公司最著名的赛车之一，因为在1916年赢得了印
地500而举世闻名。

它同样也是这款标致L500R混动Vision Gran Turismo的
设计灵感来源。

其车身后部的造型以及逐步收窄的车尾都直接沿用了L45
的设计。

这辆混动车配备有一台1.6升四缸涡轮增压引擎和两部电机。]

entries.en:
Nicknamed the "Kouki" ('late'), this version of the Toyota 86
appeared in 2016.

It features improved power and torque, while the suspension
system went through a complete overhaul.

Front and rear bumpers were also heavily modified to
improve airflow.

The body was made stiffer, especially at the rear, meaning
this car handles better than the original.

Jump behind the wheel, and you're sure to notice the
difference!
entries.zh:
这款丰田86在2016年上市，由于已经进入产品周期的后期，
因此获得了“Kouki”的昵称。

它的动力和扭矩都得到了增强，整个悬挂配置也进行了
全面重置。

通过重新设计前后保险杠，增强了空气流动。

另外，车身刚性也是后期改款的重中之重，尤其是车身
后部。

当您握住它的方向盘时，就能感觉到个中差别了！

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo exclusive is a Gr.3 race car based on the
Alfa Romeo 4C.

The 4C's wheelbase was extended by 110mm for this car
to improve stability.

Also, the car's front overhang was lengthened
by around 30mm.

Most of the changes resulted in improved aerodynamics, so you
can be sure this machine remained stable at very high speeds.
entries.zh:
这款跑车浪漫旅专属的组别3级别赛车基于阿尔法罗密欧4C开发。

它与4C的差异之一在于延长了110mm的轴距。

另一项不同在于前悬架，也拓宽了大约30mm。

这辆车的调校着重于稳定性和空气动力学性能的提升，
以保证高速时的顺畅行驶。

entries.en:
The 2017 Nissan GT-R boasted numerous improvements,
including a refined engine setup.

Ignition control was optimized, resulting in a 20ps
power increase over the previous model.

Maximum power output was now rated at 570ps.

The car also featured significant styling changes to
the already-menacing exterior.

This included a new front end inspired by the
GT-R Concept R35.
entries.zh:
2017款GT-R的主要特性包括一套优化调校的引擎配置以及其
他方面的关键设计改良。

点火控制的优化让它的动力比前一代提升了20ps，

最大功率输出达到了惊人的570ps。

另外，车身上还应用了大量外观改进。

其全新的车头设计灵感来源于GT-R Concept R35。8

entries.en:
This race-oriented S-FR made its first official appearance
at the 2016 Tokyo Auto Salon.

While the details of its powertrain remained undisclosed,
its creators suggested that...

...under its hood was a supercharged engine.

With even more power, combined with an excellent chassis,
this car was indeed ready for the track.
entries.zh:
这辆专为比赛而重新设计的S-FR最初在2016年东京汽车沙龙
上亮相。

它的传动系统细节从未公开，不过其设计师表示……

这就是一辆机械增压版本的S-FR。

拥有如此强力的引擎和轻量化的车身，确实有资格被称
为快速、灵巧的比赛机器。

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo original is a Gr.1 race car based on the
Bugatti VGT.

With around 600ps of power on tap, which is maybe low for
a Bugatti, this thing still accelerates like the devil.
entries.zh:
这辆原创的跑车浪漫旅组别1级别赛车基于
布加迪VGT开发。

虽然其最大功率输出被限制在600ps区间，但它的加速性能
依然在同级别中遥遥领先。

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo original is a Gr.1 race car based on the
Hyundai N 2025 VGT.

It has been fitted with a special rear wing and a naturally-
aspirated engine to comply with Gr.1 regulations.
entries.zh:
这辆原创的跑车浪漫旅组别1级别赛车基于
现代N 2025 VGT开发。

为了符合组别1规范，它不得不安装上自然进气引擎和特制
尾翼。

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo exclusive is a Gr.1 race car based on the
Mazda LM 55 VGT.

Its lightweight chassis and cutting-edge drivetrain
make it a formidable contender in its class.
entries.zh:
这辆原创的跑车浪漫旅组别1级别赛车基于
马自达LM 55 VGT开发。

它的轻量化底盘和行业领先的传动技术让它成为了同级
别赛车中最有实力的竞争者。

entries.sourceName: Peugeot L750R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo, 2017
entries.en:
This Gran Turismo exclusive is a Gr.1 race car
based on the Peugeot L500R HYbrid VGT.

Large spoilers were added to the front and rear,
greatly improving aerodynamic performance.

It's also 175kg lighter than the L500R.

And to cap it off, the hybrid system was tuned to
provide up to 750ps!
entries.zh:
这辆原创的跑车浪漫旅组别1级别赛车基于
标致L500R混动VGT开发。

它的车身前后都增加了大型扰流板，以大幅强化空气动
力学效果。

相比基础车型L500R，它的重量再次削减了175kg。

不仅如此，它的混动动力系统也接受了调校，可以输出
最大750ps的动力！

entries.en:
This particular GT-R was fine-tuned by Nissan's motorsports
division, NISMO to shine on the race track.

For starters, it uses the same turbochargers as
the GT-R GT3 race car.

This allows the V-6 engine to produce an incredible 600ps
and 66kgm of torque.

The 2017 model featured enhanced rigidity
and a competition-tuned suspension.

It set an amazing lap time of 7 minutes and 8.679 seconds
at the Nürburgring.

This actually set a record for a production vehicle
at the time!
entries.zh:
这辆GT-R由日产的传奇团队NISMO针对比赛用途进行了精细调校。

它甚至用上了GT3组别赛车的同款涡轮增压器，

将引擎的每一滴动力都榨取了出来，用于输出600ps的动力
和66kgm的扭矩。

这辆2017款车型的刚性接受了强化，悬挂系统也按照比赛
标准进行了调校。

它在纽博格林赛道上跑出了7:8.679的最佳时间，
这个成绩为团队的实力提供了最佳佐证，

也创下了当时的量产车圈速纪录！`

entries.en:
If you consider yourself a connoisseur, then this car
is for you.

It's the legendary Alpine A110, reborn for the modern age.

Power is supplied by a mid-mounted inline-4 that pumps
out an impressive 250ps.

Thanks to its aluminum chassis, it weighs in at a
lean 1100kg, making it agile and quick.

All in all, this car is worthy of the A110 name.
entries.zh:
这是一件专为鉴赏家打造的艺术品！

这辆传奇的阿尔派A110在现代得以重生。

其动力由一台中置直列四缸引擎提供，可以输出250ps的动力。

因为采用了全铝合金底盘，它的车重惊人的轻，精简到
了只有1100kg。

其杰出的操控性绝对配得上A110的盛名。

entries.en:
The DB11, successor to the DB9, is Aston Martin's current
flagship model.

As you can see, it's quite a stunning piece of metal.

Form follows function here because its elegant shape
results in excellent aerodynamics.

Under its hood is a twin-turbo 5.2-liter V12.

It allows the car to run from zero to <100km/h> in 3.9 seconds
and reach a top speed of <322km/h>!
entries.zh:
DB11是DB9的后继车型，也是阿斯顿·马丁目前的旗舰型号。

不用我多说，这辆车的设计就是它的最大亮点：

炫酷车身上的每一根线条、每一条弧度的设计都是为了
实现优异的空气动力学性能而存在的。

车上搭载有一台全新开发的5.2升V12双涡轮增压引擎。

可以在3.9秒内完成0-<100km/h>的加速，并实现<322km/h>的最高时速。这
是一辆实力非常强劲的GT竞争者。

entries.en:
This Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo is McLaren's idea of what
racing might look like in 2030 and beyond.

When you get behind its wheel, be ready to be
thoroughly impressed.

But first, you'll need to get accustomed to the
prone driving position.

By assuming this posture, your field of vision is enhanced,
and there are also benefits in terms of interior layout.

Every aspect of this car was intended to put the needs of the
driver above everything else.

McLaren's total dedication to creating the perfect race car
is reflected in this amazing design study.
entries.zh:
这辆Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo是迈凯伦对于2030年之后的
赛车做出的畅想。

它包含了一系列精妙设计，为驾驶者带来无穷的惊喜。

设计概念的重中之重必然是俯卧的驾驶姿势。

这样的姿势不仅可以扩大驾驶员的视野范围，对内饰布
局也有所助益。

这些设计的背后凝聚着以驾驶员为中心的设计理念。

这部终极机器充分体现了迈凯伦对完美驾驶体验的不懈追求。

entries.en:
This prototype, introduced at Le Mans in 2016, was yet another
effort from Toyota to grab that elusive title.

The naturally-aspirated V-8 of its predecessor, the TS040,
was replaced with a twin-turbocharged V-6.

In fact, almost everything, from the battery system to its
aerodynamics, was totally redesigned.

Although its 1000ps power output was similar to the TS040,
the way it behaved on the track was totally different.
entries.zh:
作为丰田追逐胜利的最新尝试，这辆原型车在2016年勒芒耐
力赛上粉墨登场。

其前任车型TS040采用的自然进气V8引擎在这款车上被换成
了V6双涡轮增压引擎。

而事实上，从电池系统到空气动力学方案，车辆的每一
个方面都进行了重新设计。

它的输出功率虽然和TS040类似，都是1000ps，但驾驶体验却有
天壤之别。

entries.en:
This 919 Hybrid was the jewel in Porsche's racing
crown during the 2010s.

Its mid-mounted engine sent 500ps to the rear wheels, while
electric motors powered the front tires with 400ps.

All this made it a 900ps 4WD hybrid race car.

When the WEC and Le Mans finally welcomed hybrid cars, the
919 Hybrid went quickly to work, showing its capabilities.

And those capabilities were impressive indeed, as it
went on to win big races in 2015, 2016 and 2017.
entries.zh:
这辆919 Hybrid也许可以被称作是保时捷在2010年代赛车领域中
王冠上的宝石。

它的中置引擎可以向后轮输出500ps的动力，而搭载的电机
则可以为前轮提供400ps。

四轮驱动混合功率总计约为900ps。

随着世界耐力锦标赛和勒芒耐力赛终于迎来混合动力时
代，这辆车向全世界显示了它的可能性。

它在2015、2016和2017年取得了三连冠，成为了所有参赛者赶
超的目标。

entries.en:
This was the car Audi turned to when it sought to take the
top prize at the 2016 FIA World Endurance Championship.

This particular iteration of the R18 was a hybrid racer.

It featured a mid-mounted turbocharged 4.0-liter diesel engine
and high-powered electric motors at the front.

The version here was raced by Audi Sport Team Joest.

It took 2nd place in the Manufacturers' Championship
in the 2016 season.
entries.zh:
为了在2016年的国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛冲击冠军，奥迪派出了这
辆车参赛。

这辆R18的迭代作品是一辆混动赛车，

使用一台中置4升涡轮增压柴油引擎和前置的高性能电机
驱动。

这台赛车的驾驶者是奥迪运动Joest车队。

后者最终在2016赛季的车厂冠军争夺中取得了亚军的好成绩。

entries.en:
The ZL1 1LE boasted some of the most impressive
specifications of any car in the world.

It was based on the sixth-generation Camaro SS.

The 1LE package was specifically designed for those looking to
hot-lap their car on the track.

Key features included a special lightweight construction
and a custom suspension setup.

This model lapped the famed Nürburgring Nordschleife in
an impressive 7:16.04.[
entries.zh:
这款ZL1 1LE是一辆前置后驱跑车，囊括了赛车世界中的多
项优秀特性。

它基于第六代科迈罗SS开发的。

安装的1LE套件也是专为将科迈罗开上赛道的车手们准备的。

套件的主要特点包括特制的轻量化车身结构和定制的悬
挂配置。

这款车曾在纽博格林北侧赛道上跑出过7:16.04的最佳时间。

entries.en:
The Tundra is Toyota's entry into the full-size
pickup truck segment.

The TRD Pro is the so-called "sports version" of this
versatile vehicle.

As its name suggests, it was produced by TRD, Toyota's
in-house motorsports division.

Thanks to specially produced dampers and wheels, this truck
was able to reach high speeds over the roughest of terrains.

Power was supplied by a 5.7-liter V-8 engine.

Combine that with 4WD capability, this massive beast
could also tow almost anything anywhere.
entries.zh:
坦途是丰田在全尺寸皮卡领域最引以为豪的成就。

这款TRD Pro相当于这台多功能车型的“运动版”。

它由丰田的内部汽车运动专业团队——丰田赛车开发中心负责开发……

它的特制避震和车轮能够在哪怕最崎岖的地形上达到令
人乍舌的高速。

依靠性能强大的5.7升V8引擎和四轮驱动传动系统，

您可以轻松地驱动这台超过2.5吨的怪物。

entries.en:
The GT Race Car represents Ford's continued commitment
to motorsports.

It was developed in conjunction with the production model...

...which ensured that latest racing tech was included in
both vehicles from the very start.

The racer made its debut in 2016, a year before
the production car was released.

Right off the bat, it took 1st place in the Le Mans
LM-GTE Pro category on its first try.

The version here is painted in the same color scheme
that graced the the 2018 model.
entries.zh:
GT赛车一直以来都是福特汽车公司历史上王牌中的王牌。

当年，他们决定在开发量产型号的同期开发一辆赛车——

为了从设计之初就向公路版本引入最新的比赛用技术。

这辆赛车在2016年首次亮相，比量产车型的上市时间提前了
足足一年……

它首次亮相就斩获了勒芒的LM-GTE Pro组别冠军。

这里的这一台车使用的是2018款的配色。

entries.en:
This is the GT3 race version of the BMW M6 that was unveiled
at the 2015 Frankfurt Motor Show.

The car became known as an exceptional handling machine,
with excellent stability.

Under its hood was a custom-tuned turbocharged 4.4-liter V-8.
entries.zh:
这是一辆GT3规格的宝马M6，首次亮相于2015年法兰克福车展。

它以最顶级的稳定性和优越的操控性傲视群雄，

并配备了一台定制调校的4.4升V8涡轮增压引擎。

entries.sourceName: Lancer Evolution Final Edition    Gr.B Rally Car
entries.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.B rally car is based on
the Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution Final Edition.

The color scheme pays tribute to the Mitsubishi
rally teams from the old days.

The aerodynamic parts are borrowed from the Gr.3 version.

It boasts superior downforce, which is essential when going
really fast on an off-road trail. 8
entries.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的组别B拉力赛车是基于
蓝瑟翼豪陆神终极版开发的。

它的配色灵感深受过去的三菱拉力车队启发。

其空气动力学套件沿用了组别3版本，

为车辆提供卓越的下压力，即便在泥地赛道上也能牢牢
“粘”住地面。

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.B rally car is based on
the Subaru WRX STI.

The body is specifically designed to provide maximum
downforce at high speeds.

And, the wider tires and suspension are specifically
developed for driving on the dirt.
entries.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的组别B拉力赛车基于WRX STI开发。

它应用了拉力赛领域的诸多最新科技趋势，拥有首屈一
指的下压力。

为了应对拉力赛，它改用超宽轮距，并安装了一套专为
泥地驾驶调校过的悬挂系统。!

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.B rally car is based on the
Peugeot RCZ.

There's a popular event in Colorado called the Pikes Peak
International Hill Climb.

And, as you can see from the huge front and rear wings,
this car was designed specifically to win that race.

The engine is mounted amidships, providing power to
all four wheels.
entries.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的组别B拉力赛车基于标致RCZ开发。

您有没有听说过派克峰？那是位于美国境内的一条传奇
爬山赛道。

您也许可以通过大得离谱的前后翼判断出来，这台机器
就是专为在派克峰这样的赛道上取胜而设计的。

它采用了中置引擎布局，向四轮同时输出动力。

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.B rally car is based on the
sixth-generation Ford Mustang.

The livery is inspired by the Ford GT race car.

The four lights mounted on the hood and wide body give
the car a menacing presence.

Underneath the body, the suspension has been strengthened
to keep ride quality stable.

The original car was rear-wheel drive, but this one has been
converted to 4WD.
entries.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的组别B拉力赛车基于第六代Mustang开发。

它的涂装来源于福特GT的官方车队配色……

它的宽体车身和在引擎盖上高高竖起的四盏车灯形成了
具有冲击力的造型。

此外，其悬挂系统也进行了特别强化，以确保相对恒定
的离地间隙。

传动系统方面，则是从基础车型的前置后驱布局换成了
拉力赛常用的四轮驱动。

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.B rally car is based on the
Ford Focus ST.

The drivetrain has been converted from powering only the
front wheels to 4WD.

Various changes have also been made to alter the weight
distribution, such as moving the radiator to the rear.

The handling is considerably sharper as a result.
entries.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的组别B拉力赛车基于福特福克斯ST开发。

其传动系统从标准的前置前驱改为了四轮驱动。

为了调整配重比，这台车经历了翻天覆地的改装，例如
将散热器挪到了车身后部。

这辆车的操控性也因此得到了大幅强化，容错率更高。

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive safety car is based on the
Mercedes AMG GT S.

It comes equipped with essential safety-car equipment, such
as a revolving light on the roof and flashing headlights.

The AMG GT S is known for having been the official safety
car of Formula 1 from 2015 to 2017.
entries.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的安全车以梅赛德斯AMG GT S为
改装原型。

这台车配备有一切必要的安全装备，例如车顶上的旋转灯标和闪光灯。

在2015年到2017年期间，AMG GT S还是F1赛事的官方安全车。

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.1 race car is based on the
McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo-exclusive.

Power is restricted to 950ps as per regulations,
but it packs a serious punch nonetheless.

McLaren's driver-focused technology makes this a formidable
weapon on any race track.
entries.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的组别1级别赛车是基于
迈凯伦Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo开发的。

由于赛事组别规定，它的动力被限制在950ps之内，但
依旧非常强劲。

秉承以驾驶者为中心的技术理念，迈凯伦将这辆车打造成了
任何赛车武器库中最可怕的武器。

entries.en:
Peugeot Sport's 208 GTi picked up the hot hatch mantle
from the legendary 205 GTi.

The car employed an FF layout, meaning its engine was
mounted in front and powered the front wheels.

With a more compact body than its predecessor, the 207,
it weighed more than a 100kg less.

The engine came in the form of a turbocharged 1.6-liter inline-4
that produced 200ps and 28kgm of torque.
entries.zh:
标致Sport推出的208 GTi从传奇车型205 GTI
手中接过了顶级高性能掀背车的衣钵。

以前置前驱布局搭配性能强劲的引擎，提供令人激动的
驾驶体验。

这台专属定制的涡轮增压1.6升直列四缸动力单元可以输出
200ps的动力和28kgm的扭矩。

它的车身相较于前辈207更为紧凑，还砍掉了超过
100kg的重量。

entries.en:
The 60.8km Isle of Man TT is renowned for being
one of the most dangerous races in the world.

At first only motorcycles ran the course, but for the
past few years, cars were added to the list.

Subaru has been a familiar sight at the Isle of Man event,
challenging it since 2011 with cars like this one.

This WRX's turbocharged 2.0-liter flat-4 has been tuned
to produce an amazing 600ps.

The engine and other performance parts were tuned by STI,
which stands for Subaru Tecnica International.

The motorsports arm of Subaru was also responsible
for the company's dominance in WRC.
entries.zh:
全长60.8km的马恩岛TT赛道以高难度而著称，甚至可以称得
上是生死挑战。

但是您知道这条赛道上还一直举行着一项四轮汽车的计
时赛吗？

自2011年起，斯巴鲁美国的计时赛挑战者们就一直想要用你眼前
的这台车打破纪录。

这辆WRX体内的2升水平对置四缸涡轮增压引擎经过专业人
士调校，可以输出600ps的纯粹马力。

如此强大的动力全靠STI的技术支持才得以实现，甚至有
多位专业车手也参与到了这款赛车的设计和制造中。

正是这样的技术合作阵容帮助斯巴鲁开启了在世界拉力锦标
赛上的霸主时代。

entries.en:
This Lexus RC F GT3 was created to wage war in the FIA GT3
championships.

This car has seen action in Japanese Super GT races, the U.S.
IMSA Series, and the European GT Series.

And the amazing thing is that this svelte Lexus machine
has won in every series it has appeared in!
entries.zh:
这辆雷克萨斯RC F GT3是针对国际汽联GT3组别而开发的赛车。

它曾经出战过许多赛事，例如日本的Super GT、美国的国际汽车运动协会系列赛，
还有欧洲的GT系列赛等等。

当然，它的参赛可不是为了走个过场，而是在出战的每
一项赛事中都实实在在地获得了胜利！

这才是一辆真正的速度机器应有的样子！%

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.B rally car is an original
based on the Honda NSX.

It has unique custom suspension, ensuring plenty of ground
clearance and an ability to handle the harshest terrain.

Because of its mid-engine/AWD layout, the car's weight
distribution is biased towards the rear.
entries.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的组别B拉力赛车基于本田NSX开发。

它采用独特的定制悬挂系统，以保持稳定的离地间隙，
其他针对泥地赛道的必要改装也不曾缺席。

尽管采用中置引擎布局和四轮驱动传动系统，但它的车
重配比明显地向车身后部倾斜。_

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.B rally car is based on
the Hyundai Genesis Coupe.

It has been adapted to take on any dirt road, as its
rear-wheel-drive layout was converted to AWD.

The tires are also wider, now measuring a whopping 2050mm.

Despite a relatively long wheelbase, it makes no
compromises in maneuverability.

The organic undulations of its front bumper and rally-
ready aerodynamics make it look as good as it goes.
entries.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的组别B拉力赛车基于
现代捷尼赛思Coupe开发，

针对泥地赛道驾驶进行了完备的改装：将前置后驱传动
系统替换为一套四轮驱动系统，

轮距也拓宽到了惊人的2050mm。

尽管轴距较长，但它在操控性方面没有做出任何妥协。

前保险杠那流畅起伏的外廓和适合拉力赛的空气动力学
外形让它一跃成为赛场上当仁不让的竞争者。

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.B rally monster
is based on the Nissan GT-R.

It comes equipped with a rally suspension system,
tuned specifically for driving on the dirt.

It also has an extra set of four fog lamps, making it
ready to race in the dead of night.
entries.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的组别B拉力赛车基于日产GT-R开发。

它安装了拉力赛专用悬挂系统，所有的调校都围绕提高
泥地路面驾驶响应而展开。

额外安装的一组四盏雾灯是参加夜间赛事的完美搭档。

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.B rally car is based on
the sporty Toyota 86.

Its two-layered rear spoiler and other aerodynamic elements
help make it a truly state-of-the-art rally machine.

The drivetrain has been adapted from rear-wheel drive to AWD,
ensuring appropriate grip and traction on the dirt.
entries.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的组别B拉力赛车基于丰田86开发。

双层尾部扰流板以及其他空气动力学配件的添加使它摇
身一变，成为一款最先进的拉力机器。

另外，其传动系统也从原有车型的前置后驱配置改为了
四轮驱动布局。

entries.en:
It's no secret that many of Porsche's road-going masterpieces
were the product of the company's racing heritage.

The 911 GT3 RS is no different.

The engine and suspension were custom-built for this car.

And extra steps were taken to reduce the weight,
including the installation of a magnesium roof.

The 991 was the first GT3 RS car to add rear-wheel
steering to its formidable array of features.

If you want to go fast anywhere from the open road to a
challenging race track, this car should be high on your list.
entries.zh:
保时捷那赛车范十足的设计风格深受全世界汽车爱好者的喜爱。

这款911 GT3 RS就充分地展现了他们最精湛的生产工艺。

定制化打造的引擎和悬挂系统自不必提。

保时捷还采取了一系列措施来减轻车重，例如安装镁合金车顶等。

在同类型车中首次应用的后轮转向让本就所向披靡的各项特性
如虎添翼。

不论车速有多快，它都能确保提供超一流的操控性能。

entries.en:
This Vision Gran Turismo celebrates the Porsche brand
in the form of a lightweight sports car.

It features a state-of-the-art carbon-fiber monocoque and a
beautiful glass canopy.

The design pays tribute to classic Porsches from the past,
including the 356 roadster.

The power unit was inspired the 919 endurance race car
and the all-electric Taycan.

It features two motors, one in the front and the other at the
rear of the car.

This "dual electric engine" produces an impressive
1114ps through an AWD layout.

The car remains incredibly stable at high speed, too,
thanks to its active aero systems.
entries.zh:
这台轻量化的Vision Gran Turismo跑车充分展现出了保时捷的
优雅。

技术领先的碳纤维单体车壳以及
绝美的玻璃车顶是它的吸睛亮点。

设计方面沿袭了开启保时捷传奇的
356车型的优良传统。

动力单元则汲取了919
耐力赛赛车和全电动的Taycan的经验。

它装有两台电机，一台在车前部，一台
在车后部。

这种“双电动引擎”组合可以提供令人惊诧的
1114ps动力。

还有它的主动式空气动力系统，
将动感而高效的驾驶感受带到了这款车型上。\

entries.en:
The 996 GT3 was a true labor of love for Porsche's
top engineers.

In fact, this high-performance model reinvented the 911 genre.

First, instead of the traditional air-cooled engine, this one
came with a water-cooled boxer powerplant.

Thanks to its excellent power and race-ready chassis, the GT3
served as the foundation for many race cars.

Some say it's the true successor to the 993 Carrera RS.

But everyone agrees it's a car that will go down
in Porsche history.
entries.zh:
996 GT3是保时捷的顶尖工程师们充满热诚的产物：

基于充满魅力的911原版车打造，

并加入部分现代化的设计要素，尤其是一台水冷引擎。

这款GT3在未来将会成为多款赛车的设计基础。

还有人说他是993 Carrera RS的真正继承者。

无论从哪个角度看，它都是一款真正具有开创历史意义的赛车。^

entries.en:
The Taycan is Porsche's first fully electric vehicle.

The motors are incredibly powerful and super
responsive as you would expect from a Porsche.

The steering system and brakes are also world-class.

The Turbo S, which is the top-of-the-line model,
delivers a massive 761ps.
entries.zh:
Taycan是保时捷的第一款全电动汽车。

它的电机性能和响应速度都完全配得上这个顶级品牌的身份，

转向和刹车系统也无不在昭示着“保时捷”的响亮名号。

整个产品系列中最顶级的型号涡轮增压S的动力输出竟然高达761ps。

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive safety car is based on the
Nissan GT-R.

The LED lights on the roof and bumpers provide helpful
information for drivers on the track.

They are controlled by a set of specially-designed
switches inside the car9
entries.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的安全车基于日产GT-R开发。

车顶和保险杠上安装的LED灯会为赛道上的车手们提供重
要的信息。

这种灯光信号是由车内的一套特殊开关控制的。

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.3 race car is based on
the Volkswagen Beetle.

It has undergone a number of special improvements, including
being converted from a front-drive car to a rear-wheel drive.

With its wide fenders and missing roof, there's not
much of the original car left in this machine.
entries.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的组别3级别赛车基于
大众甲壳虫开发。

它接受了一系列特别的升级和改良，包括从前置前驱传
动系统改为前置后驱，

还加装了宽挡泥板，降低了车顶高度，以实现跑车化的
改造。

entries.en:
This road car was designed as a homologated
Alfa Romeo 4C Gr.3.

It features a 450ps engine mounted on a chassis with a long
wheelbase designed for the 4C Gr.3.
entries.zh:
这款公路车是一款经过改装，并获得认证的
阿尔法罗密欧4C组别3级别赛车。

在专为这款4C组别3级别赛车设计的长轴距底盘之上，
安装了一台450ps的引擎。

entries.en:
This road car was designed as a homologated
Corvette C7 Gr.3.

At 2050mm, it's the maximum allowable width for a
Gr.3 racer.

Its chassis retains all the hallmarks of its race car
forebears, and the handling is very responsive.-
entries.zh:
这款公路车是一款经过改装，并获得认证的
科尔维特C7组别3级别赛车。

它的轮距达到了2050mm，也是组别3级别规定中所允许的最大宽度。

它的底盘则保留了原型赛车的所有标志性设计，操控响应相当灵敏。

entries.en:
This road car was designed as a homologated
Ford Mustang Gr.3.

There is absolutely nothing standard about its acceleration
or cornering capabilities.

It's a powerful FR, making it a great choice for anyone
who wants to do some drifting.
entries.zh:
这款公路车是一款经过改装，并获得认证的
福特Mustang组别3赛车。

它的加速性或者过弯能力都远高于标准。

这是一辆性能强大的前置后驱车，也是所有漂移爱好者
的上上之选。_

entries.sourceName: Lancer Evolution Final Edition    Gr.B Road Car
entries.en:
This N-class road car was designed as a homologated
version of the Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution Gr.B.

The weight is evenly distributed between front and rear, and
its 4WD system provides plenty of grip through corners.

This one truly breaks the rallying mold, making for
a hugely enjoyable on-road experience.
entries.zh:
这款N级公路车是一款经过改装，并获得认证的
蓝瑟翼豪陆神组别B级别赛车。

车重被均衡地分配到车的前后部，而且它的过弯性能也
极其优异，完全不像一台四驱车。

这辆车完全打破了拉力赛车的桎梏，为您提供极其享受
的公路驾驶体验。_

entries.en:
This road car was designed as a homologated
Peugeot RCZ Gr.3.

The mid-engine layout allows for the glamorous proportions that
give it its unique look.

The design brings to mind Peugeot's 2002 "RC" concept.

And it may have been the original inspiration here.
The RC also had a mid-mounted engine, after all!
entries.zh:
这款公路车是一款经过改装，并获得认证的
标致RCZ组别3级别赛车。

通过中置引擎布局，它实现了令人着迷的车身比例
和独特的外观。

其外观设计带有标致的2002款“RC”概念赛车的影子，

也许它的灵感就来源于此，毕竟RC也是一台
中置引擎车型！

entries.en:
This road car was designed as a homologated
Subaru WRX Gr.B.

The chassis is taken wholesale from the Gr.B rally version.

However, the aerodynamic parts show that on-road performance
was also a consideration.

In fact, the side panels and rear diffuser make road racing
seem like the focus here.
entries.zh:
这款公路车是一款经过改装，并获得认证的
斯巴鲁WRX组别B级别赛车。

组别B拉力赛车的底盘被全盘照搬了过来，

而新加入的空气动力学部件则体现出对公路驾驶
性能方面的思考。

事实上，从侧面板材和后扩散器的设计不难看出，其设计
重点更多放在公路赛事上。

entries.en:
The Clubsport is a Porsche Cayman GT4 designed for
racing on the track.

In terms of power, it's no different from the base model.

However, changes to the shape, underbody and power train
mean it's much more competition-focused.

The change from a 6-speed manual to a two-pedal DCT
transmission also help maximize performance.
entries.zh:
本质上来说，Clubsport就是一台中置引擎版本的Cayman GT4，
专为赛道竞速设计。

它的动力与原版车型并无差异，

而外观、车身底板和传动系统方面的改动则表明它更强调竞赛。

此外，它的六速手动变速箱被换成了双踏板双离合变速
箱，以便最大发挥速度的优势。

entries.en:
The 991 version of the 911 RSR is a race car designed for
endurance events such as the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

The biggest departure from the stock 911 is
its mid-mounted engine.

Considerable aerodynamic improvements were also implemented,
making this machine stable at high speeds.
entries.zh:
911 RSR的991版本是一款专为勒芒24小时耐力赛这样的耐力赛事
所设计的赛车。

它和911最大的差别在于它采用了中置引擎布局。

大量的空气动力学优化令它变得高度可控，操控感十足。

entries.sourceName: Fittipaldi EF7 Vision Gran Turismo by Pininfarina
entries.en:
Emerson Fittipaldi is one of the true legends of motorsports.
His credentials include...

...two-time Formula 1 champion...

...two-time Indy 500 winner...

...and now, car designer. This Vision Gran Turismo model is
his take on the perfect race car.

Its official name is the Fittipaldi EF7 VGT by Pininfarina.

The concept was to create a car that anyone could drive,
but one that could also be a serious racing contender.

And as anyone taking the wheel will see, that concept
has become reality.=
entries.zh:
埃默森·费迪帕尔蒂是一位赛车运动领域的传奇人物。

拥有两个一级方程式冠军头衔……

两届印地500冠军得主……

而现在，他又成为了一名汽车设计师。这辆Vision Gran Turismo
让他的赛车梦想成为现实。

这辆车的全称是Fittipaldi EF7 Vision Gran Turismo，由宾尼法利纳负责打造。

其设计理念是打造一辆任何人都能驾驶，但同时又具备
强大的赛事竞争力的车。

握住它方向盘的人想来都会认同，这个理念已经实现了。

entries.en:
This race car, based on the third-generation Audi TT, was
designed to compete in a one-make race.

Called Audi Sport TT Cup, it began as a support series for
the German Touring Car Masters in 2015.

As for the car, it was a bit different from the road car,
thanks to a few improvements.

For example, while the engine was the same turbocharged inline-4
as the TTS, it came with more power, rated at 300ps.

It also featured a large adjustable rear wing.~
entries.zh:
这辆赛车基于第三代奥迪TT开发，专用于参加特定的单一
车种赛……

也就是奥迪运动TT杯……

这项赛事开始于2015年，是德国房车大师赛的一项辅助赛事。

它采用了和TTS相同的直列四缸涡轮增压引擎，但动力略
有提升。准确地说，是提高到了300ps。

大型可调式尾翼则是它的另一项特色。9

entries.en:
This road car was designed as a homologated
Mazda Atenza Gr.3.

Its key features are Gr.3-worthy handling and a powerful
400ps engine.

A true expression of Mazda's "KODO" design philosophy...

Every detail has been considered, right down to how its body
reflects light.
entries.zh:
这款公路车是马自达阿特兹组别3级别赛车的认证车型，

拥有组别3级别的操控性和一台性能强大的400ps引擎。

此车充分彰显了马自达的“魂动”设计哲学……

充分考虑每一处细节，连车身对光线的折射这样的细微
之处都不放过。

entries.en:
This fourth-generation Clio was tuned by Renault Sport.

The R.S. 220 EDC Trophy boasted a strengthened
chassis and a custom 220ps engine.

Certain styling elements made it look a bit more intriguing
than the standard 2016 model.

It was a car that truly looked as good as it drove.
entries.zh:
这是雷诺Sport车队使用的第四代Clio。

这款R.S. 220 EDC Trophy采用了强化底盘和一台定制引擎，可输出
动力高达220ps。

在标准的2016款基础车型上进行了不少外观方面的改进……

小幅进化后的外观显得非常养眼。

entries.en:
This 2017 Alpine Vision Gran Turismo is based on
its predecessor from 2014.

Not only was the engine power increased to
a massive 603ps...

...its drivetrain was converted to a rear-engine,
rear-wheel-drive layout.

If you take this thing near its top speed, you'll notice
that the car's aerodynamics were enhanced as well.
entries.zh:
这款2017阿尔派Vision Gran Turismo站在了前代2014款车型的
肩膀之上。

它的引擎动力提升到了更为强大的603ps……

传动系统的升级引入后置后驱布局。

关于空气动力学全面改造后的成果，座舱里的您肯定能
体会到。

entries.en:
The Audi e-tron Vision Gran Turismo is a fully electric
version of the original Audi VGT.

Its unique styling is the work of Audi Design, the company's
in-house design department.

The body graphics are inspired by those from the classic
Audi 90 IMSA GTO.

With one motor at the front axle and two at the rear,
it was AWD with a total power output of 815ps.

The Audi race team loved this design study so much, they even
went as far as to build one in real life!%
entries.zh:
这辆奥迪e-tron Vision Gran Turismo是奥迪VGT的纯电动版本。

它那独特的外观设计来自公司内部设计团队奥迪设计。

其车身图案的灵感来源于经典的奥迪90 IMSA GTO版。

这辆车在前轴安装有一台电机，后轴另有两台，总功率
输出可以达到815ps。

因为对这台车爱不释手，奥迪的赛车部门甚至在现实里将
这辆车制造了出来。

entries.en:
Held in Las Vegas, Nevada, the SEMA Show is the world's
largest automotive aftermarket event.

The car you see here, the Wicked Fabrication GT 51...

...won the "Best in Show Gran Turismo Award" at the
2016 SEMA Show.

It was designed by former racing driver Bruce Leven...

...and built at the Wicked Fabrication factory in Alabama.

To realize a modern-day classical racing Ford...

...Leven based his creation on a 1951 Ford Custom Club Coupe.

He installed a race-tuned V-8 under the hood and reinforced
the chassis for serious track sessions.

According to Wicked Fabrication, more than 10,000 hours
were spent in building this special car.
entries.zh:
每年在美国举行的美国汽车用品改装车展览会
是世界上最大的改装汽车盛会。

Wicked Fabrication GT51曾在2016年参加车展

并赢得了跑车浪漫旅“最佳巡展”大奖！

这款车是由前赛车手布鲁斯·列文设计的，

并在阿拉巴马州的Wicked Fabrication工厂制造。

它的设计理念是打造一台“经典福特赛车”，

因此基于1951年的福特改装俱乐部轿跑进行改装……

并安装了一个经过竞速调校的V8引擎。底盘也依照竞速
需求进行了加固。

你能从这台小美人身上明显看到改装师为其倾注的超过
10000个小时的心血！/

entries.en:
The AMG F1 W08 EQ Power+ dominated the
2017 Formula 1 season.

The engine was a turbocharged 1.6-liter V-6 with a
unique integrated hybrid energy recovery unit.

The car was driven by Lewis Hamilton and
Valtteri Bottas.

Between the two of them, they notched up an
impressive 12 victories in 20 races.

This performance earned Hamilton his fourth
World Drivers Championship.

Mercedes AMG also claimed its
fourth consecutive Constructors Championship.
entries.zh:
这辆AMG F1 W08 EQ Power+是2017年F1赛季中最亮眼的表演者。

它的1.6升V6涡轮增压引擎上安装了独有的混动能量回收单元。

在2017年，刘易斯·汉密尔顿和瓦尔特利·博塔斯驾驶这款车参赛，

二人在20场比赛中总共拿下了惊人的12胜。

统治级的表现帮助汉密尔顿赢得了他的第四个车手世界冠军，

也帮助梅赛德斯AMG将他们的第四个车队冠军奖杯收入囊中。8

entries.en:
There's nothing quite like a 1980s Formula 1 car.

They were stylish, powerful and downright raw, with
gobs of power and incredible sound.

Gran Turismo thought of bringing back the mystique
of that golden era with this car.

Powering this machine is a turbocharged 1.6-liter V-6
that recalls the classic engines of the day.

And it packs some serious Formula 1 heat, too.
How's 1000ps at 11000rpm?

If you want to feel a pure Formula 1 race car,
give this one a try.
entries.zh:
俗话说，英雄所见略同……

如果您对外观设计略有心得，您一定也同意80年代的一
级方程式赛车是最美的！

这辆车就是跑车浪漫旅尝试将那个黄金年代再现的
产物。

它使用一台1.6升V6涡轮增压引擎，能让您再次体验到那个
时代的经典动力。

这款F1赛车能够输出非常强大的动力，在11000rpm的转速时能
够输出1000ps。

在我看来，没有一款车比它更值得推荐了。

entries.en:
This is what you get when you add racing-level
capabilities to the already formidable AMG GT.

Custom turbochargers raise the power to a 585ps.

And the suspension has been updated to incorporate
the technology used in today's GT3 race cars.

Thanks to the addition of a rear-wheel-steering system,
this car has razor-sharp handling character.

So, if you want to enjoy neck-wrenching cornering with amazing
straight-line performance, this is the car for you.
entries.zh:
当你为本已天下无匹的AMG GT安装上各种竞赛级别的性能
套件之后，就会得到这部杰作。

其定制的涡轮增压器可以将车辆的动力提升到可怕的585ps……

为了应用来自GT3组别赛车的技术，悬挂系统也做出了相
应升级。

后轮转向系统的加入将为您在高速下的完美操控提供保障。

所以如果您想要一边深踩油门，一边享受超级顺滑的过
弯体验，这辆车符合您的所有期待。!

entries.en:
The GR Supra Racing Concept appeared on the motorsports scene
before the new GR Supra hit the production line.

This created quite the stir for Japanese-car enthusiasts
everywhere.

The development concept for this car was to create a contender
for the Le Mans LM-GTE class.

Mission accomplished because this Supra made for the ideal
endurance racer right out of the gate.
entries.zh:
这辆GR Supra赛车概念车在新一代的GR Supra开始量产之前就
已经在赛车场上驰骋了。

它的亮相点燃了全世界爱好者的热情。

团队原本的开发目标是打造一台在勒芒LM-GTE组别中具有竞
争力的赛车。

他们出色地完成了任务，打造出了一辆理想的耐力赛赛车。

entries.en:
If such a thing as the archetypal sports car happens to exist,
then this may be it.

Building on the concept of the Type 996, the 997 featured
improved engine capabilities among other things.

This late-model version was released in 2008.

Engine displacement was increased to 3.8 liters, which
increased power by 20ps to 435ps.
entries.zh:
如果这个世界上存在一辆所有跑车的典范的话，那这个
头衔就非它莫属了。

这辆997是按照996车型的迭代来设计的，采用更强大的引
擎，追求全方位的提升。

我们面前的这一台是在2008年发布的后期车款。

其引擎排量已经扩到了3.8升，让马力提升了20ps，达到了435ps。

entries.en: Buddy_ContentCar_BrandCentralOwner_normal__911_carrera_rs_96_1020385
entries.zh: Buddy_ContentCar_BrandCentralOwner_normal__911_carrera_rs_96_1020385

entries.en:
Sold only in Japan, the Toyota Crown has represented
the quintessential Japanese luxury sports sedan.

This particular model, which was introduced in 2012, was the
14th-generation version.

With the first Crown appearing in 1955, it's one of the longest
running models in Japan to date.

The name "Athlete" was chosen to represent its
distinctively sporty nature.

It's a shame that the car has never been marketed worldwide.
entries.zh:
“丰田皇冠”这个名字在全日本汽车爱好者的心目中代表着
尊贵。

这台车在2012年首次发布，已经是久负盛名的皇冠系列中的
第14代产品了。

回首1955年推出的第一代皇冠，这个系列已经传承延续了超
过半个世纪。

丰田为14代车型定下的型号名称“Athlete”充分表达了它的运
动基因……

以及它那公路王者的霸气外形。

entries.sourceName: Mercedes-AMG F1 W08 EQ Power+ (Color Variation) 2017
entries.en:
AMG's W08 EQ Power+ was an unstoppable force in the 2017
Formula 1 season.

This particular version features an all-new color scheme
that gives the dominant race car some flash.

Like the previous year, the AMG F1 team dominated in 2017 taking
its fourth straight Constructors Championship.

Ace driver Lewis Hamilton also had a stellar year,
winning his fourth Drivers Championship.
entries.zh:
AMG的W08 EQ Power+在F1的2017赛季中势不可挡。

这个版本采用了全新的配色，显得卓尔不群。

2017年是难忘的一年，AMG F1车队正是凭借此车连续第四年
拿下车队总冠军，

而无法超越的刘易斯·汉密尔顿也用他的第四个车手总冠军实现了双
喜临门。

entries.en:
The Dallara SF19 Super Formula was built for Japan's
top-level formula racing series.

The engines used in the Super Formula championship are known
as Nippon Race Engines.

They are turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4s that produce
more than 550ps.

They're supplied by both Toyota and Honda. This particular
car has the Toyota engine.
entries.zh:
这辆达拉拉SF19超级方程式专为日本最顶级的
方程式赛车赛事所打造。

用于超级方程式锦标赛的引擎统称日本比赛引擎，

都是动力超过550ps的2升直列四缸涡轮增压引擎。

这些引擎全部由丰田和本田提供，这辆车上安装的是一台
丰田引擎。|

entries.en:
The Dallara SF19 Super Formula was built for Japan's
top-level formula racing series.

The engines used in the Super Formula championship are known
as Nippon Race Engines.

They are turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4s that produce
more than 550ps.

They're supplied by both Toyota and Honda. This particular
car has the Honda engine.
entries.zh:
这辆达拉拉SF19超级方程式专为日本最顶级的
方程式赛车赛事所打造。

用于超级方程式锦标赛的引擎统称日本比赛引擎，

都是动力超过550ps的2升直列四缸涡轮增压引擎。

这些引擎全部由丰田和本田提供，这辆车上安装的是一台
本田引擎。|

entries.en:
This safety car is a Gran Turismo exclusive based on the
Toyota Crown Athlete G.

It features a distinctive yellow body and blue revolving
rooftop light.

The Crown is known for its high level of safety features in Japan
and is also the car of choice for the national police force.
entries.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的安全车基于丰田皇冠Athlete G开发。

它采用了鲜明、显眼的黄色车身和蓝色的旋转顶灯。

皇冠是日本警方的官方采购车型，在民众眼中，也意味着
安全的保障。

entries.en:
This is the second-generation Subaru Impreza WRX.

Like its predecessor, it was a World Rally Championship star.

This car was the last Impreza to win a WRC title,
cementing a legacy that's still talked about to this day.

The production model received extensive upgrades,
including a major facelift.

The 2004 model was faster and stronger by leaps and bounds.

This was because torque was increased by 2kgm,
and the engine's mid-range response was significantly improved.

Paired with rigid and stable chassis, this car is
incredibly fun to drive on any course.
entries.zh:
这是斯巴鲁翼豹WRX车族中的第二代型号。

和其前代车型一样，它也是世界拉力锦标赛上的明星。

尤其值得一提的是，它是最后一款在世界拉力锦标赛上赢得
世界冠军的翼豹。这个荣誉直到今天依然被人们津津乐道。

其量产车型经过了大量的升级，包括外观方面的大量修改。

这辆2004款车型在速度和性能方面有了突飞猛进的发展。

在引擎方面，它的最大扭矩不仅提升了2kgm，
中转速下的响应速度也得到了大幅优化。

再搭配上坚固且贴合地面的底盘，让它能在任何赛道上
都能提供无与伦比的驾驶体验。$

entries.en:
There are two ways of sorting Lancer Evolution generations:
by number or by base model.

According to the base model system, the Lancer Evo VII,
VIII, and IX all belong to the third generation.

Of these, the Lancer Evolution IX MR was the last model.

It was also the last Lancer Evolution to be equipped with
Mitsubishi's 4G63 4-cylinder turbo engine.

With a strong turbocharger and continuous variable valve
timing, it offered better engine response than ever before.

And its sporty look helped distinguish it as the
definitive IX version.

The "MR" in its name stands for "Mitsubishi Racing," an exclusive
label reserved for Mitsubishi’s top-tier sports cars.
T
entries.zh:
蓝瑟翼豪陆神的代际排序通常有两种算法：
按照编号排，或是按照基础车型划分。

以后者划分的话，蓝瑟翼豪陆神VII、VIII和IX
均属于第三代。

这样算来，蓝瑟翼豪陆神IX MR就是第三代的
最后一款。

同时也是最后一款搭载三菱
4G63 4缸涡轮引擎的蓝瑟翼豪陆神。

凭借强大的涡轮增压器和连续可变气门正时技术，
它提供了远超常规的引擎响应。

运动外观更是翼豪陆神IX的集大成者。

名称中的“MR”则代表“三菱赛车”——
三菱顶尖跑车的专属标签。
k

entries.en:
The R8 LMS is a GT3-class race car.

And the Evo, as you might expect, is an updated model.

It features significant cooling and aerodynamic improvements
over the original 2019 version.

The hood vents are bigger and new air intakes have
been added next to the headlights.

The front/rear weight balance was also tweaked,
improving handling as a result.
entries.zh:
这辆R8 LMS是一辆GT3组别赛车。

顾名思义，名字中的Evo指代它是一款升级版车型。

相比2019车款，它的冷却器性能更好，空气动力学表现也
更出众。

引擎盖上的通风口变得愈发宽大，而且在头灯旁追加了新的进气口。

其前后配重平衡也进行了重新调整，进而优化了操控性能。`

entries.en:
This fully-customized car built by STI, Subaru's motorsports
division, was based on the standard BRZ.

It features specially engineered dampers, high-grip tires,
and original STI-built body parts.

You'll certainly notice how much better this upgraded
version corners.
entries.zh:
这辆由斯巴鲁的汽车运动部门STI全方位定制打造的赛车以一
辆标准版BRZ作为改装原型，

使用了特殊设计的避震，高抓地力的轮胎和STI原厂制造
的车身部件。

行驶当中，您一定会感觉到这辆升级版本的过弯性能提
升有多大。

entries.en:
The X2019 Competition is a virtual racer created
specifically for Gran Turismo.

It represents the pinnacle of race car design.

Development began with the X2014 Standard serving as
the base model.

Downforce was reduced slightly, and the original engine
swapped out for a naturally-aspirated 3.0-liter V-12.

It was designed to test the skills of the best drivers in
the world, not to mention provide thrilling racing action.
entries.zh:
这辆X2019 Competition是一款专为跑车浪漫旅打造
的顶级赛车，

代表了赛车设计的巅峰水平。

它以X2014 Standard为基础原型进行开发，

稍稍降低了下压力，并将原版引擎换成了一台自然进气
的3升V12引擎。

它的设计旨在以近距离的位置争夺考验车手的技术，并
且鼓励车手进行紧张刺激的竞技性表演。

entries.en:
The Lambo V12 Vision Gran Turismo offers a glimpse
into the future of single-seat super sports cars.

Designed by Lamborghini's internal design department,
Lamborghini Centro Stile...

...the car features y-shapes and hexagons all over
its sleek body.

The drivetrain is a hybrid system, with electric motors
and a V-12.

The so-called "digital cockpit" has various augmented
reality features, providing a new experience for drivers.
entries.zh:
这辆兰博基尼V12  Vision Gran Turismo是一辆充满未来感的
单座超级跑车。

它出自兰博基尼的内部设计部门兰博基尼设计中心
的手笔……

它的主要造型元素由为数不少的y形和六边形轮廓组成，
遍布线条利落的纤细车身上下。

它的混合动力单元由一台V12引擎和电机构成。

还有那个搭载各种增强现实功能，被称为“数字驾驶舱”
的座舱，绝对是一项不可不睹的奇观。

entries.en:
The Vision Gran Turismo Coupé is the ultimate expression of
Jaguar's impeccable pedigree and technological wizardry.

The experience centers on its fully electric powertrain.

Every lesson learned from Jaguar's Formula E and I-PACE
eTROPHY history has been worked into the car.

The beautiful interior and exterior draws inspiration
from the marque's rich motorsports history.

The past, the present and future;
they're all are here in this one exquisite vehicle.
entries.zh:
这辆Vision Gran Turismo Coupé是捷豹那完美血统和技术魔力的
终极展现。

其驾驶体验主要围绕一套纯电动力系统打造。

所有从捷豹的电动方程式锦标赛和I-PACE eTROPHY杯纯电动车锦标赛赛事经验中积累的
宝贵知识都得到了充分利用。

充满美感的内饰和外观设计从整个赛车运动的历史中汲
取了灵感，

让赛车的过去和未来的精华，都凝结在了这一辆精美的
赛车上。

entries.sourceName: Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo LH Edition
entries.en:
This special edition of the Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran
Turismo is named for racing legend Lewis Hamilton.

Key differences from the base model include the rich
Bordeaux bodywork and the large fixed rear wing,

Also, the power of the engine has been increased to 600ps.
entries.zh:
这台梅赛德斯-奔驰AMG Vision Gran Turismo的特殊版本
以传奇F1车手刘易斯·汉密尔顿命名。

它和原版车型的主要区别在于波尔多红色的车身涂装和大尺
寸的固定式尾翼。

另外，它的引擎功率也提高到了600ps。/

entries.en:
How much do you know about Porsche's legendary 917 race car?

It brought the company its first ever overall victory at
Le Mans back in 1970.

This "917 LIVING LEGEND" was created to rekindle the spirit
of that amazing machine.

Incredibly, it was developed by just a handful of staffers
from Porsche's research department.

One of the key features retained from the original 917 is
the iconic fan, located above the mid-mounted V-8 engine.
entries.zh:
不知您对保时捷的传奇赛车917了解多少？

它为这家公司在1970年赢得了首个勒芒比赛的总冠军。

这辆“917 LIVING LEGEND”在设计伊始就从它那战绩彪炳的前辈身
上吸取了不少灵感。

更令人难以置信的是，这辆车仅由人数不多的保时捷研究部
门研发完成！

其最关键的设计特性当属沿袭自917的标志性风扇，置于
中置V8引擎的正上方。

entries.en:
This is a true 4WD sports car, developed by Toyota with the
goal of competing in the World Rally Championship.

Its power ranks among the top of the turbo 1.6-liter class at
272ps, and its 4WD system was tuned for sports driving.

The body is surprisingly sturdy, resulting in excellent
handling on all types of terrain.

The specially designed 3-door body gives the car
a distinctly competition-focused feel.
entries.zh:
这是一辆丰田专为参加世界拉力锦标赛而设计的四轮驱动
跑车。

它的1.6升涡轮增压引擎拥有同级别中的最强动力，马力高
达272ps，而且四轮驱动系统也针对跑车驾驶进行了特别调校。

它的车身出奇的坚固，而且拥有让人赞不绝口的出色操
控性和稳定性，

特殊设计的三门车身也说明了这台车独特的竞赛属性。

entries.en:
Launched in 2020, the Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo SV is the
racing version of the VGT Coupé.

With its wealth of experience in the EV-racing scene,
Jaguar's aim was to create a 24-hour race contender.

The power unit was designed by the race team, and its four
motors produce a whopping 1903ps.

Its top speed is just north of <400km/h>.

Liquid-nitrogen cooling systems ensure hyper-accurate
battery temperature management.

All of which adds up to a car whose fearsome speed can be
brought to bear on every inch of the track.
entries.zh:
这辆捷豹Vision Gran TurismoSV是VGT Coupé的赛车版本，
于2020年正式推出。

捷豹运用自己在纯电动赛车领域的丰富经验，倾力打造了
一辆24小时耐力赛的冲冠赛车。

动力单元直接来自车队，四部电机总共可以输出令人咋
舌的1903ps动力。

想知道它的极限速度吗？只是将将超过<400km/h>……而已！

通过液氮冷却系统，实现了对电池温度的超精确管理。

所有这些特性集中到同一辆车上，令它在赛道上彻底发
挥出令人生畏的速度优势。

entries.en:
Jaguar's third Vision Gran Turismo car is this roadster.

It's an electric vehicle, following the lead of
the company's two previous VGT cars.

Powered by three electric motors, it's capable of
producing more than 1000ps.

It provides the pure driving experience you'd expect from a
Jaguar sports car.

The body design was inspired by Jaguar's iconic D-Type.

The D-Type was a race car that competed in the 1950s,
winning the 24 Hours of Le Mans three times!

From a styling point of view, it was best known for the huge
fin situated behind the cockpit.

And the VGT Roadster brings that fin back to life for
this modern version of the classic racer.

On this car, this fin is active, responding to the speed at
which the car is traveling.�
entries.zh:
这款“Roadster”便是捷豹的第三款跑车浪漫旅愿景跑车。

它沿袭了捷豹前两辆跑车浪漫旅愿景车的理念，是一辆纯电动汽车。

它由三个电动马达驱动，能够输出超过1000ps的动力。

它满足了车手们对捷豹跑车纯粹驾驶体验的期待。

车身设计的灵感来自捷豹标志性的D-Type赛车。

D-Type是曾在20世纪50年代出场的经典赛车，
曾三次夺下勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军！

从外观上讲，它最为人熟知的特色便是那位于车尾的巨大尾鳍……

这款VGT Roadster令它的尾鳍设计在当下再次焕发出了生命力！

在新车上，尾鳍变成了活动式的，
并且会根据车速自动作出相应调�|��h��

entries.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive safety car is based on the
Mégane R.S. Trophy.

Renault Sport's distinctive yellow color has been
retained, with a light bar added to the roof.
entries.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅原创的安全车基于梅甘娜R.S. Trophy打造。

雷诺Sport车队那标志性的黄色涂装得到了保留，车顶上还加
入了细长的警示灯。

entries.en:
This safety car is a Gran Turismo exclusive based on the
Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat.

It features a light bar on the roof and spotlight-equipped
wing mirrors.

It also comes with other special equipment, such
as bullbars.

The Charger is used as a patrol car by many U.S.
police departments.<
entries.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的安全车基于
道奇Charger SRT Hellcat开发。

它的车顶上安装了一组灯条，后视镜上安装了聚光灯，

车身上还添加了一些特种装备，如专用防撞保险杠等。

顺带一提，Charger本身就是许多美国城市警察局的警用巡逻车。:

entries.en:
This GT4 race car was specially developed by TOYOTA GAZOO
Racing for the Nürburgring 24 Hours.

Aside from the safety systems required by the regulations,
very little here is different from the factory model.

Finishing a respectable 3rd in its class...

This car serves as a testament
to the performance potential of the GR Supra.
entries.zh:
这辆GT4赛车由丰田GAZOO Racing团队专门为
纽博格林24小时耐力赛所打造。

除了添置赛事规则强制要求的安全系统外，这辆赛车和
原厂车几乎毫无差别。

最终，它在同组别比赛中取得了第三名的好成绩……
