Have you heard of MAZDA SPIRIT RACING? It’s a new brand born
of Mazda’s exceptional achievements in motorsports.

One car that embodied the full extent of Mazda’s racing
expertise was the MAZDA SPIRIT RACING ROADSTER 12R.

As its name suggested, it was based on the ND Mazda Roadster,
although beneath the surface it was something totally different.

The 2.0-liter engine is a rarity in Japanese soft-tops—featuring
hand-assembled heads and pistons.

In terms of power, it pushed the boundaries of what a
production car could achieve, with 200ps.

Its chassis was reinforced, the suspension used height-adjustable
Bilstein dampers, and the brakes supplied by Brembo.

Alas, production was limited to just 200 units. A true works-tuned
roadster, it was a rare and shining gem.�
entries.zh:
你听说过马自达灵魂车队吗？这个全新品牌源自马自达在
赛车领域的非凡成就。

马自达灵魂车队ROADSTER 12R正是一款凝聚了马自达
所有赛车技术的集大成之作。

顾名思义，它基于ND Mazda Roadster打造，
但其内部构造却焕然一新。

这台2升引擎在日本敞篷跑车中极为罕见，
配备特制气缸盖和活塞，全部由手工组装。

在动力性能方面，它将量产车规格推向极致，
可爆发出200ps的强劲动力。

底盘刚性十足，悬挂采用高度可调的
倍适登减震器，刹车系统则来自布雷博制造。

遗憾的是产量仅限200台！
相信我，这款经过厂队调校的敞篷跑车堪称稀世珍品！~

entries.en:
Polestar is a premium EV brand from Sweden with a unique
focus on speed and sustainability.

The flagship of the brand is the Polestar 5, a grand
AWD sedan measuring 5m in length.

Its panoramic glass roof maintains clear visibility with the
aid of a camera-supported virtual rear-view mirror.

Dual motors at the front and rear delivers
650 kW of power...

...while BWI MagneRide dampers read the road up to 1000
times per second to enhance both comfort and speed.

An 800V battery system enables charging rates up to 350 kW,
and the rear motor can be decoupled for more efficiency.

Sustainable inside and out, the Polestar 5 may very well be
a guiding light for automotive design in the years to come.
entries.zh:
极星是来自瑞典的高端电动品牌，
对于速度与可持续性有独到专注。

其旗舰车型极星5是一款大型四驱轿车，
车长达到5m。

全景玻璃车顶丝毫不影响后方视野，
这得益于通过摄像头实现的虚拟后视镜。

前后双电机加持的Performance性能版可输出650千瓦……

还配备了京西智行磁流变减震器，每秒可扫描路面信息
高达1.000次，从而提升行驶时的舒适感与疾速。

800V高压电池支持最高350千瓦充电功率，
后电机可分离，以提升能效。

由内到外贯彻可持续理念的极星5，很有希望成为
未来汽车设计的指路明灯。

entries.en:
Making its debut in 2022, the mid-engine 296 GTB
was Ferrari’s first V-6 plug-in hybrid.

Praised for its compact dimensions and featherweight
agility, it was a road car built for the track.

The 296 GTB would go on to serve as the foundation for the
296 GT3, successor to the storied 488 GT3.

To meet GT3 regulations, Ferrari replaced the hybrid system
with a pure twin-turbo V-6, producing 591.7 bhp.

Assembly was entrusted to the legendary French outfit Oreca,
which also provided maintenance and after-sales support.

Since its debut at the 2023 24 Hours of Daytona, the 296 GT3
quickly proved itself as a relentless competitor.

By the end of 2024, with 100 victories to its name,
it had become the undisputed star of GT3 racing.9
entries.zh:
2022年推出的中置引擎296 GTB是
法拉利首款V6插电混动跑车。

它以紧凑尺寸与极致轻量化著称，
堪称为赛道而生的公路猛兽。

事实上，296 GTB正是296 GT3的研发基础，
后者接替488 GT3成为新一代战驹。

为使该车符合GT3赛事规范，法拉利将其混动系统
更换为纯双涡轮V6引擎，输出动力达591.7匹马力。

组装由传奇法国赛车制造商奥雷卡操刀，
并提供后续维护和售后支持。

在自2023年戴通纳24小时赛首秀以来，296 GT3
不断证明其纯正血统，展现出不可撼动的实力。

仅到2024年底就已豪取100胜，
当之无愧地成为了GT3赛事的耀眼明星。

entries.en:
Ferrari had been an early adopter of hybrid technology, as
demonstrated by the LaFerrari and the SF90 Stradale.

The 296 GTB was another such plug-in hybrid; this time
powered by a V-6, first developed for the Dino.

Its twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6, paired with an electric motor,
produced a formidable 830ps.

This hybrid system not only reduced CO₂ emissions but also
delivered extraordinary output for the driver.

The car’s exterior design was equally captivating. Its low
nose echoed the classic lines of the legendary 250 LM.

Measuring 4565mm in length, the 296 GTB was compact, its
lightweight V-6 further enhancing its on track agility.

The 296 GTB embodied Ferrari’s vision of electrification
as the new secret weapon in motorsports.
entries.zh:
法拉利是混动技术的先行者，
LaFerrari和SF90 Stradale便是例证。

296 GTB也是一款插电混动车型，不同的是它
搭载了V6引擎——法拉利最初为Dino采用的配置。

这款3升双涡轮增压V6引擎结合电机，
综合输出功率可达830ps。

混动技术不仅有助于降低二氧化碳排放，
更能提供强劲动力输出。

车辆外观的另一大亮点是其低鼻锥设计，
向传奇车型250 LM的经典造型致敬。

车身长度仅4565mm，极为紧凑，
轻量化V6引擎在赛道上更有优势。

毫无疑问，这款车彰显了法拉利
将电气化作为赛车运动新型秘密武器的决心。+

entries.en:
If you've heard of Mine’s, then you are a true “Car Guy.”

Mine’s is a Japanese tuning firm renowned for its GT-Rs.

Its most celebrated creation was the BNR34 GT-R N1 base,
a fully loaded, high-performance street car.

Capped at 600ps, its RB26DETT engine was tuned for
seamless acceleration across the entire rpm range.

Its ability to lap the Tsukuba Circuit in less than a minute was
the ultimate testament to Mine’s engineering prowess.

In 2021, this example underwent a full restoration, driven
by a strong desire to preserve it for future generations.

Only its GT-R badge bore battle scars—a subtle yet striking
detail added by Mine’s president, Michizo Niikura.

Once the subject of a 300,000,000 yen offer, time would tell
how it might one day be appraised on the global stage.�
entries.zh:
若你知晓迈恩斯大名，那你一定是位真正的“玩车佬”。
迈恩斯是一家日本专业改装厂，专精于改造GT-R车型。

其最负盛名的作品基于BNR34 GT-R N1 base打造，
是一款性能卓越、配置齐全的高性能街车。

其所搭载的双顶置凸轮轴电子汽油喷射双涡轮引擎峰值功率被设定在600ps，
专为在常规转速区间内提供线性加速而打造。

这台车在筑波赛道跑进了一分钟大关——
充分印证了迈恩斯的顶尖工程造诣。

2021年，此车进行了全面修复，
因为人们强烈希望将其完好保存，以传后世。

唯有车头的GT-R徽标留有往日激战的痕迹——
这一匠心细节正是迈恩斯总裁新仓通藏先生提出的。

这台曾获3亿日元报价的座驾，
其国际舞台的价值，且待时间评说。

entries.en:
Gran Turismo players may already have been familiar with
the special formula machine known as the F3500-A.

The F3500-B was its variant, although both cars were
born of the same admiration for 1990s F1 racing.

The key difference lay in their power units. Where the F3500-A
employed a V-12, the B model carried a V-8.

Although less powerful, the V-8 delivered an output of 710ps.
Light and compact, it carried advantages of its own.

Note the newly added front wing, crafted specifically for the
car’s high nose and offered in three unique designs.

Beyond showcasing an evolution of the hanging wing concept,
it was a visual delight.

Setting the benchmark for formula machines, the F3500-B
delivered an experience that only a V-8 could provide.�
entries.zh:
《跑车浪漫旅》的玩家或许早已对
名为F3500-A的特殊方程式赛车耳熟能详。

这款F3500-B是其衍生型号，两款车均
源于对90年代一级方程式赛车的致敬。

二者的主要区别在于动力单元：
F3500-A采用V12引擎，而B型则搭载V8引擎。

V8的动力虽稍逊，但最大输出仍达710ps，
紧凑且轻量化的引擎结构更增独特优势。

注意观察新增的前翼，专为匹配该车的高鼻锥设计，
并提供了三种独特款式。

它不仅展现了悬吊式前翼设计的演进，
更带来视觉上的享受。

作为方程式赛车的标杆之作，F3500-B
带来了独属于V8引擎的驾驭体验。

entries.en:
What hasn’t already been said about the Porsche 911,
that historic and legendary sports car par excellence?

This GT3 R was derived from the 911 (992) introduced in 2018.
It may resemble a road car, but it was engineered for racing.

Notably, its displacement was increased to 4.2 liters,
and the engine was tilted forward by 5.5 degrees.

A revised layout extended the wheelbase to 2507mm, and both
the front and rear axles employed a multilink suspension.

The underfloor design concept was particularly striking, and
the swan-neck mount for the rear wing was a novel touch.

Meanwhile, the interior featured a centered seat, roll cage,
and a 10.3-inch display.

A car with a truly international clientele, the 911 GT3 R
proved its racing prowess at events across the world.�
entries.zh:
对于保时捷911这款无与伦比的历史传奇跑车，
人们早已穷尽赞美之辞。

眼前这台GT3 R正是基于2018款911（992）打造。
它虽然形似公路跑车，实则是专为赛道竞速而生。

相比911，它的显著变化在于引擎排量增加到了4.2升，
且引擎姿态向前倾斜了5.5度。

布局经过优化，将轴距延长到了2507mm，前后轴
均采用多连杆悬挂系统。

底板的设计理念相当惊艳，尾翼的天鹅颈式支架
也是富有新意的神来之笔。

同时，在座舱内，中央驾驶位、防滚架和10.3英寸显示屏
一应俱全。

作为饱受全球车迷喜爱的车型，911 GT3 R
还在世界各地的赛场上证明了其非凡实力。

entries.en:
Ever heard of the “TCR” racing category? It’s where
2.0-liter FF touring cars battle it out on the track.

Ever since this perennially popular category began, Hyundai
has been actively developing cars to compete in it.

This ELANTRA N TC is the third-generation successor to
the i30 N and Veloster N.

Exploiting the full potential of the ELANTRA N, it becomes
the ultimate lightweight, aerodynamic machine.

Although its power and torque remain within regulation limits,
its advanced chassis settings deliver superior handling.

Already carrying several victories from around the globe, it has
earned a stellar reputation among racing privateers.

Thanks to its unique design, this is one car that truly
stands out on the track!<
entries.zh:
你听说过“TCR”赛事吗？这是专为2升级别前置前驱房车
而设的比赛。

自从这项经久不衰的赛事诞生以来，
现代一直积极打造赛车来参与其中。

眼前这台伊兰特N TC是i30 N和
飞思N的第三代继任车型。

它深度释放了伊兰特N的潜能，化身为一台追求
极致轻量化和空气动力学性能的终极竞速机器。

在动力和扭矩均符合赛事规则限制的前提下，
通过精密的底盘调校，实现了卓越的操控表现。

此车目前已揽获全球多项赛事桂冠，在私人车队中
赢得了极高的声誉。

凭借独到的设计，这无疑是一台能在赛道上
尽显锋芒的实力派跑车！

entries.en:
Perhaps best known as a smartphone maker, Xiaomi arrived
on the EV scene in spring 2024 with its record-setting SU7.

The SU7 Ultra is a high-performance model that ran the
Nürburgring Nordschleife with a time of 7:04:957.

Its body employs innovative Gigacasting technology
that seamlessly integrates the battery and chassis.

Powered by three electric motors (one in front and two at rear),
it delivers a maximum output of 1548ps!

A host of aerodynamic components and lightweight carbon-fiber
panels help it achieve a maximum downforce of 285kg.

The suspension combines air springs and adaptive dampers with
torque-vectoring control for greatly enhanced handling.

With automobiles now part of Xiaomi’s expanding ecosystem,
the SU7 Ultra is poised to stand as its flagship model.�
entries.zh:
以智能手机制造商闻名的小米，在2024年春季凭借
创纪录的SU7强势进军电动车领域。

SU7 Ultra高性能版本以7分04.957秒的成绩
征服纽博格林北环赛道。

车身采用创新的一体化电池技术，
实现电池与底盘的无缝融合。

搭载三电机系统（一前两后），最大功率达1548ps！
众多空气动力学组件与轻量化碳纤维板材
共同创造高达285kg的极致下压力。

悬挂系统集成空气弹簧与自适应减震器，
配合扭矩矢量分配系统显著提升操控表现。

随着汽车业务加入小米生态，
SU7 Ultra必将担当品牌旗舰重任。

entries.en:
The Chevrolet Camaro is one of the most iconic American cars.
Its first-gen model from 1966 commands near-mythic respect.

This example is a restomod, pairing the spirit of the original
with modern high-performance upgrades.

In terms of presence, this is an intimidating machine. Built low
to the ground, it wears aggressive aero components.

The wide-mouth front bumper enhances cooling, while
chrome trim is blacked out and carbon-clad.

Under the hood sits a supercharged V-8 producing
667ps of power, making it a formidable hot rod.

Its roll-cage interior houses a sequential gearbox
and Alcantara bucket seats with a refined edge.

With its blend of classic style and cutting-edge tech, this
is a special Camaro built to compete in any era.�
entries.zh:
雪佛兰科迈罗是美式汽车中最具代表性的车型之一。
该系列于1966年问世的第一代车型至今被车迷奉为神作。

眼前这台车是基于经典车型的修复改装版，
巧妙融合了原版车型的复古氛围感和现代高性能改装。

外观上，这台车显露出威慑力十足的强大气场。
低趴的车身姿态咄咄逼人，展现精良的空气动力学套件。

宽体前杠有效提升了散热效能，原本的镀铬件
则被黑化处理，覆上了碳纤维材质。

引擎盖下，一台机械增压的V8引擎迸发出
667ps的磅礴动力，展现出最狂野的改装车气质。

防滚架座舱内，序列式变速箱与欧缔兰麂皮
桶椅相得益彰，透出精致品位。

经典外观与前沿科技的完美交融，
造就了这台足以在任何时代傲视群雄的非凡科迈罗。�

entries.en:
Renault is best known for its compact cars, but its
technical prowess extended even to its SUVs.

This was nowhere more evident than in the Renault Captur,
the perfect marriage of compact style and SUV strength.

Here is the second-generation model from 2019, easily
recognizable by its C-shaped signature lighting.

Available with gasoline, diesel and mild hybrid engines, the
range introduced Renault’s first plug-in hybrid model.

Renault hybrids were built with F1-tested technology, meaning
they were fast and offered unparalleled control.

Inside, the Captur featured a floating center console
with a 7-inch display and smartphone connectivity.

Boasting comfort and convenience in a compact package,
the Captur was a small but mighty hero of everyday life.�
entries.zh:
对大众而言，雷诺的紧凑型车型更为家喻户晓，
但其旗下的运动型多用途汽车车型也体现了高超的技术水平。

最显著的例证便是雷诺Captur，紧凑型风格
与运动型多用途汽车运载力的完美结合体。

这里的这台是2019年的第2代车型，
标志性的C型灯光设计很容易分辨。

和雷诺的第一款插电式混合动力车型一样，该车型有
汽油版、柴油版和轻度混合动力版的引擎可供选择。

雷诺的混合动力车型采用一级方程式比赛中验证过的技术，
因此在高车速下仍能保证无与伦比的可操控性。

在内饰方面，Captur采用了悬浮式中控台，
带有7英寸显示屏和智能手机互联互通功能。

Captur以紧凑的尺寸实现了引以为傲的舒适度和便利性，
是一款小巧而又强悍的日用多面手。�

entries.en:
The rapid rise of Chinese automotive design has been evident
across everything from road cars to supercars.

And the Yangwang U9 by BYD stands as a shining example—
an electric supercar that captured the art of speed.

Its bold yet graceful form was penned by Wolfgang Egger,
a renowned automotive designer behind several European icons.

Built on BYD’s e⁴ platform, the U9 featured quad motors
capable of delivering a combined output of 1305ps.

It also employed the DiSus-X system, integrating hydraulic and
pneumatic controls to enhance stability and precision.

A limited-edition variant, the U9 Xtreme, reached a top speed of
<496.22km/h>, making it one of the fastest EVs in the world.

In 2025, it posted a lap time of 6:59.157
at the Nürburgring Nordschleife.

Representing a pinnacle of China’s advanced EV technology,
the U9 stands as a rare gem in the automotive world.�
entries.zh:
中国汽车设计的显著进步已
遍及从家用车到超级跑车的各个领域。

比亚迪仰望U9便是其中一颗璀璨的明珠——这是一款
真正诠释了何为“速度艺术”的电动超跑。

其造型大胆而优雅，由曾打造多款欧洲传奇车型的
知名设计师沃尔夫冈·艾格设计。

U9基于比亚迪“易四方”平台打造，搭载4电机，
综合输出功率高达1305ps。

其云辇-X系统融合了液压与气动技术，
精准掌控速度与姿态。

限量款的U9 Xtreme的最高时速更可达到<496.22km/h>，
使其问鼎全球最快电动车。

2025年，它在传奇的纽博格林北侧赛道
创下了6:59:157的圈速纪录。

作为中国先进电动汽车技术的巅峰代表，
U9无疑是汽车界罕见的瑰宝。

entries.en:
Le Mans Daytona h (LMDh) regulations were introduced in 2023
to reduce the cost of prototype sports-car racing.

Under the new rules, BMW introduced the M Hybrid V8, a machine
intended to succeed the V12 LMR that won Le Mans in 1999.

While its oversized kidney grille gives it the look of a BMW road
car, the illuminated headlight outlines lend it a futuristic edge.

BMW selected a chassis built by Dallara, and power came from
a twin-turbo 4.0-liter V-8 derived from BMW’s DTM program.

TThe M Hybrid V8 appeared in the IMSA Championship in 2023, and
the FIA World Endurance Championship the following year.

In 2025, it scored a 1-2 finish at the eighth IMSA race and took
2nd place at Imola in the World Endurance Championship.

It also has served as the base for BMW Art Cars, but there’s
still plenty more to come from it on the track.�
entries.zh:
勒芒-戴通纳混合动力规则于2023年引入，
旨在降低原型跑车的赛事成本。

根据该规则，宝马推出了M Hybrid V8，期望它
能成为1999年勒芒冠军车型V12 LMR的继任者。

宽大的双肾形格栅赋予了它宝马公路车的神韵，
而激光光纤照明技术勾勒的头灯轮廓则充满未来感。

宝马选择了达拉拉制造的底盘，并配备了一台
4升V8双涡轮增压引擎，基于德国房车大师赛所使用的动力单元。

M Hybrid V8于2023年在国际汽车运动协会跑车锦标赛中首次亮相，
次年便征战世界耐力锦标赛。

2025年，M Hybrid V8在赛季第八场国际汽车运动协会跑车锦标赛中包揽冠亚军，
并在世界耐力锦标赛第二站伊莫拉站中夺得第二名。

它还被选为了宝马艺术车项目的创作载体。
不过，它在赛道上的传奇才刚刚开始！�

entries.en:
Porsche has a long history in endurance racing, and the 963
was designed to meet Le Mans Daytona h regulations.

It carries elements of Porsche’s road car design in its exterior,
with a chassis produced by Multimatic Inc.

Power comes from a  twin-turbo 4.6-liter V-8 hybrid engine,
a unit with roots in the legendary 918 Spyder.

In 2023, Porsche joined forces with Team Penske,
unleashing the 963 in the IMSA Championship and WEC.

In the U.S., it quickly racked up three IMSA victories,

but really began to shine the following season, in 2024.

It captured both the IMSA drivers and manufacturers' championships,
as well as the WEC drivers title.

Porsche even created a special roadworthy version, the RSP.
The 963 is truly a jewel in Porsche’s racing crown.�
entries.zh:
保时捷在耐力赛领域拥有悠久的历史，
为符合勒芒-戴通纳混合动力规则，他们打造了963。

其外观融入了保时捷公路车的设计元素，
底盘则由摩缇马帝股份有限公司制造。

其动力由4.6升V8双涡轮增压混合动力引擎提供，
这台动力单元传承自传奇车型918 Spyder。

2023年，保时捷与声名显赫的潘世奇车队强强联手，
将963投入国际汽车运动协会跑车锦标赛和世界耐力锦标赛的赛场。

在美国，它迅速斩获三场国际汽车运动协会跑车锦标赛胜利，
但直到接下来的2024赛季，它才真正大放异彩。

该车型不仅包揽了国际汽车运动协会跑车锦标赛的车手和制造商双料冠军，
还拿下了世界耐力锦标赛的车手总冠军。

保时捷甚至为其打造了一个名为RSP的特殊公路版本！
963无疑是保时捷赛车皇冠上的一颗璀璨明珠。

entries.en:
The Le Mans Daytona h regulations helped reduce the cost of
prototype racing, but also placed restrictions on components.

So Ferrari returned to the top class of the WEC after 50 years
with a car built to Le Mans Hypercar regulations.

That car was the 499P, created in the tradition of the 312 P.
The AWD uses a twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6 hybrid powertrain.

The 499P took pole position in its 2023 debut race
and stunned the world by finishing third.

The climax of its season came in the fourth race, where Ferrari
won Le Mans for the first time since 1965.

The 499P was a groundbreaking model, and Ferrari also produced
the track-only Modificata to celebrate its success.
n
entries.zh:
勒芒-戴通纳混合动力规则降低了
原型跑车的赛事成本，但也对部件施加了诸多限制……

于是，法拉利在阔别50年后决定重返世界耐力锦标赛
顶级组别，其出战的赛车正是针对勒芒规则而专门设计。

这款车便是499P，沿袭312 P基因的全轮驱动车型，
搭载一台3升V6双涡轮增压引擎与一台混动电机。

2023年，499P在首场比赛中便夺得杆位，
并最终荣获第三名，令世界为之震惊。

该赛季的高潮出现在第四场比赛中，
499P帮助法拉利自1965年以250 LM夺冠后首次问鼎勒芒。

这场比赛见证了勒芒赛事成立一百周年，
也见证了499P拿下历史性的一冠。

entries.en:
Peugeot once dominated endurance racing with the 905 and 908,
and the 9X8 marked its first entry in the Hypercar class.

Developed by Peugeot Sport, the all-wheel-drive 9X8 combines
a twin-turbo 2.6-liter V-6 with a front electric motor.

Check out the lion-claw light signatures, a design cue
it shares with Peugeot road cars.

The early 9X8’s wingless design drew plenty of attention,
but a large rear wing was eventually added in 2024.

The tires also were changed to a staggered setup,

helping improve aerodynamics and weight distribution.

It showed its refined speed in the 2025 season, finishing
a close second in the seventh race at Fuji.

With its bold approach, the 9X8 aims to redefine what a hypercar
can be: a powerful beast with a personality all its own.�
entries.zh:
标致曾凭借905和908等车型称霸耐力赛领域。
9X8则是其首款涉足终极跑车组别的车型。

这款车由标致运动开发，搭载一台2.6升V6双涡轮
增压引擎，并配备电动机。

灯组上的狮爪图案值得留意——这也是标致公路车
的标志性特征。

早期的9X8采用无尾翼设计，一度备受瞩目，
但最终在2024年还是加上了大尺寸后尾翼。

此次升级还包括将轮胎改为前窄后宽配置，
大幅优化了空气动力学性能与重量分布。

在2025赛季中，9X8展现了精准调校后的速度，
并在富士站的第七场比赛中以微弱劣势屈居亚军。

9X8大胆的理念旨在重新定义终极跑车的边界——
这头猛兽独具个性，实力不容小觑。�

entries.en:
Motorsports fans understand the importance of safety cars.
They lead rolling starts and neutralize races after accidents.

Production-based road cars often serve as safety cars, but ordinary
performance is not enough when leading race machines.

Gran Turismo created this special safety car-spec version
of the 992-generation Porsche 911 Turbo S.

The 992-generation 911 made its debut in 2018, drawing attention
for its updated platform and expanded digital technology.

The Turbo S followed in 2020 as the flagship model, with a twin-turbo
3.8-liter flat-6 and AWD delivering high performance.

It can run from 0-<100km/h> in 2.7 seconds and reach <330km/h>,
giving it the speed to handle safety car duties with authority.

The roof-mounted light bar may go unnoticed, but it remains
essential for maintaining order and safety on the circuit.�
entries.zh:
大家都知道安全车的重要性。
它们会在滚动发车或发生事故时出动，引领车阵。

通常安全车由普通公路车充任，但普通车的性能
显然有些力不从心。

因此，《跑车浪漫旅》精心打造了这款特别车型，
基于992世代保时捷911 Turbo S的安全车规格版本。

992世代911于2018年首次亮相，
因采用全新的MMB平台而备受瞩目。

这款Turbo S在两年后问世，其3.8升双涡轮增压引擎
与四轮驱动系统提供了极其稳定的性能。

它从0加速到<100km/h>仅需2.7秒，最高速度可达<330km/h>，
能从容胜任安全车的角色。

安装在车顶的指示灯是维持赛道秩序与安全的无冕英雄。

entries.en:
There is a question looming over the modern age: Is the
sports car destined to go the way of the dodo?

The IONIQ 6 N is Hyundai N’s answer to that question,
redefining the sports car for the EV era.

Its sleek streamliner silhouette boasts a Cd of 0.27, blending
aerodynamic efficiency with striking design.

Beneath that shape is 609ps and 740 Nm of torque.
But there is more here than mere brute force.

When N Grin Boost is activated, the IONIQ 6 N’s
0-<100km/h> sprint drops to just 3.2 seconds.

Its N e-Shift simulates a physical gearbox, backed
by the roar of its N Active Sound+ system.

Crowned 2026 World Performance Car, this machine
proves the electric sports car’s future has arrived.
entries.zh:
我们这个时代面临着一个严峻的问题：
跑车是否会像渡渡鸟一样走向灭绝？

艾尼氪6 N是现代N品牌给出的答案，
它重新定义了电动车时代的跑车本质。

其流线型车身拥有0.27的风阻系数，
将空气动力学效率与惊艳设计融为一体。

外壳之下蕴藏着609ps动力和740 Nm的扭矩。
但等等！它的实力远不止蛮力。

启动e-N驾趣增强模式后，艾尼氪6 N的
0-<100km/h>加速时间仅需3.2秒。

同时，e-N动力换挡模式系统模拟了传统变速箱的换挡感受，
配合N模拟声浪系统+系统的引擎轰鸣，体验更加沉浸。

这款车荣获2026世界性能车称号，
标志着电动跑车的未来已经到来。<

entries.en:
The Mercedes-Benz 300 SL Coupe is a classic car
with a real racing pedigree.

It was based on the legendary W194 racing coupe,
which won races all over the world,

including the 24 hours of Le Mans, and the
Carrera Panamericana,

a victory which really turned heads in North America.

East coast importer Max Hoffman asked the German manufacturer
to produce a road version of the W194.

Some dealers claimed to have a hundred orders waiting

Mercedes-Benz relented, and the 300 SL “Gullwing” Coupe resulted.

It's undoubtedly one of the most important models in the
company's history!&
entries.zh:
有着真正的赛车血统的梅赛德斯-奔驰300 SL轿跑
是一辆无可争议的经典跑车。

它是基于传奇赛车W194设计制造的。

W194在全世界赢下了包括勒芒24小时耐力赛在内的无数赛事。

它甚至在Carrera泛美拉力赛中取胜，让北美车迷也为之
侧目！

东海岸的进口商马克斯·霍夫曼请求德国制造商生产W194
的量产公路版本。

梅赛德斯-奔驰毫不犹豫就接下了订单！

而300 SL“鸥翼”轿跑就是这次豪赌交易的产物。

它无疑是这家公司史上最重要的车款之一！

entries.en:
The F40 was the last Ferrari to have been personally
approved by the company's founder, Enzo Ferrari.

The development codename of the F40 was "LM,"
standing for "Le Mans".

You can see that it was designed as a road car, while
it has the appearance of a serious race car.

Some say that the F40 suffers from
turbo lag and a peaky engine...

...but I consider it to be a very refined example
of Ferrari engineering.

Many professional drivers maintain that the the engine
has very few shortcomings if it is properly controlled.

That means, if you have the driving skill,
you can handle it.&
entries.zh:
F40是最后一辆由公司创始人恩佐·法拉利亲自批准生产的法拉利。

F40的开发代号是“LM”，勒芒的英文缩写。

它是一辆按照公路车来设计，但具有赛车外观的车。

外界有一种普遍的说法，认为F40的涡轮迟滞明显，引擎
的输出曲线也偏高。

但我个人认为这是一款代表着法拉利车辆工程技术水平
的车型。

多位职业车手证实，只要对涡轮的控制得当，
引擎的转速曲线就不是问题。

所以如果您的驾驶技术不错的话，我相信您一定可以驾驭它。

entries.en:
The 1997 Castrol TOM'S Supra is one of the most famous
race cars in the history of Japanese motorsports.

The All Japan Grand Touring Championship was a very popular
event in Japan from the late 1990s to the early 2000s.

It featured cars like the Nissan Skyline GT-R, the Honda NSX,
and of course, the Toyota Supra.

Nissan's GT-Rs dominated the series
in the beginning.

But the first car that challenged its dominance
was this 1997 Castrol TOM'S Supra.

The Supra would go on to win the All Japan GT Championship
four times.

But it's this iconic TOM's Supra that I remember most fondly.
entries.zh:
1997嘉实多TOM'S Supra是日本汽车运动史上最著名的赛车之一。

全日本GT锦标赛曾是90年代末期到2000年代初日
本非常热门的汽车赛事。

参赛车型包括了日产Skyline GT-R、本田NSX，
当然也少不了丰田Supra。

日产GT-R在赛事早期是最具有统治力的赛车……

且这辆1997嘉实多TOM'S Supra是最先向它们发起挑战
并夺走其统治地位的日本挑战者。

Supra在日后总计赢得了四次全日本GT锦标赛，

但给我留下最深刻印象的还是这辆标志性的TOM'S Supra。

entries.en:
Do you know about the 1991 Le Mans 24 Hours?

In the final year that rotary engines were allowed to compete,
Mazda defied the odds and won in miraculous fashion.

The winning race car was the 787B, powered by 4-rotor engine,
which outlasted powerhouse rivals like Jaguar and Porsche.

The victory was made even sweeter by the fact that Mazda
became the only Japanese company to win the historic race.

After a bad showing the previous year, no one expected the
787B to do well in 1991, qualifying in 19th position.

However, the Mazda team was undeterred and ran a strategic
and consistent race, taking the checkered flag.

The drivers who accomplished the impossible were Volker Weidler,
Johnny Herbert and Bertrand Gachot.

After the race, the now-historic No. 55 car was safely stowed
away to be preserved forever.

Then, in 2011, the car was restored and returned to Le Mans for a
demo run celebrating the 20th anniversary of its victory.
entries.zh:
您对1991年的勒芒24小时耐力赛了解吗？

那是允许转子引擎赛车参赛的最后一年，
马自达也抓住了机会一举夺魁！

在那场令人震惊的赛事中，这辆编号为55的787B成为了全
场的天皇巨星。

因为马自达此前几年在勒芒屡次出师不利，这场来之不易的
胜利就显得更加的甘美——

1990年，787在比赛中大败而归，而1991年更是因为糟糕的排
位赛表现而只能从19位发车。

但马自达车队并未气馁，克服了一切困难，取得了传奇般的
伟大胜利。

这实际上也是勒芒比赛史上第一次由日本赛车夺冠。

获得冠军的55号赛车在赛后被妥善保存。

在2011年它还接受了全面复原，在勒芒故地重游庆祝获胜
20周年的辉煌时刻！]

entries.en:
This is a 1970 model, first-generation Dodge Challenger.

And it happens to be an R/T series, powered by a 426 Hemi
engine, which features hemispherical combustion chambers.

The 1970 models debuted in 1969, and customers had a choice
between the basic straight-six model and this R/T.

The basic model was classified as a "pony car," while the R/T
was considered a true muscle car.

Relatively few Dodge Challenger R/Ts were produced,
so today they are worth quite a lot.

In fact, I'd go so far as to say that this Hemi R/T is a true
collector's item.
entries.zh:
这是第一代的道奇Challenger，推出于1970年，

而且它恰好是台R/T版本，由一台426 Hemi引擎驱动。
这是一台使用半球形燃烧室的引擎。

1970年车款在1969年亮相，消费者可在两款车型中进行选择：
基础款的直列6缸版本和这款R/T版本。

基础款的定位是一辆“小马车”，而R/T才是真正的肌肉车。

道奇Challenger R/T的产量相对较少，
因此它们今天的售价也非常高昂。

实事求是地说，这辆配备了Hemi引擎的R/T敞篷车是一辆真
正值得收藏的珍品！

entries.en:
The Ferrari 330 P4 is, without a doubt, one of the
most beautiful race cars in the world.

And one of the rarest also.

The Ferrari P series are sports cars with a mid-mounted
V-12 engine.

First developed in 1963, they have an amazing track record,
with many historic wins over the years.

The development of the P series was stepped up
to challenge Ford at Le Mans...

...and it reached its pinnacle with the P4 in 1967.

At the 1967 Daytona 24-hour race, two 330 P4s and one 412P
pulled off a spectacular 1-2-3 finish.

Even if you include the P3 modified to P4 specifications,
only four 330 P4s were ever produced.
entries.zh:
法拉利330 P4无疑是世界上最美、

也是最稀有的赛车之一。

法拉利P系列是搭载中置V12引擎的跑车，

首次开发于1963年，并在当时的许多比赛中书写了辉煌的
历史。

为了在勒芒24小时耐力赛中与福特对抗，P系列的开发力量
得到了补强，

并在1967年的“P4”中达到了巅峰。

在1967年的戴通纳24小时耐力赛中，两辆330 P4和一辆412P技
惊四座，包揽了前三。

即使算上改装成P4规格的P3，330 P4总共也只生产了4辆。

entries.en:
The 365 GTB4 remains one of the most memorable Ferraris.

It made its debut in 1968...

...as the successor to iconic 1960s Ferraris
like the 250 GT Lusso and the 275 GTB.

It is a front engine/rear-wheel-drive model,
powered by a 4-cam 4390cc V-12.

Like all Ferraris of the period, the first number indicated
the displacement per cylinder.

The "GT" stood for "Gran Turismo."

The "B" designated it as a "Berlinetta,"
meaning that it was a coupe.

And the "4" represented the 4-cam engine with
double overhead cams on each cylinder bank.

Most people know this car as the
Ferrari Daytona.

A name inspired by the company's historic 1-2-3 finish at
the Daytona 24 Hours in '67, a year prior to its release.

A major achievement indeed!�
entries.zh:
365 GTB4是真正的旗舰车型。

它于1968年首次亮相，

是1960年代法拉利指标性车款
250 GT卢索和275 GTB的后继者。

这款前置引擎、后轮驱动的车型由一台前置的4390cc4凸轮V12
引擎驱动。

像那个时期的所有法拉利一样，名字中的数字表示每个气缸
的排量，

“GT”则代表“伟大旅行”。

B代表“berlinetta”，
表明这是一台双门跑车。

最后的“4”则代表每个气缸组都装有双顶置凸轮的四
凸轮引擎。

此外，法拉利365 GTB4又普遍被称为
“法拉利戴通纳”，

因为在其发布的前一年，法拉利在1967年戴通纳24小时耐力赛
中取得了独占前三的历史性战绩。

这确实是一项一重大成就。4

entries.en:
When most people think of the Ford GT40, they think of
Carroll Shelby, and they wouldn't be wrong.

But it's worth mentioning that Shelby wasn't actually involved
with the first GT40 Mark I, which appeared in 1964.

The Mark I was a car with a fantastic concept.

I think the way it retains the look of a classic GT car
makes it especially beautiful.

The only thing the Mark I was missing was the reliability
required for endurance racing.

That's why Ford decided to hand a large part of its
racing program over to Shelby.

And, the rest is history.

But the GT40 Mark I is where it all began, and because of that,
it's considered a prized collector's item.
entries.zh:
大多数人听到福特GT40时，都会想到卡罗尔·谢尔比，
他们这样想没有错。

但值得一提的是，谢尔比本人其实与1964年登场的首款GT40 Mark I
并无关系。

GT40 Mark I是一款有着杰出概念设计的跑车。

因为它保留了传统超级跑车的外形，我认为这一点令其
尤为惊艳。

Mark I唯一缺少的是耐力赛所需的可靠性。

所以福特才将他们的赛车项目中相当大的一部分事务交给了
卡罗尔·谢尔比掌管。

此后GT40的光辉事迹，史册上早有公论。

但GT40 Mark I才是传奇的开端，而其作为稀有的汽车收藏品，
自然也是实至名归。

entries.en:
The 1965 Shelby GT350 is a variant of the Mustang
that debuted in 1964.

It was a model that was born from the collaboration between
Ford and Carroll Shelby,

and has a fantastic history of successes
in the world of racing.

Ford's then General Manager, Lee Iacocca, is generally
regarded as the man behind the Mustang.

In addition to knowing how to build cars people wanted.
Iacocca understood the value of motorsport,

which is why he entrusted the Mustang's
racing project to Shelby.

The result of this new collaboration was the GT350.

Being made specifically for racing, it's very spartan
compared to the standard Mustang,

its light, 2-seat setup and high-performance 289 engine
ensured success in SCCA and other competition races.�
entries.zh:
1965年的Shelby GT350可以视作是1964年首次亮相的Mustang的
一个变种。

它是福特和卡罗尔·谢尔比合作诞生的车型，

并在赛车界缔造了一段赫赫有名的成功历史。

福特当时的总经理李·艾柯卡被普遍认为是
催生Mustang的幕后功臣。

艾柯卡不仅知道如何制造大众想要的汽车，而且深刻理解赛
车运动的价值，

因此他才把Mustang的赛车项目委托给谢尔比。

双方新合作的产物就是这台GT350。

由于是专门为赛车运动制造的，与标准的Mustang相比，车内
装潢非常粗犷，

但双座配置带来的轻量化和高性能的289引擎确保了其在
美国赛车俱乐部和其他比赛中的巨大成功。

entries.en:
The legendary Miura supercar was actually Lamborghini's
first midship design.

This car is chassis 0706—the second of the first five cars
built—and is the oldest Miura in existence

Even for a brand as storied as Lamborghini,
the Miura is especially legendary.

Its chassis—designed by Gian Paolo Dallara—was displayed
without a body, at the 1965 Turin Salon.

Those who saw it thought it was a sure sign that Lamborghini
was going to start racing!

The reaction was enough to persuade company founder
Ferruccio Lamborghini to greenlight its development,

and the first prototype Miura was completed the
following year in 1966.

This chassis number 0706 has miraculously survived the years
without any restoration work,

and it was entered in the Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance
in 2008, where it won the Gran Turismo Trophy.�
entries.zh:
传奇的Miura超级跑车是兰博基尼的首款中置引擎车型。

这辆底盘编号0706的Miura是最早打造的五辆原型车中的第二辆，
也是现存年代最久远的一台！

即便对于充满传奇历史的兰博基尼来说，
Miura的故事也堪称传奇。

在1965年的都灵车展上首次亮相的只有底盘——
由詹保罗·达拉拉操刀设计，车身外观并未进行展示。

然而，有幸目睹此车者都将其视作
兰博基尼要进军赛车界的标志！

这样的公众反应足以说服创始人费鲁吉欧·兰博基尼
批准继续研发的计划。

第一辆Miura原型车便在第二年的1966年完成了。

这台0706奇迹般地在没有经过任何复原工作的情况下保存
到了今天，

它还在2008年亮相圆石滩经典车展，
并赢得了一座Gran Turismo奖杯。�

entries.en:
Is the McLaren F1 the greatest supercar of them all?
Quite possibly.

McLaren's founder, Bruce McLaren, had always wanted to
enter the road car business,

but died in 1970 before a true production car
could be developed.

The company would not start working on road cars again
until the late 1980s.

And this 3 seater "McLaren F1" was finally born in 1992.

Conceived and engineered by Gordon Murray, the exterior and
Interior were designed by Peter Stevens.

Many aspects of this car, including the weight balance
and distribution, are close to perfection.

Needless to say with only 106 built, they're not easy to get.

It’s little wonder that the McLaren F1 is one of the most
desirable supercars ever.
entries.zh:
这辆迈凯伦F1是最伟大的超级跑车吗？我觉得算。

实际上，迈凯伦的创始人布鲁斯·迈凯伦一直想要进入公路车市场。

可惜他在真正的量产车开发完成前就于1970年去世了。

直到1980年代后期，公司才开始重新考虑公路车的开发计划。

这款3座的“迈凯伦F1”终于在1992年姗姗来迟。

此车由戈登·穆雷构思和设计，
外观和内饰则交由彼得·史蒂文斯操刀。

这辆车在各方面的性能，包括配重平衡和动力平衡，都
堪称完美。

它的稀有程度自不用说：总共只生产了106辆，要想入手
十分不易。

这样一想，迈凯伦F1成为史上最受追捧的超级跑车之一，就
一点也不稀奇了！]

entries.en:
This McLaren F1 GTR is the overall winner
of the 1995 Le Mans 24 Hour race.

The drivers in the race were Masanori Sekiya, J.J. Lehto,
and Yannick Dalmas,

and Sekiya was the first Japanese driver to win the famed race,

and Lehto was also the first Finn to claim this honor.

Although design engineer Gordon Murray was not
keen on entering it in races,

he agreed to make some aerodynamic alterations,
and the result was a win at its first race,

which happened to be at Le Mans!

 Following the Le Mans victory, McLaren resolved to
continue developing the GTR as a race car,

making this a crucial icon in both the history
of McLaren and in the history of Le Mans.
entries.zh:
这辆迈凯伦F1 GTR是1995勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军车。

参加比赛的车手是关谷正德、J.J.莱赫托和雅尼克-达尔马斯，

关谷还是第一位赢得这项著名比赛的日本车手，

而莱赫托也是第一位获得这一荣誉的芬兰人。

尽管设计工程师戈登·穆雷对于让它参加比赛并不感冒，

但还是同意作出一些空气动力学方面的改动。结果就在
处女秀上取得胜利，

更重要的是，那场比赛就是勒芒大赛！

在勒芒胜利之后，迈凯伦决定继续将GTR作为赛车来开发，

这也使它同时成为了迈凯伦历史和勒芒历史上的一个重要标志。+

entries.en:
Carroll Shelby, who won at Le Mans and even competed in
Formula 1, was one of America's greatest car enthusiasts……

who has a permanent place in automotive history.

After he retired from driving, Shelby became a constructor,
with a focus on developing road cars that could win races.

The 'Cobra' is one of the iconic cars produced by Shelby.

First production lots were shipped out in the spring of 1963,

 and were initially powered by Ford’s 260 CID engine, which
were soon replaced by the 289 CID unit.

And the legendary Cobra 427 was introduced in 1964.

The Cobra 427 was powered by a 7L Ford 427,

which was an engine selected by Shelby with the aim to
defeat Ferrari in competition.

With their proven competition pedigree and aggressive looks,

big block Cobras are sought after by car enthusiasts
all over the world.�
entries.zh:
卡罗尔·谢尔比不仅在勒芒24小时耐力赛中拿到过冠军，甚至参加
过一级方程式比赛。他是美国最伟大的汽车狂人之一……

在汽车历史上永久地占有一席之地。

在从赛车手的身份退役后，他转而成为一名汽车架构师，
专注于开发能够赢得比赛的公路车。

“Cobra”是谢尔比的代表作之一。

第一批Cobra在1963年春天发售，

最初搭载了福特的260 CID引擎，但很快被289 CID动力单元所取代。

传奇的Cobra 427则于1964年推出。

Cobra 427由一台7升福特427引擎驱动，

这是谢尔比亲自选择的引擎，目的是在比赛中将法拉利拉下马。

由于其成熟的赛车血统和咄咄逼人的外观，

大块头的Cobra被世界各地的汽车爱好者所追捧。

entries.en:
This 250 GTO is one of the last Ferraris to combine
the characteristics of road cars and racing cars.

It's not the rarest Ferrari of them all, and maybe
there are fairer models around.

But if you like good stories, I'm sure you'll become
fond of this car!

Even if you include the 330 GT and the series 2 cars,
only 39 of these 250 GTOs were built in total.

and each one of them has its own unique tale.

This car, chassis number 3729GT, is a right-hand drive
built for the UK.

It was purchased by Jaguar dealer
and race car driver John Coombs,

and it was originally white but painted red in 1966.

Really famous drivers including Graham Hill, Richie Ginther
and Mike Parkes, drove this car in the UK during the 1960s.

It was later owned and raced by the British racing driver
Jack Sears for several years.

Since 1999 it's been owned by former Microsoft President
and chief operating officer, John Shirley.

The price of this particular car takes this long stor�ed
history into account.
entries.zh:
250 GTO是最后一代混合了公路车与赛车特性的法拉利之一。

它可能不是最稀有的法拉利，也不是外观最动人的，

但如果您对车辆背后的精彩故事感兴趣，那您一定会
喜欢上它！

即使算上330 GT和后续2系列的车，250 GTO也总共只生产了
39辆。

而且每一辆车的背后都有着独特的故事。

我们眼前这辆的底盘编号为3729GT，是一辆针对英国市场制
造的右舵版本。

它被捷豹经销商和赛车手约翰·库姆斯购入。

原本白色的车身在1966年被涂成红色。

在60年代，包括格拉汉姆·希尔、里奇·金瑟和迈克·帕克斯在内的
多位著名英国车手都曾驾驶过它。

后来有几年它归属于英国赛车手杰克·西尔斯，甚至还参加过比赛。

1999年起，它进入了前微软总裁和首席运营官约翰·雪利的收藏。

显而易见，这台车的售价已经把它漫长且精彩的经历都
换�,进去了……

entries.en:
Jaguar played a huge part in the history of the
24 Hours of Le Mans,

winning this famous race five times in the 1950s with the
C-Type and D-Type.

However Jaguar withdrew from competition at Le Mans after 1956,
and didn't show interest in racing again until the 1960s.

But development of a sports car to succeed the D-Type
had been secretly underway.

That successor of the D-Type, is the car you see before you,
the XJ13 with a midship mounted V12.

But unfortunately, this XJ13 never made it to Le Mans.

By the time the car was ready, management's priorities
had changed again.

We can only imagine what might have happened,

had Jaguar been part of the legendary Ford-Ferrari tussle
at the '67 Le Mans.
entries.zh:
捷豹在勒芒24小时耐力赛的历史上曾经极为活跃，

在20世纪50年代凭借C-Type和D-Type五次赢得这一著名赛事。

然而，这家公司于1956年后退出勒芒赛事，直到20世纪60
年代才重新表现出对比赛的兴趣。

不过，D-Type的后继者的设计开发一直在秘密进行。

它便是您眼前看到的这台配备中置V12引擎的XJ13。

不幸的是，这辆XJ13从未如愿踏上勒芒的征途。

当这辆赛车准备完毕的时候，管理层的优先战略目标又
发生了变化。

我们只能幻想，如果捷豹参与了1967年勒芒耐力赛
福特与法拉利那场堪称传奇的战斗，

最后会是什么样的结果。2

entries.en:
This is one of the most recognizable cars from the 1990s
German touring car championship known as the DTM.

After regulations were loosened in 1993, the DTM became a
platform for developing some very powerful cars.

One of these was the Alfa 155 2.5 V6 TI, which was fielded
by the Alfa Romeo works team.

Winning 12 out of 20 races in 1993...

...it secured the championship title for both
driver Nicola Larini and the manufacturer.

The DTM later became a more international competition
before being discontinued in 1996.

This meant that Alfa Romeo would go down in history as the
only non-German manufacturer to win the series.

It's one of the most significant DTM cars whose uniqueness
lies in its heritage.
entries.zh:
这是1990年代的德国房车大师赛中最为人熟知的几款赛车
之一。

在1993年降低了准入标准后，德国房车大师赛成为了开发测试马力强大
的车款的舞台。

阿尔法罗密欧厂队的155 2.5 V6 TI便是其中之一。

它在1993年的20场德国房车大师赛比赛中取得12胜，

拿到了车手（尼古拉·拉里尼）与制造商双料冠军。

德国房车大师赛后来正式并入一项国际性赛事，并在1996年停办。

这意味着阿尔法罗密欧是在德国房车大师赛历史上唯一获得冠军的非德国制造商。

顶着这样的光环，让这台德国房车大师赛冠军车显得更加出类拔萃。

entries.en:
The 1969 Z28 was the last of the first-generation Camaros
and is considered one of the greatest of them all.

After only three years of production, 700,000 units were sold.

The lineup included 12 different engines,
including inline-6- and V-8-powered variants.

This Z28 represented the top-of-the-line version of
that first-generation model.

It came with a high-revving 5.0-liter V-8,
a 4-speed manual gearbox and power disc brakes.

And the car was distinguished as a Z28 by two wide stripes
that ran the length of its body.

There's an interesting backstory to the Z28's engine, too.

It was actually based on a race engine. The 5.0-liter V-8
was essentially a de-tuned version of the engine...

...originally developed for the Penske Camaro
that competed in the SCCA Trans Am Series.

The Penske Camaro was driven by the legendary American
race driver Mark Donahue.

He won the Trans Am series in both 1968 and 1969.%
entries.zh:
1969 Z28是第一代科迈罗的末期型号，
也被认为是产品线里最出色的车型。

第一代科迈罗仅仅只生产了3年……

它的12种不同引擎配置车型，包括直列6缸
与V8引擎版本，仍销售出了70万辆。

这辆Z28是第一代科迈罗中最典型的代表。

它配备了高转速的5升V8引擎，四速手动变速箱
和效果出众的碟刹……

其经典标志之一便是横穿整个车体的两条宽涂装色带。

哦，它的引擎背后也有一个有趣的小故事。

它实际上是以赛车引擎为基础开发的，
5升引擎的去竞速调校版本。

相当于最初为美国赛车俱乐部泛美系列赛开发，
并搭载到潘斯克科迈罗上参加比赛的那款。

著名的美国赛车手马克·多纳休
曾驾驶一台潘斯克科迈罗……

在1968年和1969年连续两年赢得泛美系列赛。%

entries.en:
Have you ever considered who had the most influence over
modern racing car technology?

For me, that would be either Colin Chapman or Jim Hall.

Chapman, of course, was the founder of Lotus.
But do you know Jim Hall?

He is the founder of Chaparral Cars,

but also a driver who competed in Formula 1,
as well as being a brilliant engineer.

The most innovative of all the Chaparral cars was
this 1970 2J, aka the “sucker” car.

It featured two fans at the rear of the chassis, which were
a part of a suction system that produced downforce.

Other innovations included an adjustable spoiler and a
two-pedal semi-automatic transmission...

All in all, it’s one of the most outlandish and imaginative
race cars ever produced.

The 2J was undoubtedly Chaparral's greatest achievement,
and lives on in motorsport legend to this day.�
entries.zh:
您有没有思考过，谁才是对现代赛车技术影响最大的人物？

我会提名柯林·查普曼和吉姆·霍尔。

众所周知，查普曼是
莲花跑车的创始人，但您知道吉姆·霍尔吗？

他是Chaparral汽车的创始人，

也是一位F1车手，还是一位才华横溢的工程师。

Chaparral最具创新意义的作品是这款1970年的2J，也被称作“吸
尘器”。

它的底盘尾部安装了两个风扇，通过吸力来产生下压力。

它的其他创新设计还包括可调节的扰流板和双踏板半自
动变速箱……

总而言之，这是史上最奇特和最有想象力的赛车之一。

2J毫无疑问是Chaparral最伟大的成就，至今也是赛车运动的一
项传奇。]

entries.en:
The "Hakosuka" Skyline has become a cult classic for
Japanese car enthusiasts.

Of the various models, this 2-door hardtop GT-R,
known by its model number, KPGC10, stands out.

This car remains on the most-wanted list for many collectors.

Among the car's many charms was its engine.

It was the direct descendent of the high-performance engine
in Japan’s first prototype race car, the Prince R380.

Fewer than 1200 KPGC10s coupes were produced. Including
the 4-door models, the total is still only around 2000 cars.

This car made a name for itself by winning 49 consecutive races
in the Japanese Touring Car Championship.

Owning it means owning a piece of that
incredible history.
entries.zh:
轮廓分明的“Hakosuka” Skyline在全世界都
有着无数拥趸。

其中，这辆双门硬顶GT-R，
因其型号KPGC10而闻名于世……

至今令全世界的收藏家们趋之若鹜。

引擎是它众多的魅力之一……

该引擎是日本首辆赛车原型车，
王子R380上的高性能赛车引擎的直接继承者。

KPGC10总共只生产了不到1200辆，算上四门版也只有2000辆左右。

这还是一台在日本房车锦标赛中连续取得
49胜的历史传奇赛车。

拥有了它，就如同拥有了那段不可思议的历史。

entries.en:
McLaren's founder, Bruce McLaren, always wanted to produce
a road car that would rival the best in the world.

In 1969, he drew up plans to produce road-going cars that
were essentially slightly modified Can-Am race machines.

These were called the M6GT and M12GT.

However, they never amounted to much...

...with only a few prototypes created.

His dream was finally realized in the 1990s with perhaps the
greatest sports car of all time.

Designed by Gordon Murray and equipped with the company's
racing know-how, the McLaren F1 road car was born.

The car shown here is the McLaren F1 GTR, a race version of
the legendary road car.
　
The stock F1 was so powerful that for Le Mans, the engine had to
be detuned from 618 HP to 592 HP to comply with regulations.

The McLaren F1 powerplant was built by BMW...

...which allowed the F1 GTR to also be raced by
BMW's works teams.

It has become one of the most popular of the F1 collection
of BMW works racers.
entries.zh:
迈凯伦的创始人布鲁斯·迈凯伦一直想要进军公路车领域。

1969年，他们就计划推出公路车款。本质上则是经过
少许改装的加拿大-美国挑战杯赛车。

它们是M6GT和M12GT。

然而，这个项目只制造了几辆原型车……

直到20世纪90年代，他的梦想才通过戈登·穆雷设计的……

可合法上路的“迈凯伦F1”的诞生而真正实现。

迈凯伦F1至今仍然被许多人认为是世上最好的超级跑车。

这辆迈凯伦F1 GTR是迈凯伦F1的赛车版本。

原有的F1性能太过强大，以至于在参加勒芒比赛时，
必须将动力从636ps下调到600ps，才能参赛。

迈凯伦F1引擎是由宝马制造的……

F1 GTR也顺理成章地成为了宝马车厂车队的比赛座驾。

我们在这里看到的FINA涂装版本不但以美艳而闻名，
更是备受宝马赛车运动最受欢迎的跑车之一。

entries.en:
The Nissan Skyline GT-R has a storied racing history.

It established a tradition that was carried on by the
second-generation GT-R.

The 1999 Pennzoil Nismo GT-R was powered by
the RB26DETT, an inline-6 engine.

It won the All Japan Grand Touring Championship.

It remains one of the most consistent race cars to
ever wage war in the competitive series.

While the R34 GT-R took the title again
in 2003, which was its final year...

...the battle-tested engine under its hood had already
been swapped in favor of a V-6 powerplant.

This means that this 1999 Pennzoil was the last GT-R
to win the series title with the iconic inline-6.

There's just something special about this inline-6-powered model.
For me, its achievements are nothing short of legendary.�
entries.zh:
日产Skyline GT-R曾拥有过一段传奇般的赛车历史。

它确立了这一传统，且在
第二代GT-R上得以延续。

1999年的Pennzoil Nismo GT-R由一台直列6缸RB26DETT引擎
提供动力，

一举夺得了全日本GT锦标赛冠军。

在这一年中，它表现出了坚如磐石的性能，
证明了自己是天生赢家。

当它在2003年再次夺冠时，
这一代GT-R也步入了末年，

连引擎都已经换成了新的V6引擎。

这意味着这台1999年的Pennzoil是最后一台搭载日产标志性
直列6缸引擎赢得系列赛冠军的GT-R。

这款直列6缸车型非常特殊。在我看来，
它的成就本身已是个传奇。

entries.en:
The Ford Mark IV dominated the 1967 Le Mans 24 hour race,

and it was a momentous achievement for Ford,
which had also won the prior year.

The car was powered by the 7L V8 engine that Carroll Shelby
had chosen for the Mark II,

But its chassis was completely different.

This chassis was based on the J-car that was under development
to meet new regulations…

incorporating cutting edge aerodynamic innovations.

As a result, the Mark IV was incredibly quick.

So quick in fact, that it finished a full four laps ahead of
the second-placed Ferrari 330 P4 at Le Mans in 1967.

It's also worth noting that the drivers Dan Gurney and
A.J. Foyt were both American,

making this the first victory for an all-American team
in the history of the 24 hours of Le Mans.

And it's because of these facts that the Ford Mark IV
has a special place in motorsport history. j
entries.zh:
这是福特的一项重大成就——在1967年主宰勒芒24小时耐力
赛的福特Mark IV。

不仅如此，上一年的比赛桂冠也是由Mark IV摘得的。

该车配备了卡罗尔·谢尔比为Mark II挑选的引擎，

但是使用的底盘完全不同。

该底盘来自研发中的J-car，后者的研发旨在满足新发布的
比赛规则……

还整合了当时最先进的空气动力学特性，

使得这台Mark IV的速度快到可怕。

在1967年的勒芒耐力赛正赛中，它以足足领先亚军法拉利330 P4
四圈之多的优势完赛！

由于两位参赛车手丹·格尼和A.J. 福伊特都是美国人，

于是这就成了全美籍车手车队在勒芒24小时耐力赛上的
首胜。

这些独一无二的成就帮助Mark IV在赛车运动史上占据了特
殊的位置。�

entries.en:
You'd be hard pressed to find a wilder, more bewitching
street-legal car than the Alfa Romeo Giulia TZ.

It's also incredibly rare, with only around
12 ever built.

And what’s truly noteworthy is that this race car...

...has no history of crashes and has never undergone
any restoration work.

You can see why it has become a collector's item.

It should come as no surprise that this TZ2 won the Gran Turismo
Trophy at the 2009 Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance.
entries.zh:
您很难找到哪辆车能像阿尔法罗密欧朱丽叶TZ这般狂野、迷人，
同时还能在路上合法行驶。

不仅如此，它也非常的稀有，
总共只制造了12辆左右！

它的存在简直就是一个奇迹……

像这样一辆纯粹的赛车，居然从来没有发生过碰撞，
也从未接受过修复。

这样的无伤历史，想要不出名也难！

锦上添花的是，TZ2还在2009年的圆石滩经典车展获得了
GT奖杯。[

entries.en:
Despite their early success in the 1950s, Jaguar didn't enter
a works team at Le Mans again for almost 30 years.

In fact, they wouldn't return to the race until 1986,
when they entered the XJR-6.

The XJR-6 was designed by Tony Southgate,
who had made his name in Formula 1,

and it was powered by a naturally aspirated V12 engine.

It was the heyday of turbocharged cars, and the XJR-6's uniquely
high-pitched exhaust note was instantly recognizable.

The sight and sound of a Jaguar tearing around the track
once more certainly got the fans excited!

Two years later, Jaguar entered the XJR-9
and finally won at Le Mans,

 for their first new victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans since an
Ecurie Ecose D-Type won in 1957.

It had been more than thirty years since their last win!

That alone is enough to secure this iconic car's
place in the annals of racing history!�
entries.zh:
尽管捷豹在20世纪50年代
就早早地创下辉煌战绩，

但在之后的将近30年时间里，
捷豹都再没有以厂队的身份参加过勒芒耐力赛。

一直等到1986年，他们才带着XJR-6重返赛场。

XJR-6由当时在F1声名遐迩的托尼·索思盖特设计，

配备了自然进气V12引擎。

当时涡轮增压车型的声势日渐浩大，而XJR-6爆裂清脆的排
气声夹在其中，获得了很高的辨识度。

一辆捷豹赛车在赛道上飞驰的景象和巨大的轰鸣声都能让
车迷兴奋不已！

两年后，捷豹带着XJR-9在勒芒重新登上领奖台。

这是自1957年Ecurie Ecose D-Type获胜以来，
他们在勒芒24小时耐力赛中的首次胜利。

距离他们上次夺冠已经过去了30多年！

仅仅这一条，就足以确保这款标志性汽车被载入赛车运
动的史册里！�

entries.en:
This Nissan R92CP is the fastest Group C racing car of them all.

It really is an absolute beast, reaching over <400km/h>
on Fuji Speedway's long straight.

Group C races used to be extremely popular in Japan in their day,

The year after the FIA World Endurance Championship was created,
Japan had already set up its own endurance racing series.

This series was initially dominated by Porsche,

but Nissan and Toyota quickly grew stronger to become
its top contenders.

The R92CP - designed by Nissan's Kazutoshi Mizuno and built
entirely in-house, was developed for the former C1 class,

and its level of maturity as well as its speed
were way ahead of its competition.

Even legendary drivers of Japan such as Kazuyoshi Hoshino and
Masahiro Hasemi spoke of R92CP's acceleration with dread.
entries.zh:
这辆日产R92CP在所有C组别赛车中速度名列榜首！

这辆车绝对是一匹真正的猛兽，曾在富士赛道的长直道
上跑出超过<400km/h>的速度。

C组别的比赛在日本曾经非常流行。

事实上，在国际汽联创立世界耐力锦标赛的第二年，日本就建
立了自己的耐力系列赛。

这个系列赛最初由保时捷主宰，

但日产和丰田迅速崛起，成为其主要竞争者。

R92CP由水野和敏设计，所有零件均由日产自行制造组装，
原本是为了参加曾经的C1组别而开发的。

它的完善度和速度都要远远领先于其竞争对手。

就连日本传奇车手星野一义和长谷见昌弘也对R92CP无可比
拟的加速能力望而生畏！�

entries.en:
If you're looking for a car that will really give you a
taste of traditional American hot rod culture...

Then the 1932 Ford Model B, or "Deuce", as it is
affectionately called, is a great place to start.

The name "Deuce" comes from its two-door
configuration.

Popular as a base for customization...

It is a prime example of a custom hot rod.
entries.zh:
如果您正在寻找一辆能够真正体验美国传统改装车文化
的汽车……

那么又被大家昵称为“二点”的1932年福特Model B
或许会是个不错的开始。

“二点”这个名称来源于车型的双门配置。

它是广受欢迎的改装车基础车型，

你可以将之当做美国定制改装车的一个典型范例。

entries.en:
Franco Scaglione was a designer who applied the principles of
aeronautical engineering to car design during his career.

He is perhaps best known for his B.A.T. design concept cars.

B.A.T. stands for "Berlina Aerodinamica Tecnica," and these were
experimental vehicles designed for aerodynamic testing.

This car predates B.A.T. 5, which is usually considered
the first of the B.A.T series.

But the owner Chris Drake and many historians believe
that this car spawned the B.A.T. series...

...and should be considered to be B.A.T.1.

First presented at the 1952 Turin Motor Show, it was later
owned by the Packard Motor Car Company.

Lovingly restored over a period of seven years,
Drake's hard work paid off in 2010...

...when, at the famous Pebble Beach Concours
d'Elegance...

...it won the Gran Turismo Trophy!
entries.zh:
弗朗哥·斯凯荣内在他的整个职业生涯中都致力于
把航空工程的理念应用到汽车设计当中。

他最著名的作品当属B.A.T.概念赛车。

B.A.T.是“车辆空气动力学技术”的缩写，
这批实验车也确实被用于空气动力学测试。

尽管编号存疑，但这辆B.A.T.5通常被视作B.A.T.车系中的第一辆……

但车主克里斯·德雷克以及许多历史研究者相信
正是它启发了B.A.T.系列……

所以它才是真正的B.A.T.1。

这台车在1952年的都灵车展首次亮相，
随后归属于帕卡德汽车公司。

经过历时七年的精心修复。德雷克的辛勤工作
终于在2010年得到了回报……

这辆车出席了圆石滩经典车展，

并为他赢得了一座超级跑车奖杯。

entries.en:
To me, when Leonardo Fioravanti was at Pininfarina
and designing for Ferrari...

..remains one of the greatest periods in the company's history.

Starting with the Dino 246 and culminating with this 288 GTO,
most cars featured mid-mounted V-8 engines.

Although its styling may appear sleek and feminine, the rear
fenders are an indication of its mighty power.

Only Fioravanti could craft such a beautiful mid-engine car!
Some would say that the GTO is the epitome of his genius.

The 288 GTO’s model name is derived from its twin-turbocharged
2.8-liter V-8 powerplant.

Only 270 were ever made, so they're not that easy to find.
Still, it's a must-have for any serious Ferrari collection.
entries.zh:
我的个人意见是，列奥纳多·菲奥拉万蒂在宾尼法利纳
操刀设计的时期是法拉利历史上最伟大的时期之一。

从Dino 246开始萌芽，直到这款288 GTO臻于巅峰，大多都配
备了一台V8中置引擎。

虽然此车的造型可能看起来比较阴柔纤细，但宽厚的后
挡泥板表明了它所蕴含的强大功率。

也只有菲奥拉万蒂才能设计出如此曼妙的中置引擎汽车！

事实上，还有人说他的天才智慧都浓缩体现在了这台GTO
当中。

此车的名称288 GTO取自其装载的2.8升V8双涡轮增压引擎。

这款车只生产了270辆，所以现在一车难求。但只要您收
藏法拉利，就绝对不能缺少它！

entries.en:
The Countach had a huge impact on the motor industry, and
plotted the course Lamborghini has followed ever since.

Its development was headed up by the brilliant engineer
Paolo Stanzani...

Who, together with designer Marcello Gandini,
produced this scissor-doored masterpiece.

Although Countachs were produced for over 25 years,
the first generation LP400 remains the most popular.

There's just something different about the way it drives.
The fact only 150 were made adds scarcity value, too.

You can be certain these Countach LP400s are only going to
become more popular in the years to come.
entries.zh:
Countach的出现对汽车工业产生了巨大的影响，并就此确立
兰博基尼之后一直遵循的路线。

它的开发是由天才工程保罗·斯坦扎尼牵头负责的……

他与设计师马塞罗·甘迪尼合作无间，
联合设计了这款剪刀式车门的杰作。

尽管Countach的生产持续了25年以上，第一代的LP400
仍然是最受车迷欢迎的。

其驾驶体验颇有独特之处。而且只生产了150辆的事实也
让它身价倍增。

我可以确定地说，在未来的几年里，Countach LP400
只会变得更加抢手。,

entries.en:
If I were to ask you to think of Swiss F1 team,
chances are you'd think of Sauber,

which was founded by Peter Sauber, a keen amateur race driver.

Sauber built his first race car in 1970,
and drove it in hill climbs.

Sauber then focused on the management side of things, and the
team experienced early success with the BMW-engined C5.

In many ways, that success was the launchpad which propelled
the team all the way to Formula 1 in 1993.

Prior to its F1 involvement, Sauber's greatest achievement
was the C9, a Group C race car developed with Mercedes.

The C9 made its racing debut in 1987, and soon tasted victory.

In the 1989 season it was virtually unrivaled,

becoming the winner of the World Sports Car Championship
and winning the 24 Hours of Le Mans!�
entries.zh:
提到瑞士的F1车队，您自然会想到索伯车队。

车队的创始人皮特·索伯是一位激情四溢的业余赛车手。

他在1970年打造出了他的第一辆赛车，并驾驶它参加爬坡赛。

后来，他将重点转向管理，而他的车队也凭借搭载宝马引
擎的C5取得了早期的成功。

这种成功在方方面面激励着车队，推动他们在1993年登上
F1大赛的舞台。

在参与F1之前，索伯车队最大的成就是C9：一款与梅赛德斯
合作开发的C组别赛车。

C9于1987年在赛场上首次亮相。不久就尝到了胜利的滋味。

在1989年赛季中，它表现得所向披靡，

连续夺得了世界跑车锦标赛和勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军

entries.en:
The Shelby Cobra Daytona Coupe may be the most
valuable Shelby Cobra of them all.

Carroll Shelby was determined to win Le Mans for Ford...

...so he asked his friend Pete Brock to design a coupe body
for the Cobra.

Its specs are almost exactly the same as the 289 Cobra,
but its top speed was <30km/h> faster.

Having won class races at Le Mans and Daytona, this Cobra
claimed the 1965 FIA GT Class championship.

Only six examples were ever produced, including prototypes,
therefore, the car has become the stuff of legends.
entries.zh:
Shelby Cobra Daytona Coupe可能是Shelby Cobra中
价值最高的一款车型。

在下决心要为福特赢得勒芒耐力赛后……

卡罗尔·谢尔比便邀请他的朋友兼雇员皮特·布洛克
为他设计Cobra的车身。

它的规格配置几乎与289 Cobra完全相同，
但得益于双门车身的引入，最高速度提高了<30km/h>。

这款Cobra在勒芒和戴通纳都赢得了其所属组别的比赛，
最终又赢得了1965年国际GT制造商锦标赛GT组冠军。

包括原型车在内，Daytona Coupe只生产了六辆，如此稀少的产量
也把这台车推上了封神的位置。\

entries.en:
This unique Plymouth roadster is best known for having been
designed by Carrozzeria Ghia.

But do you know where the "XNR" name comes from?

If you try to read “XNR” out loud, it sounds just like
"Exner," doesn't it?

It's the name of the legendary American designer
Virgil Max Exner...

...who led Chrysler's design for much of the 1950s and 1960s.

He developed various designs in conjunction with
Luigi Segre of Carrozzeria Ghia.

Many innovative and interesting designs
resulted from this collaboration.

And this XNR Ghia Roadster was one of them.

The XNR also made waves in 2011 when it claimed the Gran Turismo
Trophy at the Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance.
entries.zh:
这款独特的普利茅斯roadster的出名之处在于
它是由车身制造公司Ghia设计的。

但您知道“XNR”这个名字是怎么来的吗？

您读一下就会发现“XNR”听起来很像“埃克斯纳”，对吧？

这款车的名字正是取自美国传奇设计师维吉尔·马克斯·埃克斯纳，

他于上世纪50至60年代主要领导克莱斯勒的设计。

他与车身制造公司吉亚的路易吉·塞格雷合作完成了许多设计，

二人的合作带来了大量创新而有趣的作品。

这辆XNR Ghia Roadste就是其中之一。

这辆XNR还于2011年在圆石滩经典车展夺得了GT奖杯，
再次吸引了所有人的目光。

entries.en:
Ferrari's 250 GT series owes much of its renown to this car,
the 250 GT Berlinetta.

The model was announced by Ferrari in 1959, and marked a
decisive shift away from previous 250s.

One of the most notable differences was the 2400mm wheelbase,
which was 200mm shorter than its predecessors.

This gave the car better handling, and led to the name
"SWB," which stands for "short wheelbase."

The V12 engine was also more powerful,

and driven by great drivers including Stirling Moss, Graham Hill,
and Carroll Shelby,

 the model proved to be an outstanding success.

The total production of the Ferrari 250 Berlinetta was
around 160 cars in total.

Some of these featured an aluminum body for racing, while
others like this one had steel bodies for street use.�
entries.zh:
法拉利的250 GT系列所拥有的知名度很大程度上来自于这款车，
即250 GT Berlinetta。

这款车由法拉利在1959年宣布推出，标志着与以前的250车型风
格的彻底转变。

最明显的差异之一是长为2400毫米的轴距，比前代车型缩
短了近200毫米。

这让该车获得了更好的操控性，并获得了“SWB”这个代表
“短轴距”的名号。

它搭载的V12引擎的功率也更加强大。

当时的大部分伟大车手，例如Stirling Moss、格拉汉姆·希尔，
以及卡罗尔·谢尔比都驾驶过它。

这款出类拔萃的车型在当时取得了巨大成功。

250 Berlinetta大约生产了160辆。

其中一些采用赛车的铝制车身，而另一些则采用公路车
型的钢制车身。�

entries.en:
No sports car says "America" quite like
the Chevrolet Corvette!

This second generation model, also known as the Sting Ray
was especially popular.

Later versions featuring the L88 racing engine are very
collectable, and regularly sell for over $1 million.

This 1963 coupe is perhaps best known for its split
rear window.

It's a design feature that was only used in the first
year models because it limited rear visibility.

The one-year "split window" Sting Rays are hugely popular,
and are among the most collectable Corvettes.
entries.zh:
没有哪款跑车能比雪佛兰科尔维特更能体现美国味！

其中，被称为Sting Ray的第二代科尔维特车型特别受欢迎。

搭载L88赛车引擎的后期版本非常值得收藏，其售价经常
超过100万美元。

这款1963年的双门硬顶跑车车型最为人称道的是其分体式
后窗。

受限于狭窄的后窗视线，这一设计特征仅仅出现在首发
版车型上，随后就被取消了。

总而言之，搭载了分体式车窗的首发年Sting Ray极其受欢迎，
也是最有收藏价值的科尔维特之一。

entries.en:
So let me introduce you to one of the most important cars
in the long history of the Corvette: the Sting Ray Racer.

Corvettes have been raced enthusiastically,
ever since their debut in 1954.

Zora Arkus-Duntov, an engineer and racing driver who
worked for GM, was particularly keen on racing,

and in 1957 he produced the Corvette SS,
the first Corvette built specifically for racing.

Now this Sting Ray Racer is essentially a Corvette SS
with an open-top body.

It's based on drawings by Peter Brock,
who is a renowned designer of GM.

The development of the Sting Ray Racer was commissioned by Bill
Mitchell, who was the new GM Design chief at the time.

The design of the Sting Ray Racer is known for having had
a significant influence on the history of the Corvette,

as another GM designer, Larry Shinoda, refined this design
into the C2 Corvette.
entries.zh:
请允许我向您介绍科尔维特的悠久历史中最重要的车型之一：
Sting Ray Racer。

自1954年首次亮相以来，科尔维特就受到了赛车界的广泛欢迎。

当时为通用汽车工作的工程师兼车手卓拉·阿库斯-丹托
特别热衷于驾驶它参赛。

1957年，他创造了科尔维特SS，
是第一辆专门设计为竞赛用途的科尔维特。

这台Sting Ray Racer本质上是一台采用了敞篷车身的SS。

它的车身设计由通用汽车的著名工程师彼得·布罗克操刀，

赛道版则是在新任通用汽车设计部主管比尔·米切尔监督下研发而来。

Sting Ray Racer的设计显著地影响了科尔维特车系的发展史，

再后来，另一位通用汽车的设计师拉里·篠田又对这一设计
做出了改进，创造出了经典的科尔维特C2。"

entries.en:
One of the great masterpieces of Japanese car design,

Toyota's 2000GT ranks among the most beautiful
GT cars in history.

When it debuted in 1967, it sold for a little over
two million yen, which was approximately $6800 at the time.

Today It would fetch high 6 figures in dollars.

A minor design modification in 1969 also divides the 2000GTs
into early models and late models.

The 2000GT competed in numerous speed trials
where it set records,

and it was even raced by Carroll Shelby in 1968.

All in all, it's a fabulous car, and one which you can enjoy
owning for many years.
entries.zh:
作为日本汽车设计的伟大杰作之一，

丰田2000GT已跻身世界上最美丽的GT跑车之列。

当它在1967年首次亮相时，售价只略高于200万日元，在当
时约等于6800美元。

如今，它的售价按美元计算已达到六位数的天价。

按照1969年的小改款划分，2000GT可以被分为早期和后期型号。

2000GT参加了许多速度测试，并创下多项速度记录，

甚至在1968年的比赛中担任卡罗尔·谢尔比的座驾。

总之，这辆无与伦比的车在您的收藏中停上多少年都依
然值得回味。

entries.en:
The 4WD Sport quattro S1 revolutionized the automotive
industry in the 1980s.

You only have to look at its achievements in the
World Rally Championship for proof of that!

The Sport quattro S1 was developed
for homologation in Group B rallying.

As a result, only 200 were ever built.

But that's not the whole story to this particular
Sport quattro S1.

This is an S1-E2, a further evolved version of the S1.

It won the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb in 1987,
with Walter Röhrl at the wheel.

This victory would prove to be the last hurrah for the
Sport quattro, as Audi pulled out of Group B rallying in 1986.

Without a doubt, this is one of the greatest among greats.
entries.zh:
奥迪4WD Sport quattro S1在1980年代彻底革新了汽车工业。

它在世界拉力锦标赛上的成绩就已经足以证明这一点。

Sport quattro S1是为满足B组别拉力赛事认证规范而进行开发的
原型车，

因此只生产了200辆。

但关于这一台车的故事到这还没结束！

这辆S1-E2实际上是原版S1的改进版本。

在1987年，沃尔特·罗尔驾驶这台车赢得了派克峰国际爬坡赛。

这也是Sport quattro最后一次赢得冠军。
因为在1986年，奥迪就退出了B组别。

毋庸置疑，这款车是传奇中的传奇。

entries.en:
The 500 Mondial Pinin Farina Coupe was one of the great
Ferraris of the 1950s.

There are a few different types of the Ferrari Mondial,

But this is 1 of 2 coupes that were built
to race the 1954 Tour de France!

Unfortunately it retired out of the race,

but perhaps this was a good thing, given how well it was
taken care of and endured throughout the years.

The car was bought by a French collector and safely stored
away in a chateau for several decades.

So, when John Shirley acquired the car in 2002,

everything from the engine to the paint finish was
in perfect condition!

After only minor work, he was able to enter it in the
Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance in 2012.

Unsurprisingly, it went home with the Gran Turismo Trophy.4
entries.zh:
500 Mondial Pinin Farina Coupe是50年代最伟大的法拉利之一。

法拉利Mondial有几种不同的型号，

而这辆是为1954年的环法汽车赛而制造仅有的两辆之一！

遗憾地是它并未完赛，

但因祸得福，这辆车随后得到了完善的养护并保管多年。

这辆车被一位法国收藏家买下，并安全地存放在一座城
堡里数十年之久。

因此，当约翰·雪利在2002年获得这辆车时，

它从引擎到油漆都处于完美的状态！

在稍加保养之后，他就带着这辆车参加了2012年的圆石滩
经典车展。

不出意料，它将当年的GT奖杯捧回了家！

entries.en:
Amédée Gordini was a legendary tuner of Renault
and Simca cars,

and perhaps best known for his achievements at Le Mans.

He was a hard working Frenchman who even went on to become an
F1 race car constructor - basically, a genius.

For many years, Gordini partnered with Renault to produce
performance versions of the company's mass market cars.

This Renault 8 Gordini is one such example and probably the
most popular of the official collaborations.

The fact it's almost twice as powerful as the base model
just goes to show what a genius tuner Gordini really was.

The classic blue paint with white stripes, V-shaped bonnet
and boxy styling still has legions of fans to this day!
entries.zh:
阿梅代·戈迪尼是雷诺和西姆卡汽车的传奇调校大师，

因其在勒芒比赛中的成就而广为人知。

这位勤奋的法国人甚至还参与了一级方程式赛车的制造，
换句话说，这一位是真正的天才。

多年来，戈迪尼一直与雷诺合作，生产面向大众市场车型的高
性能版本。

这辆官方合作的雷诺8 Gordini就是个不错的范例，而且可能是
最受欢迎的范例！

这台车的性能相比基础车型几乎翻了一番，足以证明戈迪尼
确实是一位天才的调校大师。

带有白色条纹的经典蓝色漆面、V形引擎盖和方正的造
型使得此车至今仍坐拥大量的粉丝！

entries.en:
The Mazda RX500 is a supercar that is nothing short of mythical.

It was built in 1970 for the 50th anniversary of Toyo Kogyo,
known as Mazda today, and displayed at the Tokyo Motor Show.

This RX500 was conceived as a successor
to the famed 'Cosmo Sport' of the 1960s.

Unlike the Cosmo Sport however, its rotary engine was not
 mounted in front but positioned rear-midship.

And this rotary engine was a high rpm type that would
rev up to 14000rpm.

With 247 HP and weighing only 850kg,
the RX500 was an extremely fast car.

Only one RX500 was ever built as a concept model, and in
2008 it was restored by Mazda to its original glory.
entries.zh:
马自达RX500是一款神奇的超级跑车。

它于1970年为了纪念东洋工业（即现在的马自达）
创立50周年而制造，并在东京车展上展出。

RX500是60年代广负盛名的Cosmo Sport的继任者。

与Cosmo Sport不同的是，它的转子引擎没有安装在前面，而是
采用了中后置布局。

这款转子引擎专为高转速而调校，最高转速高达14000rpm。

高达250ps配上仅有850kg重的车身，RX500的速度快得惊人。

RX500仅有一台概念赛车存世。在2008年，经马自达修缮后，它恢复
了往日的神采。

entries.en:
The 8C name refers to the engine's eight cylinders, and
these cars are the iconic pre-war Alfa Romeos.

The inline-8 was designed by the genius Italian
engineer Vittorio Jano.

The “Berlinetta” body was made by famed coachbuilder
Touring.

There were only five Berlinettas made in total.

This particular one, from 1937, appeared in many motor
shows and catalogues.

It also won "Best of Show" at the Pebble Beach
Concours d'Elegance in 2018.

It then won the Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'Este
the following year...

...before winning the Louis Vuitton Classic Concours Award.

I doubt many other cars have won prizes at three of the
world's biggest concours.

Needless to say, its current value is nothing short of
astronomicalű
entries.zh:
8C的名号不仅对应了引擎的8个气缸，也致敬了阿尔法罗密欧
战前生产的标志性车型。

直列八缸引擎由意大利天才工程师维托里奥·亚诺设计完成，

“Berlinetta”车身则由著名车身制造商图尔灵打造，

而且，Berlinetta只生产了五辆。

这辆1937年下线的8C在圈内声名远播，曾在许多车展和拍
卖目录中现身。

它还在2018年的圆石滩经典车展中赢得了“最佳巡展”
的名号，

并在第二年的埃斯特别墅车展中再次斩获殊荣。

它还赢得过路易·维登经典车展奖。

我怀疑有多少其他车型能包圆世界三大展会的奖项！

毋庸置疑，它现在的售价已经是个天文数字了。

entries.en:
The F50 was the successor to the F40, and was one of
the most Spartan cars Ferrari ever produced.

The idea came from Enzo Ferrari's son, Piero,

who wanted to create a road car similar to an F1 race car
for the company's 50th anniversary.

This is reflected in things like the F50's V12 engine being
mounted in the same structure as the Ferrari F1 machine.

The V12 engine in-house is also based on the V12 used in
the Ferrari F1 racers.

So if you're in the mood to drive a Ferrari F1 around town,
the F50 is the car for you!
entries.zh:
F50是F40的继任者，也是法拉利制造过的最“朴素”的汽车之一。

它的设计理念来自于恩佐·法拉利的儿子皮耶罗，

后者希望打造一款接近一级方程式赛车的公路车来庆祝
公司成立50周年。

这一理念反映在了F50的V12引擎上。这台V12引擎是基于法拉利
的一级方程式赛车设计的，

然后安装在同款一级方程式赛车结构打造的车架上。

如果您有兴趣想要开着法拉利的“F1”赛车招摇过市，F50就
是您的不二之选！~

entries.en:
The D-Type is one of the most important cars in the history
of Jaguar motorsport,

it is also one of my favorite driving cars of the 1950s.

While it shares components with the double
Le Mans-winning C-Type,

its all-aluminum monocoque body was a radical new change
from that model.

Its straight-six engine was also significantly tuned for both
power and reliability.

C-Type designer Malcolm Sayer also
worked his magic on the D-Type,

fitting a fin to factory team cars
to enhance stability at high speeds.

The D-Type retired on its Le Mans debut in 1954, but
came back in 1955 to win three consecutive races.

Just 68 of this legendary racing car were produced,
With the works cars being the most desirable.
entries.zh:
D-Type是捷豹汽车运动史上最重磅的车型之一，

也是我最喜欢的50年代车型之一。

尽管它与两次赢得勒芒比赛的冠军赛车C-Type共享部件，

但全铝单体车壳带来了全新的巨变。

其直列六缸引擎也针对功率和耐用性进行了显著调校。

D-Type的外观设计由曾参与过C-Type设计的马尔科姆·塞耶完成，

并在车厂车队的赛车上专门安装了鲨鱼鳍翼片，以强化
高速行驶时的稳定性表现。

D-Type在1954年首次参加勒芒耐力赛时因故退赛，但在1955年王
者归来，取得了三连冠。

这款传奇之车仅仅生产了68辆，其中又属车厂车队的那
几台最受热捧。

entries.en:
The E-type Coupe, which made its debut in 1961, had a huge
influence on sports car design.

The engine, in the car's nose, was based on the same straight-six
engine that won Le Mans five times in the C-Type and D-Type.

Although known in the wide world as the E-type, in
North America it was often called the "XK-E”.

The beautiful body, which evolved from the D-Type sports
racer, was designed by Malcolm Sayer,

who is known as an early proponent of
aerodynamic design for automobiles.

The E-Type remained in production for 14 years, and though it
evolved to comply with later safety and emission laws,

it remained instantly recognizable to everyone.

Although Jaguar didn’t have a factory race program
for the E-Type in motorsports,

it did build a “low-drag” coupe and a series of 12 lightweight
E-Types that were raced on both sides of the Atlantic.

Although famous for its good looks, the Jaguar E-Type
is also a seriously fast sports car.
entries.zh:
E-type轿跑于1961年首次亮相，对跑车设计产生了巨大的影响。

长长的车头下安装的直列六缸引擎基于曾五次赢得勒芒
赛冠军的C-Type和D-Type所使用的引擎打造。

虽然在世界范围内被称为E-type，但在北美，它通常被称为
“XK-E”。

E-type美丽的车身曲线，从D-Type赛车演变而来，
其设计者是马尔科姆·塞耶，

他也被视为是汽车空气动力学设计的早期倡导者。

E-type持续生产了14年，尽管不断改进以符合后来的安全和
排放法律，

但经典的外观设计依然让人一望便知。

虽然捷豹没有为E-Type设立厂队参加比赛，

但他们确实制造了一辆“低阻力”双门跑车和12辆轻量
型号E-Type，用于在大西洋两岸参加比赛。

尽管捷豹E-Type以其优美的外观而闻名，但也是一辆速度极快
的跑车。

entries.en:
This CLK-LM is one of the most attractive race cars
produced by Mercedes-Benz.

It only competed for a few years in the late 1990s, racing in
GT1, which was then the pinnacle of Touring Car competition.

GT1-class regulations required an automaker to build only
one street car to be approved for competition.

Despite their appearance, these street cars
were in fact full-on race machines.

The CLK-LM's predecessor, the CLK-GTR, was produced
in accordance to these regulations in 1997.

When the FIA GT World Championships began that same year,
the CLK-GTR took home the title.

This CLK-LM was a further evolution of the CLK-GTR.

The replacement of the V-12 engine with a V-8 improved the
race car's overall balance.

As soon as it took to the track in the '98 FIA-GT Championships,
it absolutely dominated the competition.

That year, it took home both Drivers' and Manufacturers'
championships.�
entries.zh:
这辆CLK-LM是梅赛德斯-奔驰生产过的
最诱人的赛车之一。

它只在90年代后半期参加了几年的GT1比赛，
随后就是房车比赛的巅峰时期。

GT1级别的规则只要求汽车制造商制造一辆公路车
就能获准参加比赛。

尽管外观如此，为此生产的公路车
核心却是一辆成熟的赛车。

CLK-LM的前身CLK-GTR也是出于同一目的
而于1997年生产的。

当国际汽联GT世界锦标赛于同年开始举办时，
CLK-GTR在出战便获得了冠军头衔。

CLK-LM可以视为CLK-GTR的进化版本，

用V8引擎取代V12引擎带来了
车辆的整体平衡性的改善。

使CLK-LM在1998年国际汽联-GT锦标赛中
一亮相就掀起了夺冠狂潮……

并且赢得了当年GT1赛事的
车手和制造商双料冠军。

entries.en:
I know what you're thinking: a DB3 road car doesn't exist.

The DB2 was followed by the DB2/4, the DB2/4 Mk II,
the Mark III, and then the DB4.

If that's what you're thinking, then you certainly know
your Aston Martins!

There was, however, a DB3 race car.

It was introduced in 1951, and, unfortunately,
saw limited success.

This DB3S is an upgraded version
that was released in 1953.

It's well known as a true masterpiece.

Its beefed-up inline-6 engine powered it to numerous
victories in some of the UK's most famous races.

This particular example, chassis number 1...

...is the car that took home the Gran Turismo Trophy
at the Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance in 2013.
entries.zh:
我知道您是怎么想的：DB3公路版并不存在。

紧随DB2之后推出的是DB2/4、DB2/4 Mk II、
Mark III，然后是DB4。

如果您这么想，我得承认您确实够了解阿斯顿马丁！

但事实上，曾经有过一辆DB3的赛道版。

该车型于1951年首次亮相，但遗憾地
没有激起太大的反响。

而这台DB3S则是1953年发布的升级版。

它被公认为是真正的杰作！

它由一台强化后的直列六缸引擎提供动力，
在英国最有名的赛事当中屡屡夺魁。

没错，这辆底盘编号为1的DB3S……

正是2013年在圆石滩经典车展捧起GT奖杯的那一辆。

entries.en:
This 300 SEL 6.8 AMG should be seen as an important part of
AMG's success story.

AMG started as a company that built competition vehicles
based on Mercedes-Benz cars.

It was established by former Daimler-Benz engineer
Hans Werner Aufrecht...

...and Erhard Melcher.

The name of the brand comes from the combination of
“A” for Aufrecht, “M” for Melcher...

...and “G” for Grossaspach, the hometown of Aufrecht.

The 300 SEL 6.8 AMG competed in the 24 Hours of Spa
in 1971, where it won its class and finished 2nd overall.

This result which really put AMG on the map.

Mercedes-Benz owners flocked to AMG
to have their cars tuned by the company.

AMG’s fame spread from there, becoming a wholly-owned
subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz in 2005.�
entries.zh:
300 SEL 6.8 AMG是AMG的
成功发展史上一辆重要的赛车。

AMG公司起初生产用由
梅赛德斯-奔驰汽车改装的赛车。

公司由戴姆勒-奔驰前工程师
汉斯-维尔纳·奥弗莱希特……

和埃哈德·梅尔赫创办。

品牌名称中的A代表奥弗莱希特，M代表梅尔赫……

G代表格罗萨斯帕赫，也就是奥弗莱希特的故乡。

这款车型参加了1971年斯帕24小时耐力赛，
赢得了所在级别的头名和全场亚军。

这一胜举让AMG吸引了所有人的注意……

梅赛德斯-奔驰的车主们涌向AMG公司，
希望他们能对自己的车也施展一番调校魔法。

AMG在随后的比赛中继续积累声誉，
最终于2005年成为梅赛德斯-奔驰的全资子公司。�

entries.en:
Giorgetto Giugiaro is a legend in the world of car design.

He's worked on so many great cars, it would be hard to pick
just one to define him.

But if I had to choose...

...I'd go for the De Tomaso Mangusta, a car he designed
while working for Carrozzeria Ghia.

The Mangusta looks more striking than many of Giugiaro's
later designs.

There's something elegant about its sleek lines. It’s a simple
design, and yet it's glamorous and muscular, too.

The Mangusta bowed in 1966, and only 400 were produced.
It's powered by a Ford overhead valve V-8.

These days they're highly sought-after as early examples
of Giugiaro's genius.
entries.zh:
乔盖托·乔治亚罗是汽车设计界的传奇人物。

他曾参与过许多伟大汽车的设计，因此很难只用一款车
来定义他的设计风格。

但如果一定要选的话……

我会选择这台德托马索Mangusta，
这是他在为车身制造公司吉亚工作时设计的车。

与亚罗后来的诸多设计相比，Mangusta感觉更抓人眼球。

其流畅顺滑的线条带着几分优雅……设计虽简单，但却
魅力四射，充满力量感。

Mangusta在1966年首次亮相，搭载福特顶置气门V8引擎，
总共只生产了400辆。

如今，这一车型作为亚罗天才设计的早期范例而备受收藏
者追捧。

entries.en:
Jeep is surely one of the world's most familiar and
beloved brands, especially to off-road enthusiasts.

The company has a long and storied history...

...but there's no doubt this Willys MB (Military, Model B)
was one of its greatest successes.

Interestingly, Willys didn't actually come up with
the name "Jeep."

It was the brainchild of the American Bantam Car Company’s
prototype utility vehicle for the military.

This car was designated “GP” for general purpose,
which sounds like "Jeep."

After World War II, the company decided to focus on
mass-producing Jeeps and trademarked the name.

The company’s "civilian jeeps" were based on the classic
Willys MB.

It had developed a good reputation during the war and was
initially marketed for use in agriculture.

The company also began worldwide production under license,
which meant that anyone could produce a Jeep.

This would prove to be an absolutely decisive factor in the
growth of the Jeep brand we kn�w and love today.
entries.zh:
Jeep无疑是世界上知名度最高
且最受喜爱的品牌之一。

该公司拥有丰富且悠久的历史……

但毫无疑问，这辆威利斯MB（军用型Model B）
是其最成功的作品之一。

有趣的是，威利斯公司起初用的
并不是“Jeep”这个名字。

相反，Jeep的名号衍生自美国班塔姆
汽车公司生产的军用多功能原型车。

这款车的设计“GP”为多用途，
而“Jeep”正是这一缩写的发音。

在第二次世界大战之后，公司决定专注于
大规模生产Jeep车型，于是为Jeep注册了商标。

这些“民用吉普”都是基于经典的威利斯MB而来。

得益于战争时期积累了良好的声誉，Jeep的销售最初主要
面向农业生产者。

公司在全球范围内授权生产后，
世界各地都能生产受人喜爱的Jeep。

这一授权策略对Jeep发展成为今天这个我们所知和所热爱
的品牌起到了决定性的作用。

entries.en:
The Maserati Merak is a fine example of a
beautiful mid-engine supercar from the 1970s.

It was designed by Giorgetto Giugiaro, who
began at FIAT in 1955, then worked at...

...Bertone for six years, and later at Ghia until 1968.

He subsequently established "Italdesign," a design firm
that would create many masterpieces.

The Maserati Merak was created during
Giugiaro’s early Italdesign days.

This stunning new Maserati was introduced at
the 1972 Paris Motor Show.

The Merak SS is the lighter and more
powerful model that made its debut in 1975.

This 1980 model is powered by a 220ps version
of the V-6 shared with the Citroën-Maserati SM.

Although the striking Merak has a mid-mounted
engine, it is actually a 2+2 with small rear seats...

...which is very rare for an exotic high-performance car.
entries.zh:
玛莎拉蒂Merak堪称二十世纪七十年代最优美
的中置引擎超级跑车的样板之一。

它的设计出自乔盖托·乔治亚罗之手。
1955年，乔治亚罗在菲亚特开始职业生涯，

随后又在博通工作了六年，
然后重回吉亚，继续工作到了1968年。

此后，他自己创办了“Italdesign”，一间在未来
奉献出无数杰作的设计公司。

玛莎拉蒂Merak就是乔治亚罗在“Italdesign”的
早期设计作品之一……

这辆光采夺目的全新玛莎拉蒂在1972年的巴黎车展上
完成了首秀。

在1975年，更加轻量化、性能更强的Merak SS闪亮登场。

我们眼前的这辆1980车型装备了一台输出220ps的V6引擎，
这台引擎也被用在了雪铁龙-玛莎拉蒂SM上。

这辆令人惊叹的Merak采用了中置引擎，却实现了“2+2”座位布局，
只是后排座位偏小……

对于一辆面向专业玩家的高性能跑车而言，实属罕见。�

entries.en:
The Aston Martin DB5 is truly a rare gem, both in terms
of price and its head-turning allure.

And we all know who's responsible for that, don’t we?

That's right, Bond. James Bond, from the hugely popular
British-born 007 movie series.

The DB5 which appeared in "Goldfinger" in 1964 was probably
the most famous car in the world at the time.

Aston Martin recently responded to huge public demand for
these "Bond Edition" DB5s by producing 25 replicas.

These replicas built in late 2020 and 2021 sold for
a huge sum upwards of $3.75M each.

I can't begin to imagine what
the original car would fetch,

 although one of two cars built in 1965 to promote the film
sold for $6.4 million in 2019!
entries.zh:
阿斯顿马丁DB5是真正的极品，无论就价格，还是其无与伦比的
吸引力而言，都是如此。

我们都知道这要归功于谁，不是吗？

没错，就是邦德，詹姆斯·邦德，广受欢迎的英国007电
影主角。

1964年登场于《金手指》电影中的DB5可能是当时全球最知
名的汽车。

最近，为了响应了大众对“邦德版”DB5的巨大需求，
阿斯顿马丁特别生产了25辆复刻版。

这些复刻版制造于2020年底至2021年，每辆都卖出了375万美元的天价。

我实在想象不出，如果是原版车的话，能卖到多少钱！

不过可以参考的是，1965年生产的两台电影推广样车之一
于2019年被卖到了640万美元

entries.en:
The 917K is one of the most important race cars
in Porsche's history.

It was developed from the long-tailed 917LH which made its debut
in 1969.

Under its hood was a few different engines depending on the car,
from a 4.5-liter, 4.9-liter and a 5.0-liter air-cooled flat-12.

Fast and ferocious on the track, the 917K delivered
Porsche its first overall victory at Le Mans.

Although Porsche didn't have a works team, the 917K still won
7 of 10 races in the International Championship for Makes.

Even better, it would also go on to win the 24 Hours
of Le Mans that year, and again in 1971.

Porsche's golden era began with the 917K, making it one of
the most significant models in motorsports history.
entries.zh:
917K是保时捷历史上最重要的赛车之一。

该车基于1969年生产的长尾款917LH研发而来……

可配备多款不同引擎，包括4.5升、4.9升，
或是5升风冷水平对置12缸引擎。

速度极快，在赛道上悍勇无双的917K，赢来了
保时捷在勒芒赛场上首个总冠军。

在1970年，917K赢下国际制造商锦标赛
十场赛事中的七场……

并摘得了勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军，紧接着
又在1971年卫冕成功。

可以说，保时捷的黄金年代
正是由917K揭幕的。

entries.en:
The world of motorsports is known for its
extremely competitive development,

which makes Porsche's achievements during the 1980s
truly miraculous.

Porsche won at Le Mans in 1982 and 1983 with their 956,

and the updated Porsche 956 went on to win 2 more
Le Mans races.

The Porsche 962 series is a race car that is directly linked to
the legendary 956 series,

and the Porsche 962C won at Le Mans in 1986 and 1987,

contributing to the last 2 of the 7 consecutive Le Mans
victories by Porsche that started in 1981.

The 962C remains a potent piece of machinery to this day.
Are you ready to harness the power of this legendary Porsche?
entries.zh:
赛车运动的世界以竞争极其激烈的开发而著称，

这也使得保时捷在上世纪80年代的成就显得犹如神迹一般。

保时捷在1982年和1983年连续使用956赛车赢下勒芒冠军，

紧接着，改进后的956又再夺两冠。

保时捷962系列是传奇的956的正统继承者，

系列中的962C于1986和1987年再次赢得勒芒冠军，

也是自1981年以来保时捷勒芒七连冠的最后两座奖杯的功臣。

962C的车况保存良好至今。
您准备好驾驭这辆传奇保时捷的强劲动力了吗？

entries.en:
It's a well-known fact that Porsche’s first production car
started with the rear-engine Porsche 356.

Full production of the 356 series began in 1950...

...and the coupe model was soon followed by
open-top versions.

All of these models shared a boxed sheet metal
chassis with independent suspension.

And the flat-4 engine was available in five
different displacements and output.

A slightly modified 356A appeared in 1955.

In 1956, a high performance 1.5-liter engine developed for
the 550 Spyder was offered as an option.

Models equipped with the powerful 1.5-liter engine
were called the GS Carrera.

They are known to have been cars that could immediately
be raced as is.

This model is a GS Carrera GT, characterized by
a lighter body and powerful engine.

These cars are collectibles that rarely change hands,
so don't miss your chance to drive it!�
entries.zh:
众所周知，保时捷的第一辆量产车
是引擎后置的保时捷356。

356系列的全面生产始于1950年……

继双门硬顶版本之后很快推出了敞篷版。

所有车型都适配了搭载独立悬挂的箱形金属底盘，

水平对置四缸引擎则有五种不同的排量和动力输出可选。

小改款356A于1955年推出，

到了1956年，专为550 Spyder设计开发的
高性能1.5升引擎正式登场。

配备了强大的1.5升引擎的车型被称为GS Carrera。

它们的特点在于可以随时下场参加比赛。

这台车型为GS GT Carrera，配备了
更轻的车身和更强大的引擎。

是相当罕见的Speedster款，几乎未曾易手，
您绝不会想错过亲手驾驭这款车的机会！�

entries.en:
What do you call a street-legal Porsche 911 that shoots from
zero to <100km/h> in 3.7 secs, and tops out at <310km/h>?

Why, the Porsche 911 GT1 Strassenversion of course!

Developed to meet competition rules for the Le Mans
GT1 Class, only 25 cars were ever sold.

The production car it was based on was
pretty much a race car to begin with.

From its nose to its front suspension, the Porsche 911 GT1
Strassenversion looks like a type 993 911.

But behind the seats you’ll see lots of parts reminiscent of
the Porsche 962 that competed at Le Mans in the 1980s.

The engine is a fire-breathing twin-turbocharged
3.2-liter flat-6.

A chance to own this car rarely comes around.
And this is your chance.
entries.zh:
曾经有一台可以合法上路的保时捷911，能在3.7秒内从零加速
至100km，极速高达<310km/h>，它的名字是？

没错，它就是保时捷911 GT1 Strassenversion。

专为满足勒芒GT1级别赛事要求而打造，
仅发售了25辆。

它所基于的量产车从一开始
就几乎是一辆赛车。

从车头到前悬架部分，保时捷911 GT1 Strassenversion
看起来就像993型号的保时捷911，

但座椅后面的很多部件则让人想起
80年代征战勒芒的保时捷962。

动力部分采用3.2升双涡轮增压的
水平对置六缸引擎。

拥有这辆车的机会很少登门，机不可失哦。

entries.en: Buddy_ContentCar_Hagerty_normal_mercedes_amg_gt_r_17_1030379
entries.zh: Buddy_ContentCar_Hagerty_normal_mercedes_amg_gt_r_17_1030379

entries.en:
If classic cars are your thing, then you're bound to
recognize this S-Type Mercedes right away.

It won "Best of Show" at the 2017
Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance.

And it's known as Mercedes-Benz's first sports car. Called
the S-Type, it was designed by Dr. Ferdinand Porsche.

The body was constructed by Barker & Co., a coachbuilder
best known for its work on Rolls-Royce cars.

The car's distinctive rear end is commonly referred to as
a "boat tail."

No one quite made them like Barker & Co.

This S-Type was commissioned by Earl Howe, a co-founder
of the British Racing Driver's Club.

Not only is this car a priceless gem, it takes
a certain amount of grace drive it!
entries.zh:
如果经典老爷车是您的菜，那您一定认得
这台看起来动力十足的S型梅赛德斯。

毕竟，她在2017年圆石滩经典车展中
可是赢得了“最佳巡展”奖。

被誉为梅赛德斯-奔驰的第一款运动车型的“S”系列
由费迪南德·保时捷博士设计……

并由因与劳斯莱斯合作而名声大噪
的巴克公司提供的车身。

这辆车独树一帜的车尾造型被称为“船尾”

正是由巴克一手打造的。

此车是由英国赛车手俱乐部的联合创始人
豪威伯爵委托制造的。

这样一台特立独行，举世无双的珍品，
惟有风度和气度俱佳的驾驶者才配得上它！

entries.en:
The Type W194 300SL is one of the more notable Mercedes-Benz
machines from the Golden Age of racing of the 1950s.

A champion at Le Mans and the Carrera Panamericana, the car
is also known for inspiring the iconic 300SL Coupe.

Designed by Rudolf Uhlenhaut, a legendary engineer with a
vast amount of experience in race car design...

...the Mercedes-Benz W194 300SL boasted the latest
in the race technology of its day.

It featured a spaceframe chassis, an independent suspension
and a single-overhead camshaft inline-6.

Only ten were believed to have been built.

Thanks to its excellent performance and reliability, the car
shone in endurance races.

This car, chassis number 007/52, is the car
that won Le Mans.

If a W194 were to hit the market now, the price
would surely be astronomical.�
entries.zh:
诞生于20世纪50年代的W194 300SL
是梅赛德斯旗下的传奇赛车。

在勒芒和Carrera泛美拉力赛取胜以后，
它又因为启发了经典的300SL轿跑而名声大噪。

W194 300SL由梅赛德斯工程师
鲁道夫·乌伦豪特设计……

他是一位具有丰富赛车设计经验的传奇工程师。

其空间框架底盘上装配了独立悬挂
以及顶置单凸轮轴直列六缸引擎。

据称该车总计只生产了10辆。

归功于其良好的抓地力性能和可靠性，它曾与许多
顶尖赛车一决高下，留下多场令人难忘的比赛。

底盘编号为007/52的这辆赛车是勒芒冠军之车。

如果传出W194待售的消息，只怕会
堆出一个个天文数字的报价来。@

entries.en:
On the outside, the Porsche GS Carrera looks no different
from other 356 coupes of its day,

 but what makes this GS Carrera so special
and raises its value,

is the four-cam 1.5L engine that produces 100ps.

This engine was the most powerful version
available for the 356 series at the time.

It was also possible to order lighter speedster seats,
and even without heaters to reduce weight.

That's why the GS was not just a fast street car,
but was also seen in many races.

I think you'll find that it's directly linked to
Porsche's illustrious past!
entries.zh:
从外观上看，保时捷GS Carrera和当时的其他356轿跑
并无二致，

但令GS Carrera如此独特而价值不菲的，

是那台能够输出100ps的四凸轮1.5升引擎。

这款引擎代表了当时356车系的最强动力版本。

同时这款车接受定制轻量化的speedster座椅，甚至为了减重拆
除了加热系统。

也因此，GS不仅是一辆够快的街车，更是许多赛事的常客。

看着它的光辉履历您就会发现，这辆车与保时捷辉煌的过去
密不可分！

entries.en:
The first model of the Nissan Z series was known
as the type S30.

Of all the S30s, this Z432 is particularly special.

With a classic Z-series design...

It is powered by the same S20 2L inline six-cylinder
engine seen in the Skyline GT-Rs of its day.

The four valves per cylinder...

Three carburettors...

And two cams don’t just prove its high performance.

These numbers are also the origin of the 'Z432'
model name.

The fact that it had a GT-R engine was reflected in its
price, more than double that of standard S30s.

Furthermore, only 419 of the Z432s were produced,
making it the most valuable of the first-gen Zs.

There was also a higher performance competition model
of the Z432, the Z432R.

An extremely rare variant, it tends to fetch a very
handsome price at auctions.�
