entries.zh:
日产Z系列的第一款车型被称为type S30。

在所有S30车型中，Z432显得格外耀眼。

在保留了Z系列经典设计的同时……

它搭载了当时同样用于Skyline GT-R的
S20 2升直列六缸引擎。

这款引擎每个气缸有4个阀门……

3个化油器……

和2个凸轮，足以保证它的高性能。

这些数字也是“Z432”车型名称的来源。

配备GT-R同款高性能引擎的代价反映在其售价上，
它的定价是标准S30的两倍以上。

此外，Z432只生产了419辆，
使其成为所有第一代Z系列中最有价值的车型。

Z432还推出过一款性能更出色的竞赛版，
即Z432R。

其存世量极少，当它出现在拍卖会上时
往往能拍出相当可观的价格。

entries.en:
Did you know that the first car to ever be wear the Porsche
badge was a mid-engine convertible?

It was the 356/1 prototype from 1948.

The company was no doubt intrigued with
mid-engine layouts from the get-go.

The 550 Spyder, introduced in 1953, was another
mid-engine sports car from Porsche.

The 550/1500RS was a variant that went on the market
at the end of 1954.

This specific 550/1500RS, with its blue body and white
triangular stripes, has a serial number 0067.

It's the only 550 still wearing the same finish
that came from the factory.

And that makes it a priceless treasure.
entries.zh:
您知道第一辆冠以保时捷名字的汽车是中置引擎的敞篷吗？

具体来说，那是一台1948年制造的356/1原型车。

我猜，保时捷对中置引擎跑车的偏爱由来已久。

1953年推出的550 Spyder再一次证明了这种偏爱。

550/1500RS量产型于1954年底首次亮相发售。

这一辆550/1500RS拥有蓝色车身和白色条纹涂装，生产编号为0067。

它是目前唯一一辆仍然保持出厂涂装的550，

可以说是价值连城。

entries.en:
There are countless stories to tell about the Porsche 911, but
the 911 Turbo S Leichtbau is an exceptionally rare model.

“Leichtbau,” meaning “lightweight” in German,
was produced in a limited run of 86 cars.

It celebrated Porsche’s success in the IMSA championship.

The car was based on the third-generation 911 Type 964 Turbo
and used the same 3.3-liter engine as the previous model.

However, in the Leichtbau, the flat-6 was tuned to 381ps.

Inside, most luxuries were stripped away,
along with the rear seats.

This reduced its curb weight to just 1290kg, a figure that gave
true meaning to the Leichtbau name.

Weight savings were achieved not only through reduction.

Aluminum doors with thinner glass and a carbon-fiber hood
further refined the car’s purpose.

Externally, the rear-fender air intakes distinguished
the Leichtbau from base 911s.

And, the large rear spoiler stood as a unique carbon element.

The driving experience was nothing s�ort of exquisite, reminding
us that the finest sports cars are often defined by lightness.
entries.zh:
关于保时捷911的传奇故事数不胜数，但即便在911系列中，
这款911 Turbo S Leichtbau也是特别罕见的车型。

“Leichtbau”在德语中意为“轻量化”，
此车是为庆祝保时捷在国际汽车运动协会跑车锦标赛中夺冠，

而限量打造了86台。

它基于第三代911 Type 964 Turbo开发，
并沿用了前代车型的3.3升引擎。

但在Leichtbau上，这台经过特别调校的引擎
可爆发出381ps的强劲动力。

不仅如此，车内一切豪华内饰连同后排座椅均被拆除。

这让整车重量被控制在区区的1290kg，
这正是其得名“Leichtbau”的由来。

当然，减重之道不止于拆减配件。

它配备了玻璃更薄的铝制车门，
引擎盖也换成了碳纤维材质。

外观上，后轮翼子板上的进气口是
Leichtbau车型的标志性特征。

此外，此车专属的碳纤维部件还有一块超大后扰流板。

这辆车的驾驶感毫无�*问极为出众。
它完美印证了跑车轻量化的意义。�

entries.en:
The Nismo 400R was long considered the ultimate GT-R.

 The car is based on the Skyline GT-R, but you won't find
the name "Skyline" or "GT-R" anywhere on the body.

From the engine to the body to the chassis, this limited-edition model
was extensively tuned by Nismo, Nissan's motorsports division.

And they named it simply the "400R."

Perhaps that's why this car isn't talked about
as much as other legendary Skyline GT-R models.

This is a culmination of the Nissan works team's knowledge gained at Le Mans,
coming in the form of increased displacement engine,

a reinforced suspension and clutch,
as well as the extensive use of carbon fiber, notably in the prop shafts.

At the time the 400R was being planned, Japanese automakers had a
self-imposed limit of 280 horsepower for their road cars.

As its name suggests, the 400R had a bit more, with 400.

It also had a price tag to match, costing three times as much
as a new R33 model Skyline GT-R.

One of the most ex�ensive Japanese-made cars at the time, Nissan
claims to have built only 44 of them.

Because of its rarity, it has become one of the most
difficult Skyline GT-R models to find.
entries.zh:
NISMO 400R是GT-R产品谱系的终极形态。

虽然同样基于Skyline GT-R打造，
但车型中并未带有“Skyline”或“GT-R”的字样。

从引擎到空气动力学设计、再到底盘，这款限量型号的每一处
都由日产的赛车部门NISMO进行了精心调校……

并给予了它“400R”这个朴实无华的型号名。

这或许就是它不如其他Skyline GT-R
传奇型号那般口口相传的原因。

但有一说一，从定制的加大排量引擎
到强化后的悬挂和离合器……

再到碳纤维材料的大量使用，特别是传动轴，这台限量款
可谓是日产从勒芒取得的赛车经验和知识的集大成之作。

在400R的设计规划阶段，日本的汽车制造行业
规定公路车的动力不能高于280马力。

不过顾名思义，400R拥有400马力的性能。

当然，它的价格也充分说明了什么叫一分钱一分货，
贵到可以买下3台全新的Skyline GT-R R33。

400R�#�当时最昂贵的日本汽车之一，
而且日产宣称总共只生产了44辆400R。

由于产量稀少，现如今，它已经是最难找到的Skyline GT-R了。/

entries.en:
The Celica is one of Toyota's most popular two-door coupes
but it is also known for its long career in rallying,

particularly when Group A cars became the main competitors
in the 1987 World Rally Championship.

Toyota introduced the GT-Four which was basically a rally-
prepared model of the base production Celica.

The GT-Four model was available across three generations, with
works cars and those with race history the most valuable.

This particular Group A rally machine is a 3rd generation,
GT-Four developed from the ST205 Celica.

As was essential in the golden years of Groupe A, it's four-
wheel-drive and is fitted with a turbo anti-lag system.

The Toyota works team began competing with this car
for the 1995 season of the WRC,

However, in the penultimate round, the car was
found to have illegal turbo restrictors.

The resulting penalties stripped the drivers of points and
the works team was banned from the WRC for one year.

You could say it's a car with h�story.

For rally fans, the combination of the classic Castrol livery and
the aggressive design makes this an all-time Group A classic.0
entries.zh:
赛利卡是丰田最流行的双门跑车，同时也是
一款长年征战拉力赛的车型。

特别是当A组别赛车在1987年世界拉力锦标赛中
站到了舞台中央的那段时间。

丰田顺势推出了GT-Four，可以被视作基于
量产版赛利卡的拉力赛版本。

GT-Four持续销售了三代，其中不仅有官方车队用车，
也诞生出了赛车史上的名车。

眼前这辆A组别拉力赛车是第3代，
是一辆基于ST205赛利卡开发的GT-Four，

在那个A组别的黄金时代，它也毫不例外地
配置了四轮驱动和偏时点火系统。

丰田车厂车队在1995赛季将此车投入使用。

然而，在倒数第二轮比赛时，赛会发现车上
安装的涡轮限制器不合规。

这次重大违规导致车手们的积分被清零，
车厂车队则遭到禁赛一年。

所以说，这是一辆“有故事”的车。

对于拉力赛车迷而言，经典的Castrol涂装与充满攻击性
的造^��组合在一起，使其成为了一辆跨越时间的A组别经典。

entries.en:
The Chevrolet Corvette is undoubtedly one of the world’s
most famous sports cars.

When it made its debut in 1953...

...it quickly became known as "America's sport car"
because no other car like it existed in the U.S.

The car was noted for its attractive body style
and powerful engine.

The original 1953 were built mostly by hand,
and only a 300 units were produced.

Still, they were incredibly popular, and the next year,
General Motors increased production of the car.

This 1958 model exhibits a thoroughly new design
with four headlights.
entries.zh:
雪佛兰科尔维特无疑是世界上最久负盛名的跑车之一。

在1953年首次亮相时，

当时的美国并没有真正意义上的跑车，

所以它就被大家叫成了“美国的跑车”。

53年的雪佛兰大多是手工制造的。
而且，只生产了300个。

尽管如此，它们还是非常受欢迎，第二年，
通用汽车改进了其生产系统。

这个1958年的模型配置了四个车头灯，
展示了一个全新的设计。

entries.en:
This Maserati A6GCS Spider was
bodied by the small Italian Carrozzeria, of Medardo Fantuzzi.

A Modest production run of the beautiful Fantuzzi spiders were
built on the A6GCS chassis.

Like most of the competition bodies from the Bolognese
coachbuilder, the Maserati displayed a functional beauty.

That same beauty was true of the stunning Maserati 250F
and sharknose Ferrari 156 Formula 1 cars,

 and dozens of other Maserati and Ferrari sports racing cars.

The A6GCS featured a twin cam straight-six mounted up front that
was designed by the famed Italian engineer, Gioacchino Colombo.

Fitted with three twin throat Weber Carburetors, the
1985cc engine had a maximum output of 170ps.

This car, chassis 2078 has a fantastic history.

Built as a works racing car, it was assigned to the
great Luigi Musso for the 1954 season.

Musso contested ten races in 1954, and came away with three
overall wins and five class victories,

becoming the Italian 2000cc champion.�p/>
A6GCS 2078 was sold to Argentina, where it was raced with mixed
results in 1955. It returned to Italy in 1986.

This car won the Gran Turismo Trophy at the
2014 Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance.�
entries.zh:
玛莎拉蒂A6GCS Spider的车身是意大利
小型车身制造商梅达多·凡图奇的杰作。

这款出自凡图奇之手的Spider车型精美绝伦，
基于A6GCS底盘打造，只进行了小批量生产。

和这家博洛尼亚车身制造商所推出的大部分赛车车身一样，
这辆玛莎拉蒂也兼顾了功能性和美观性。

你可以在摄人心魄的玛莎拉蒂250F、
鲨鱼鼻造型的法拉利156方程式1赛车……

以及数十款玛莎拉蒂和法拉利跑车身上
找到这份绝无仅有的审美语言。

这辆A6GCS在车前部安装了由知名意大利工程师乔亚基诺·科伦坡
所设计的双凸轮轴直列六缸引擎。

这款引擎配备了三部双腔沃柏化油器，
排量高达1985cc，可以输出最高170ps的动力。

这辆底盘号为2078的车有着辉煌的战史。

它是一台玛莎拉蒂厂队赛车，
并由杰出车手路易吉·穆索驾驶，出战1954赛季。

穆索驾驶着这辆赛车^��1954年参加了十场比赛，就带回了
三个总冠军和五个组别冠军，

成为了意大利2000cc级别毫无争议的冠军。

1955年，A6GCS 2078被卖到了阿根廷。但比赛成绩起伏不定。
直到1986年，它才又重返意大利的怀抱。

此外，这辆车还在2014年的圆石滩经典车展上
赢得了GT奖杯。�

entries.en:
Introduced in 1964, the Pontiac GTO is considered
one of the first American muscle cars.

In a series of one-upmanship by various manufacturers, the GTO's
performance was soon eclipsed by the competition.

In response, Pontiac created a new high-performance
model called "The Judge."

It came equipped with a powerful 6.6-liter V-8.

It also boasted wide tires, a rear spoiler and distinctive livery
that gave the car an extremely powerful presence.

Because of The Judge, the Pontiac GTO retained its rightful
place at the top of the muscle-car heap.
entries.zh:
被视为美式肌肉车的先驱之一的
庞蒂亚克GTO于1964年推出。

但没过多久，强大竞争对手就将它的表现掩盖。

作为回应，庞蒂亚克将希望寄托在一款
新的高性能版本，“The Judge”。

除了性能卓越的6.6升V8引擎外……

其外观也在独特的贴花，宽轮胎、后扰流板与
其他装饰的加持下显得霸气。

多亏了“The Judge”的存在，庞蒂亚克GTO才能维持
其在肌肉车领域其应有的领导地位。

entries.en:
The Lancia Rally 037 is one of the iconic Group B
rally cars of the 1980s.

Introduced in the early years of Group B racing, it combined
a mid-engine layout with a rear-wheel drive.

Its spaceframe chassis and powerful mid-mounted engine...

...was reminiscent of Lancia's iconic Stratos rally car.

While 4-wheel drive would become mainstream starting
with the Audi quattro in 1981...

...the rear-wheel-drive Rally 037 claimed the 1983
season series title, besting the competition.

This Evoluzione II was the final spec of the car, which
came equipped with a 2.1-liter powerplant.
entries.zh:
蓝旗亚Rally 037是1980年代B组别拉力赛的
标志性参赛车型之一。

这台结合了中置引擎和后轮驱动布局的拉力车很早就开
始参加B组别比赛。

其空间框架底盘和中置引擎...

让人不禁回想起蓝旗亚标志性的Stratos。

当1981年奥迪quattro的出现带动四轮驱动
成为拉力赛车主流后，

Rally 037仍然顽强地用两轮驱动为蓝旗亚
带来了1983赛季的冠军，尽管是两轮驱动汽车。

这款名为Evoluzione II，是Rally 037的最终规格，
排量提高到了2.1升，冷却系统也得到了改进。

entries.en:
It's hard to believe that a Le Mans prototype
also competed in rallies.

Well, it really did happen.

Let me introduce you to the Alpine A220.

It's a successor to the Alpine M Series, which performed well
at Le Mans in the 1960s.

It features a mid-mounted 3L V8 engine designed by Gordini...

but unfortunately it never made much of a mark at Le Mans.

However it would go on to compete in the world of rallying
which was a fairly unique challenge for such a car.

This specific car has a dramatically shortened tail for rallying
which makes it especially rare.
entries.zh:
一辆勒芒原型车也能参加拉力赛，是不是很难以置信？

其实，这事确实发生过。

让我向您隆重介绍阿尔派A220吧！

阿尔派A220是1960年代在勒芒比赛中表现极其出色的
阿尔派M系的继任者，

它采用了由戈迪尼设计的中置3升V8引擎……

遗憾的是。它从未在勒芒赛场上取得过什么值得大书特
书的成绩。

但它接下来又出现在拉力赛场上，不得不说，这也是一
个相当独特的成就。

这辆A220因为要投入拉力赛，车尾明显被缩短，这也使它
成为了绝无仅有的存在。

entries.sourceName: DELTA HF Integrale WRC Group A (1992)
entries.en:
Lancia is renowned not only for its refined Italian design spirit
but also for its illustrious motorsport heritage.

The marque has created legendary rally cars including the Fulvia,
Stratos, and the Delta, which dominated Group A racing.

The Delta burst onto the World Rally Championship scene in 1987
claiming 9 victories and ultimately earning the season title.

With each stage of development, the Delta saw
a steady infusion of innovative technology.

And just look at the pronounced blister fenders—don’t they exude
the raw, untamed aggression of a true fighting machine?

Since entering competition in 1992, the HF Integrale
captured 6 consecutive manufacturers’ titles.

A true icon of 1990s rallying, it remains a legend
whose brilliance has never faded.�
entries.zh:
蓝旗亚以优雅的意大利设计而闻名，在赛车运动方面同样
声名显赫。

它打造了Fulvia、Stratos，以及
参加A组别比赛的Delta等伟大的拉力赛车。

Delta在1987年世界拉力锦标赛中惊艳登场，斩获
总计9场胜利，夺得赛季冠军。

随着蓝旗亚的不断研发，创新技术被持续加诸其上。

基于Delta HF Integrale打造的拉力竞速机器

在1992年首次出战世界拉力锦标赛
就创下了连续夺得六届制造商冠军的壮举。

堪称该赛事历史上最伟大的成就之一。

作为90年代拉力赛车的真正标志，
时至今日依然是众人心目中的明星车型。+

entries.en:
The 1973 Skyline GT-R is often considered almost mythical
because of its extremely low production numbers.

It is nicknamed the "Kenmeri GT-R" in reference to the 'Ken
& Mary' commercials used to promote the C110 Skyline.

The base model is the C110 Skyline that debuted in 1972,
the direct successor to the legendary "Hakosuka" GT-R.

The exact model code of Kenmeri GT-R was "KPGC110,"
and sales began in January 1973.

However, the Kenmeri GT-R was only sold
for three months after its debut.

The emissions regulations introduced at the time stopped
the production of high-performance cars like the GT-R.

It is said that only around 200 cars were produced
in the three months it was available.

In order to focus on environmental issues like exhaust
emissions, Nissan also stopped its motorsports activities...

And because of this, not only did this GT-R
have a short lifespan...

It never had a chance to prove itself in racing,
which was an important part of the Skyl�ne mystique.

As a result, this model is considered the unicorn of GT-Rs
and is highly prized by collectors around the world.
entries.zh:
1973年发售的Skyline GT-R由于产量极少，
因此在世人眼前蒙上了一片神秘的面纱。

它的昵称是“Kenmeri GT-R”，源自C110 Skyline
的“Ken&Mary”系列促销广告。

它的基础车型是发布于1972年的C110 Skyline，
传奇车型“Hakosuka” GT-R的直接继承者。

Kenmeri GT-R准确的车型代码是“KPGC110”，
于1973年1月正式面市。

然而，Kenmeri GT-R的销售仅仅持续了
短短三个月就被叫停。

由于当时出台了更加严格的排放法案
限制了GT-R这类高性能车的存在。

据说在三个月的销售时间内，日产只生产了不到200辆新车。

而且为了解决废气排放等环境问题，
日产还停止了赛车方面的活动……

因此，这辆GT-R不只经历了短暂的量产生涯……

也从未有机会在赛车比赛中证明自己的实力，
这也正是这台Skyline的神秘感来源。

因此，这个车型被视作GT-R中的独角兽，
并�
获了全世界的收藏家们的高度评价。�

entries.en:
If you call yourself a racing fan, then you're no doubt
familiar with NASCAR.

Its race machines are loosely based on production cars,
and the series is extremely popular in the U.S.

Established in 1948, NASCAR is a motorsport series
with a lot of history behind it.

Among the more legendary race cars in the history of
NASCAR is the Plymouth Superbird.

Towards the end of the 1960s, NASCAR race cars were starting
to regularly exceed speeds of more than <300km/h>.

The Superbird was based on the Plymouth Road Runner.

Its long nose and large rear wing helped increase stability
at high speeds.

These aerodynamic advantages translated to incredibly
fast lap times that left the competition in the dust.

The brass at NASCAR weren't thrilled in seeing the
lopsided results of the races...

...nor did they want to see race car production costs
skyrocket, making it inaccessible to the masses.

As a result, the Superbird was discontinued after two years.

Regardles�, it's remembered as a legendary muscle car.
entries.zh:
只要是对赛车感兴趣的人，肯定
都听说过美国的纳斯卡赛车系列赛。

这是一项超高速系列赛，使用车辆
均为与量产车型有深厚联系的赛车。

始于1948年，这项汽车赛事的
系列赛背后有着无数精彩的历史。

普利茅斯Superbird是一款
专门为纳斯卡赛车开发的传奇肌肉车。

在20世纪60年代末，纳斯卡赛车的
比赛时速屡屡突破<300km/h>大关。

Superbird的开发是基于普利茅斯路跑的。

它配备了一个长车头与尾部的大尾翼
有助于增加高速时的稳定性。

这些空气动力学优势使它在比赛中创下了
多个出色的单圈时间纪录。

然而，纳斯卡赛车的赛会却对这种
专为比赛而设计的汽车全无好感。

他们担心这会提高赛车成本
而让赛事更加难以接近。

因此，Superbird的生产只持续了两年。

它真的是一款大胆而罕见的美国肌肉车。9

entries.en:
One of the most iconic cars in Honda's history
is this Formula 1 machine, the Honda RA272.

Honda was the first Japanese automaker to
compete in F1 racing.

In 1965, this car earned Honda its first F1 win at the
Mexican Grand Prix in the final round of the season.

With an aluminum monocoque chassis up front
and a space-frame towards the rear...

...it was powered by a horizontal 1.5-liter V-12 mounted amidships.

The RA272 was developed and driven by Richie
Ginther, an American racer of the 1960s.

Honda has since earned many victories as an engine
supplier, and it all began with the RA272.
entries.zh:
本田是第一家参加F1赛事的日本制造商。

其历史上最具有标志性的车型就是
这款F1赛车——本田RA272。

这辆赛车在1965年的最后一站比赛——墨西哥大奖赛
上夺魁，为本田赢得了第一座F1分站赛冠军奖杯。

它的前半部分采用铝制单体车壳底盘，
而后部则采用了空间框架……

并由一部横中置1.5升V12引擎提供动力。

这辆RA272由活跃于1960年代的美国车手
里奇·金瑟尔参与开发以及驾驶。

自那之后，本田作为一家引擎供应商赢得了无数F1胜利，
但一切辉煌都始于这辆RA272。

entries.en:
The Carrera GTS 904 is a shining star in Porsche's
storied motorsports history.

Since the early 1950s, Porsche competed in
international races with the 356.

All the while, the folks there were planning to build
a dedicated GT race car.

Essentially, they needed to build 100 cars in
12 months to qualify for competition.

The result was the Carrera GTS in 1963.

While a plan to use the flat-6 engine developed for
the 911 never bore fruit...

...the car featured a low and lightweight mid-engine
body and specially-designed suspension.

As soon as the car was ready, it was racing all over
the world.

This particular Carrera GTS competed in the second
Japanese Grand Prix, held in 1964.

Its heated yet successful battle against Japan's Skyline is
still talked about by Japanese race fans to this day.�
entries.zh:
Carrera GTS 904是保时捷赛车
运动历史上一颗闪耀的明星。

从20世纪50年代开始，保时捷就将
保时捷356投入到各项国际赛事中。

一直以来，他们都计划
打造一辆专门的超级跑车。

但他们要能满足12个月内生产100辆
以获得对应的参赛资格。

于是Carrera GTS在1963年应运而生。

虽然原计划采用为911开发的
水平对置6缸引擎从未取得任何成果……

其轻盈贴地的玻璃纤维车身、中置引擎
和悬挂等专门设计的部件。

让它刚一发布就惊爆全球。

这辆特别的Carrera GTS参加了
1964年举行的第二届日本大奖赛。

它与日本本土的Skyline展开了激烈厮杀并最终
一举夺魁的场面，至今仍被日本赛车迷津津乐道。*

entries.en:
Produced by French car company,
Citroën, the DS is a timeless masterpiece.

Citroën was founded in 1919 and has consistently been known for
its advanced technology.

In the '30s, Citroën produced unibody front-wheel-drive machines
while most cars had separate frames and rear-wheel-drive.

The Traction Avant, released in 1934,
sold about 750,000 units before production ended.

The DS model that replaced the Traction Avant was introduced
at the 1955 Paris Salon international car show.

Visitors to the show were wowed by the futuristic body
by Italian sculptor and designer Flaminio Bertoni.

The DS was a mid-size 4-door sedan that sported a sharp-looking
front end and sports-car aerodynamics...

...the result of a body that tapers sharply towards the rear.

Also, the car's mechanics, from the
suspension to the brakes to the transmission...

...was controlled by a proprietary hydraulic system.

The DS you see here is a later model
that shows a few evolutiona�y design changes.

It also has adaptive headlights that respond to steering inputs.�
entries.zh:
DS由法国品牌雪铁龙出品，是跨越时间的永恒设计杰作。

雪铁龙最初建于1919年，从其创业早期开始
便以领先的技术而闻名。

在三十年代，当分体式车架和后轮驱动还是主流的时候，
雪铁龙就生产出了前轮驱动加一体化车壳的汽车。

1934年发布的“牵引前卫”在其生产周期内
创下了75万辆的销售纪录。

作为其后继车型，DS发布于1955年的巴黎沙龙国际车展。

意大利雕塑家、设计师弗拉米尼奥·贝托尼执笔设计的
未来主义车身令观展者们震撼不已。

DS是一辆中型四门轿车，但前半部分线条却十分犀利，
拥有与跑车相当的出色空气动力学性能……

后部车身则呈锥形迅速收拢。

此外，此车的每一套系统，从悬挂到刹车，
再到传动系统……

都通过一套专利的液压系统来控制。

我们这里看到的这一辆DS是后期车型，可以从中
看到��些革命性的设计变革。

它还拥有自适应头灯，能随车辆转向而变化
——这是一个超前于时代的点子！�

entries.en:
This is the legendary Mustang equipped with the Boss 429 Ford
race engine.

You may have heard of the 427 "side oiler" engine
used by Ford in the 1960s.

It also powered classic models like the GT40 and the
Shelby 427 Cobra.

This Mustang BOSS 429 engine is the successor to the 427 and
was developed as part of Ford's push into NASCAR.

The street-legal version of the BOSS 429 produced a conservative
375 hp, while the race version pumped out 560 hp.

NASCAR regulations required 500 of these engines to
be mass produced.

After fulfilling NASCAR's homologation requirement, the Mustang
BOSS 429 ended its production run in just two years.
entries.zh:
这是一辆装有Boss 429福特赛车引擎的传奇Mustang。

您可能听说过福特在20世纪60年代使用的427“侧油器”引擎。

它是为GT40和Shelby 427 Cobra等经典车型提供动力的核心。

在历史上，429引擎作为427的后继型号，

是福特为了进入纳斯卡赛车运动而专门开发的。

虽然合法上路版Boss 429的动力输出相对保守，仅有380ps，
而其赛车版本的动力则高达560ps。

纳斯卡赛车参赛条件规定这些引擎必须生产至少500台。

也因此，Mustang Boss 429在满足认证要求后，
在短短两年内就结束了生产。

entries.en:
Have you heard of the "Fuji Grand Champion Race?"
It was a popular motorsports series in Japan in the 1980s.

Those familiar with the event...

...know all about the "Super Silhouette" that
competed in the opening races for those events.

The Super Silhouette races were held
under Group 5 regulations of the day.

While the exteriors of the cars maintained the look of
production models...

...under the sheet metal, they were dedicated race
machines developed for competition.

This Nissan Skyline Super Silhouette was
the most popular car in the series.

Famous for its flaming side exhaust, it serves as an iconic
reminder of a time when racing was fun and wild.
entries.zh:
您听说过“富士大冠军赛”吗？
如果您听说过，

这是20世纪80年代风靡日本的赛事

你可能也听说过参加开幕式比赛的“Super Silhouette”赛车的故事。

“Super Silhouette”比赛采用的是第5组别规则，

参赛车辆虽然保持了量产车的外观，

但内部已经变成了专为比赛开发的纯粹赛车。

我们的这一台叫做日产“Skyline Super Silhouette”，
是系列赛中最受欢迎的车。

因其侧面的排气管会喷出波浪形火焰而闻名全国，
至今仍有许多车迷对这台标志性的名车记忆犹新。

entries.en:
The McLaren MP4/4 Honda was a legendary F1 machine that
proved virtually unbeatable in the 1988 Formula 1 season.

The chassis was developed by Gordon Murray,
the renowned race-car designer.

It came powered with the RA168E turbocharged Honda V-6 engine.

In 1988, Formula 1 regulations changed significantly...

...with strict limits placed on turbo boost pressure
and fuel usage during races.

Honda’s turbocharged engine utilized advanced electronic control
technology, delivering both power and efficiency.

The driver lineup featured two of the sport’s finest:
Alain Prost and Ayrton Senna.

With two legends behind the wheel, the MP4/4 won
an extraordinary 15 of 16 races that season.

Car No. 12 was driven by Ayrton Senna.

In 1988, Senna secured the drivers’ championship,
recording 13 pole positions and eight victories.�
entries.zh:
这辆迈凯伦MP4/4 Honda是一部具有传奇地位的一级方程式赛车，
在1988赛季的一级方程式大奖赛上几乎所向无敌。

它的底盘由知名一级方程式设计师戈登·穆雷所开发……

并由一台本田出品的RA168E涡轮增压V6引擎提供动力。

1988年，一级方程式对引擎规则进行了大幅修改……

严格限制了涡轮增压提高的压力
和比赛中赛车搭载的燃油量。

本田的涡轮增压引擎运用了先进的电子控制技术，
同时兼顾了性能和燃油效率。

不仅如此，当时驾驶这台赛车出战的车手也是高手中的高手：
阿兰·普洛斯特和埃尔顿·塞纳。

在两名一级方程式历史中的传奇车手的驾驭下，
这辆MP4/4在1988年惊人地拿下了16场大奖赛中的15场胜利。

其中车号为12号的MP4/4就是由埃尔顿·塞纳所驾驶。

在1988赛季，塞纳拿下了13次杆位和8个分站冠军，
并最终摘下了车手总�=�军的桂冠。

entries.en:
The 1970 Chevrolet Chevelle SS was Chevrolet's mid-size
muscle car.

The optional LS6 engine provided plenty of performance,
even for a car as big as this.

The 7.4-liter 454 engine was given increased compression,
high-lift cams and special cylinder heads.

Its power rating of 450 HP was likely the highest
catalogued output for any American car at the time.

It was an incredible street machine that could easily surpass
500 HP with very little tuning.
entries.zh:
1970年问世的雪佛兰羚羊SS是雪佛兰的一款
中型肌肉车，

可选装的大排量LS6引擎提供充沛的动力。

雪佛兰将7.4升的排量发动机的压缩，
与高升程凸轮和特制气缸盖配合，

给出了高达456ps的官方数据。这或许是所有美国车中纸面
动力最高的车了。

这是一辆令人难以置信的公路车，只需稍许调校，就能
让功率输出轻松超越500ps。

entries.en:
The Peugeot 205 Turbo 16 is sometimes referred to as the
'ultimate rally car'.

It was originally designed to compete in the World Rally
Championship's legendary Group B category.

Group B regulations were officially implemented in 1983,

and at the time, only 200 of a model were required for
Group B homologation within 12 months.

No commitment to mass production of road versions meant that
manufacturers could make bold decisions on development.

And the choice made by Peugeot,

was to mount a powerful turbocharged engine midship,
combined with 4WD.

At that point, the other teams in Group B hadn’t yet adopted
the configuration, which initially gave Peugeot an advantage.

The Peugeot 205 Turbo 16 made its debut in
the middle of the 1984 season,

and it immediately proved itself to be effective, winning the
World Rally Championship title in 1985 and 1986.�
entries.zh:
标致205 Turbo 16常常被人称为“终极拉力车”。

它最初是为了参加世界拉力锦标赛充满传奇色彩的B组
别比赛而设计的。

B组别的规则于1983年正式实施时，

只需要在12个月内生产出200台车就可以获得赛事认证。

没有了大规模量产公路车型的限制，意味着制造商可以
在研发上做出更大胆的决定。

而标致做出的决定

是将一台强大的涡轮增压引擎安装在车体中部，并与四
轮驱动结合。

由于其他B组别车队并未采用这种配置，这在锦标赛的
头几年给标致带来了不小的优势。

标致205 Turbo 16在1984年赛季中期首次亮相，

立即证明了自己的高效，在1985年和1986年连续赢得世界拉
力锦标赛的冠军。

entries.en:
If you're looking for a legend of sports sedan,

then look no further than
the Mercedes-Benz 190 E 2.5-16 Evo II.

This car was made with a single goal:
to win races.

It was developed to compete in the DTM, a German race series
that gained a worldwide following through the 1980s and 1990s.

The DTM is contested by touring cars,
which are based on road-going production models.

For its entry, Mercedes-Benz turned the compact 190-series sedan
into a mighty homologation model.

The final evolution model of this is this Evolution II.

Although technically a production road car,
visually, it's a bona fide touring race car.

The race version of the 190 E Evo II
dominated the DTM and the European racing scene.

The AMG Mercedes-Benz works team won the manufacturers title
for two consecutive seasons in 1991 and 1992.

Only 502 road legal versions
of the homologation model were ever produced.

This is one car that any serious collector must have.�
entries.zh:
如果你在寻找一款拥有传奇地位的运动型轿车，

只看梅赛德斯-奔驰190 E 2.5-16 Evo II就够了。

这辆车的设计目的只有一个——那就是赢得比赛。

梅赛德斯打造它的目的完全是为了参加一项在二十世纪八九十年代
举世瞩目的赛事——德国房车大师赛。

这项赛事的参赛车辆都是基于常规的量产房车所打造的。

为了符合参赛条件，梅赛德斯将190系列紧凑型轿车
改造成了性能强大的赛事认证型号。

而这个系列的最终进化——就是这辆Evo II。

尽管从技术角度上讲，它仍然是一款量产公路车，
但从外观来看，它已经是一台不折不扣的竞赛用车了。

190 E Evo II的赛车版本不仅在德国房车大师赛，
更在整个欧洲的赛车领域取得了统治性的地位。

AMG梅赛德斯-奔驰厂队在1991年和1992年
连续两个赛季拿到了车厂冠军头衔。

作为赛事认证车型，�90 E Evo II的合法上路版本
仅生产了502辆。

不用我多说，这是一辆所有真正的收藏家
都必须拥有的车。�

entries.en:
The Jaguar XJ220 is one of the most unusual
performance cars in Jaguar history.

From the 1980s through to the 1990s,
the world's car manufacturers...

...produced numerous legendary supercars
that are still talked about today.

Classic British luxury car maker and racing legend Jaguar
made its mark on super-car history with the XJ220.

The limited production Jaguar XJ220 was released in 1992,
but the project had been in development since the early 1980s.

It started as an unofficial project by a group of employees
which included Jim Randle, then Jaguar's chief engineer.

It was later approved as an official road-car project
and development of the XJ220 began in earnest.

The car's styling takes cues from the legendary
Jaguar XJ13 race car prototype of the 1960s...

...incorporating the elegant form of the classic mid-engine
prototype in a style befitting a modern road car of the 1990s.

The construction of the engine and chassis meanwhile,
were based on Jaguar's�already successful Group C cars.

It featured a 542ps twin-turbo V-6 engine
mounted centrally in the aluminum monocoque shell.

One of the most famous stories about the XJ220...

was that it was so named because the designers
set a goal of a 220-mph (354km/h) top speed.
entries.zh:
捷豹XJ220可以说是捷豹历史上最不寻常的一辆高性能车。

从二十世纪八十年代到九十年代，全世界的汽车制造商……

生产出了无数台传奇超级跑车，直到今天依然是
车迷们津津乐道的谈资。

经典英国豪华车制造商和传奇赛车制造商捷豹也用这辆XJ220
在超级跑车历史上留下了自己的印记。

这款限量版捷豹XJ220于1992年上市，
但其开发过程却从八十年代早期便开始了。

这款车最早是由一群公司员工自发孵化的非官方项目，
其中包括捷豹当时的首席工程师吉姆·兰德尔。

几年之后，公司批准将其转为官方的公路车项目，
于是XJ220的开发正式全面展开。

这辆车的外观借鉴了二十世纪六十年代的
传奇赛车原型车——捷豹XJ13……

它结合了经典中置引擎原型车那优雅的外形和符合九十年代
现代公路车的风格设计。

而与此同时，其引擎�)�底盘部分又是基于捷豹
大获成功的C组别车型所打造。

它采用了一部中置的542ps功率V6双涡轮增压引擎
和一套全铝合金单体车壳。

XJ220最出名的故事之一就是它的命名起源……

设计师们为这款车设定了极速
能够达到220英里/小时（354公里/小时）的目标。

entries.en:
There have been many great Porsche 911s over the years,
but the Carrera RS stands out as a shining masterpiece.

The 1973 Carrera RS was the first production
911 to wear the "Carrera RS" name.

And it was built specifically to win races.

It was a homologation model designed to meet FIA Group 4
regulations.

Its engine displacement was increased to 2.7 liters
from 2.4 liters of the standard 911.

The car was lighter than the stock version because
all luxury and convenience amenities were removed.

Summer tires were chosen for enhanced grip, aided by
special front and rear spoilers.

The "ducktail" rear spoiler served as a
particularly iconic design feature.

The 911 Carrera RS was sold in limited numbers
from late 1972 to 1973.

And while race iterations of other 911s followed,
a trend that continues to this day...

...the 911 Carrera RS was the first of the series,
thus, it now enjoys legendary status among Porsche fans. &
entries.zh:
多年以来，保时捷911推出过许多款伟大的车型，
不过Carrera RS才是其中最闪亮的杰作。

1973款Carrera RS是第一辆被冠以
“Carrera RS”之名的911……

也是专为胜利所打造的比赛机器。

这辆针对国际汽联组别4规则所开发的认证赛车……

将引擎排量从标准911车型的2.4升增加到了2.7升。

此外，它还拆除了一切非必要的部件，
让车重得到了大幅减轻。

为了增强抓地力，这款车采用了夏用轮胎，
并由特制的前后扰流板来辅助增加下压力。

车尾的“鸭尾”扰流板是其极具标志性的特征。

这款911 Carrera RS仅在1972到1973年之间限量销售。

尽管在此之后，多款后续赛车型号继承了前辈的衣钵，
直至演化到最新款的911……

但作为系列的开山之作，这款911 Carrera RS永远
享有最传奇的知名度。

entries.en:
The Porsche 959 was developed specifically to compete in the
WRC's top class—Group B—which was introduced in 1982.

Because it was produced solely for homologation purposes,
only 292 cars were built.

At a glance, the 959 looked similar to contemporary 911s,
but under the skin, it was an entirely different car.

The technical ambition of the project was exemplified
by the 959's drivetrain.

Because Group B rally cars needed to efficiently transfer 500
or so horsepower to the road, they were typically 4WD.

For the 959, Porsche developed an advanced
electronically controlled 4WD system.

Unfortunately, the abrupt end of the Group B category meant that
the 959 was never able to compete in the series.

So, Porsche looked for other venues for the 959, and one of them
was what many considered the world's toughest race.

Porsche entered off-road versions of the 959
into the 1986 Paris-Dakar Rally.

To the surprise of many, the Porsche factory 959 team achieved
an a�azing one-two finish.

The Porsche 959 is a crucial milestone in Porsche history
that showed the potential of 4WD sports cars.�
entries.zh:
这辆保时捷959是专门为了参加1982年创立的
世界拉力锦标赛最高组别B组别所打造。

由于是专为通过赛事认证而制造的车型，
因此仅生产了共计292辆。

乍一看，这辆车和现代的911非常相似，
不过在熟悉的外观下却是一辆全新的汽车。

959在技术上的雄心抱负充分体现在它的传动系统上。

为了将引擎那约500马力的动力全部输出到路面上，
B组别拉力赛车通常采用传统四轮驱动。

而保时捷特意为959开发出一套更先进的电子控制四轮驱动系统。

遗憾的是，B组别的意外取消导致保时捷959未能在赛场上亮相。

不过采用了这套四驱系统的开发原型车
却在多项全世界最困难的拉力赛上取得成功。

其中最为世人熟知的
便是它在1986年巴黎-达喀尔拉力赛上的杰出表现。

保时捷959厂队在赛事中取得了惊人的成绩，包揽了前两名。

保时捷959证]��了四驱跑车的潜力，
是保时捷历史上最重要的里程碑之一。

entries.en:
The World Rally Championship represents the pinnacle
of rally racing.

It was on this international stage where Subaru became the
first Japanese automaker...

...to accomplish the great feat of winning three successive
manufacturers' titles, from 1995 to 1997.

The car that was responsible for the "three-peat"
was the Subaru Impreza WRC.

The Impreza WRC came bathed in the blue livery of
the Subaru works team.

It combined a turbocharged boxer engine with an advanced
all-wheel drive system.

This machine won many rally competitions, including the
Rallye Monte Carlo.

After the announcement of new world rally-car regulations
in 1997...

...the Impreza WRC went to battle as a 2-door coupe with
unique blister fenders both at front and rear.

Its refreshed appearance strongly resembled the original
Impreza 22B STi.

From behind the wheel of the new-look Impreza WRC...

...driver Colin McRae claimed three victories for
the Subaru rally team in 1998.
entries.zh:
拉力赛有着100多年的悠久历史。

其中最高规格的比赛，就是世界拉力锦标赛。

在这项赛事中，斯巴鲁曾经从1995年到1997年连续三届
蝉联车厂冠军头衔……

成为首个达成这项丰功伟业的日本汽车制造商。

帮助他们实现三连冠梦想的就是这台拉力赛版本的
斯巴鲁翼豹。

这辆翼豹身披斯巴鲁厂队的蓝色涂装……

搭载标志性的涡轮增压水平对置引擎和一套四轮驱动系
统……

翼豹的辉煌之路从赢得历史悠久的蒙特卡洛拉力赛
开始……

之后就是一路凯歌高奏。

在引入全新的世界拉力赛规则之后，斯巴鲁于1997年推
出了翼豹世界拉力锦标赛。

这款车的双门跑车身和独特的鼓起式前后挡泥板十分有
辨识度。

有意思的是，它还是后来大名鼎鼎的
翼豹22B STi Version的原型。

眼前这辆车是1998年的版本。

正是这辆车，在科林·��克雷的驾驶下，为斯巴鲁拉力
车队摘下了第三个冠军头衔。�

entries.en:
Even if you weren't around to experience the muscle car boom
that dominated the American automotive scene in the 1960s...

...I'll bet that your heart skipped a beat whenever
you saw one of them in action in a movie or on the TV.

The 1968 Dodge Charger is one of the great
masterpieces of the American muscle car genre.

The body style alone is enough to turn heads.

The "twin diamond" shape of the profile
is one of the trademarks of the 1968 model.

And of course, you can't have a muscle car
without the muscle.

This Charger is the sportier R/T grade, but it also...

...comes with the 426 Hemi,
Mopar's most powerful engine option available at the time.

If you're building a muscle car collection,
this is one car you can't afford to miss.
entries.zh:
即便没有亲身经历过1960年代震撼了
整个美国汽车行业的肌肉车黄金时代……

但我敢打赌，只要你在影视作品里看到一辆
这样风驰电掣的车，你的心跳也一定会随之而加速。

这辆1968款道奇Charger堪称
美国肌肉车中最伟大的杰作之一。

双菱形的轮廓是1968款的标志性特征之一，

仅凭车身就足以吸引到所有人的注目。

当然了，如果没有强大的“肌肉”，
那怎么能算是一辆肌肉车呢？

这辆Charger R/T强调运动性，

安装了当时莫帕能提供的最强大的引擎——426 Hemi动力单元。

如果你有心打造一套肌肉车收藏，那么这辆车绝对不容错过。

entries.sourceName: V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special spec.98
entries.en:
The V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special took on
the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb in 1996.

It won that year, catapulting Suzuki's image as a serious maker
of off-road machines.

The Pikes Peak Hill Climb is a race up a mountain
road to an elevation of over 4593 feet.

With a history dating back more than 100 years,
it is among the oldest motorsport events in the world.

The V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special packed a 981 HP
2.5-liter V-6 in a body that only weighed 800kg.

It was specially tuned to deliver peak performance
at altitudes that exceeded 13,123 feet.
entries.zh:
V6 ESCUDO派克峰特别版让铃木在全球一举成名。

这是一台专为参加科罗拉多州经典比赛派克峰
国际爬坡赛而制造的车。

参赛车辆要沿着海拔高度差为1400m的
山路上不断向上。

它拥有100多年的历史，是世界上最古老的
赛车运动。

挑战这次赛事的V6 Escudo在仅重800kg的
车身中装入了一台1000ps的2.5升V6引擎，

并且经过特别调校，使其在海拔超过4000m的情况下，
性能损失降至最小。

entries.en:
It’s been said that the European minivan boom of the
1980s was sparked by the Renault Espace.

The series had a powerful Formula 1 variant
known as the Espace F1.

This car was proposed to Renault by Matra, the company that
had initially constructed the Espace’s fiberglass body.

At the time, Renault was hailed as the reigning champion
of Formula 1.

Transplanting a RS4 unit from its winning F1 machine
of 1992, the FW14B...

...Matra sought to pay homage to Renault’s Formula 1 success
and, at the same time, mark ten years of the Espace.

Clothed in an almost entirely carbon-fiber
and aluminum body...

...this car swapped out its third-row seats for an F1 engine
mounted amidships.

And its test run was piloted by none other than F1 driver
Alain Prost!

This is one unorthodox minivan that can really zip
around a race track.�
entries.zh:
据说上世纪80年代欧洲多用途汽车的热潮是由雷诺Espace引发的。

该系列曾有一款强悍的一级方程式衍生车型，
名为Espace F1，

由原先负责制造Espace玻璃纤维车身的厂商马特拉
向雷诺提议打造。

当时雷诺作为一级方程式的卫冕冠军，
可谓是风头无两。

马特拉提议在此车上移植1992年冠军赛车FW14B的
RS4动力单元……

意在致敬雷诺在一级方程式的辉煌战绩，
同时庆祝Espace车型问世十周年。

此车车身几乎完全采用碳纤维与铝合金打造……

并拆除了第三排座椅，换装中置布局的一级方程式引擎。

试驾任务更是由一级方程式传奇车手
阿兰·普罗斯特亲自执驾！

这款不走寻常路的多用途汽车，
在赛道上也是风驰电掣�hp

entries.en:
The name "W 196" evokes a special reverence among
Mercedes-Benz enthusiasts.

The reason is this legendary model didn’t just compete;
it dominated the racing world of the 1950s.

When the 2.5-liter engine limit was set for F1 in 1954,
Mercedes-Benz engineered a car tailored to the new regulation.

This machine, christened the "W 196 R," was equipped with an inline
8-cylinder angled, which on the track, became a finely tuned weapon.

Upon its debut in 1954, the car claimed four out of six victories in
the skilled hands of racing legend Juan Manuel Fangio.

The following year, in 1955, it solidified its reputation,
claiming five wins out of six races.

The "W 196 R" before you hails from that illustrious,
unforgettable 1955 season.

In this iteration, it appears without the original cowl, showcasing
the sleek single-seater with "monoposto" body.

It features a distinctive hood bulge designed for air intake.

By the way, did you know that the "W 196 R" had a sibli�g
developed for sports-car racing?

Named the "W 196 S," this model became a legend in its own right,
becoming a titan of the sports-car world.

Officially known as the "300 SLR", it left an indelible mark on
automotive history with its unmatched design and performance.
entries.zh:
对梅赛德斯-奔驰车迷而言，“W 196”是一个
意义非凡的型号。

这个传奇名字在20世纪50年代主宰了赛车界。

1954年，F1引擎规格限制改为2.5升后，
梅赛德斯-奔驰随即着手开发符合新规则的赛车。

这台被命名为“W 196 R”的赛车配备了一台倾斜放置的
直列八缸引擎，在赛道上所向披靡。

1954年首次参赛时，在赛车传奇胡安·曼努埃尔·方吉奥的
驾驭下，六站比赛斩获四冠。

到了1955年，它更是展现出无与伦比的实力，
在六站比赛中夺得五场胜利。

你眼前的这台W 196 R正是来自那个辉煌的赛季。

这款去除了首发时整流罩的单座赛车……

引擎盖上突起的鼓包进气口格外醒目。

对了，你知道吗？W 196 R还有一个为跑车比赛
开发的姊妹车型。

名为“W 196 S”的它同样名声显赫，是运动跑车领域
的翘楚。

它的正式名称是“300 SLR”，^��样在汽车发展史上
留下了不可磨灭的印记。

entries.en:
The De Tomaso Mangusta is an iconic 1960s sports car.

It is one of car designer Giorgetto Giugiaro's
most legendary creations,

and its value has risen quite a bit in recent years.

Now we have a very interesting chapter
added to the history of the Mangusta.

Introducing a Gran Turismo original, the Mangusta
"Christian Dior."

This car was created in collaboration with
the famous French couture house Christian Dior.

The aim of Dior here was to infuse the sports car
with its elegant brand essence.

The designer who worked on this project is Kim Jones,
Dior Men's Artistic Director

The Mangusta he customized is characterized by its chic body
color and stripe, and the "Dior" signature on its side.

The racing number 47 on the body is also strongly tied
to the history of the Dior Brand.

Last but not least, a special racing suit and helmet
have been designed specifically to accompany this Mangusta!
entries.zh:
德托马索Mangusta是一辆标志性的1960年代跑车。

它是设计大师乔盖托·乔治亚罗最传奇的杰作之一，

其收藏价值也在近年来大幅飙升。

如今，我们又为Mangusta的辉煌历史添加了一段非常有趣的篇章，

为大家带来一款跑车浪漫旅原创车型：
Mangusta“克里斯汀·迪奥”。

这辆车是和知名法国高定时装品牌
克里斯汀·迪奥联手打造的。

由迪奥为这辆跑车注入品牌的优雅血统。

参与本项目开发的设计师是金·琼斯，
他同时也是迪奥男装部门的艺术总监。

这款由他亲手打造的Mangusta拥有雅致的奶油/暗金配色和
条纹图案。当然，车身侧面也不忘打上“迪奥”的标记。

车盖上的47号赛车号码也与
迪奥的品牌历史有着密切的联系。

最重要的是，为了配合这辆Mangusta的发布，
迪奥还特别设计了配套的赛车服和头盔！[

entries.en:
The Castrol MUGEN NSX was one of the standouts
in the competitive 2000 JGTC season.

It became the first Honda NSX to win a high-level Japanese
GT championship.

In the top GT500 class of the Japanese GT Car Championship
(JGTC), there was a real dogfight...

...between the factory teams of Honda, Nissan and Toyota,
who were always trying to one-up each other.

Since 1997, Honda had been competing with its NSX GT race car.

But tuning regulations in the JGTC restricted the development of the NSX GT.

This led to less than satisfactory results on the track, but
Honda's race department refused to give up.

Through tuning of the car's aerodynamics and improvements to weight
balance, the NSX steadily improved year after year.

All of that perseverance came to fruition in the 2000 season when
the Castrol MUGEN NSX took home the series championship.

Today, the original NSX has become a consummate collector
car, an icon of Japanese automobiles

And this car rep�esents the model's legacy as a
timeless, persistent race machine.�
entries.zh:
卡斯特罗无限NSX参加了全日本GT锦标赛2000赛季……

并成为了赢得日本顶级房车赛冠军的第一款
本田NSX车型。

GT500是全日本GT锦标赛中的最高组别，

也是日产、丰田和本田三家原厂车队之间激烈
竞争的战场。

在本田参加的首个完整赛季中，其派出了旗下的
1997 NSX GT车型……

但在参赛伊始，全日本GT锦标赛的调教规则就给了
NSX GT的后续开发当头一棒……

他们的成绩也因此一落千丈。

不过本田对空气动力学性能和配重平衡的持续调校
让赛车的表现在接下来的数年里稳步提升……

而到了2000赛季，卡斯特罗无限NSX赛车终于不负
众望，拿到了冠军。

如今，原版NSX已经成为了日本汽车史上的传奇偶像。

而这款赛车车型更是留下了光辉灿烂的遗产，成为了真
正的丰碑。

entries.en:
Overall victory in the 24 Hours of Le Mans
is one of the greatest achievements for a manufacturer.

This Toyota GT-One is one of many cars
that sought to secure its place in the history books.

It competed in Le Mans in the late 1990s under GT1 regulations,
the highest category for production-based race cars.

Having developed this Le Mans spec car specifically to
compete in GT1, Toyota named it simply the "GT-One."

Development of the GT-One, and the race team,
was led by genius race-car designer André de Cortanze.

Already an accomplished engineer, Cortanze had
developed cars for F1, WRC and Le Mans.

What he created for Toyota was
a beautifully advanced racing machine.

His GT-One combined formula car technology
with the styling of a GT car.

The Toyota GT-One competed in Le Mans twice,
in 1998 and 1999.

In its first outing in 1998, it finished 9th overall.

Toyota returned in 1999 with the team of Ukyo Katayama,
Toshio Suzuki and Keiichi Tsuchiya takin� 2nd in car No.3.

Although the team wasn't quite able to reach its goal,
fans will never forget the feats of the GT-One.�
entries.zh:
能够在勒芒24小时耐力赛上赢得总冠军对于
每一家汽车制造商来说都是莫大的成就。

这辆丰田GT-1就是为了勇攀这项赛事的
巅峰所打造的车型之一。

它在上世纪90年代参加了勒芒的GT1组别比赛，即为基于
量产车型打造的赛车所设置的最高组别。

丰田专门为参加GT1的竞速而开发了这款勒芒规格的赛车，
甚至将其直截了当地命名为“GT-1”。

GT-1的开发以及车队管理均由天才赛车设计师
安德烈·德·科尔但泽所领衔。

作为一名功成名就的工程师，科尔但泽曾经为F1、
世界拉力锦标赛和勒芒都开发过赛车。

而他为丰田贡献的作品则是一款外形美观、
性能优异的比赛机器。

他的GT-1结合了方程式赛车的科技和
GT车型风格的车身设计。

这款丰田GT-1在1998年和1999年两度征战勒芒。

在首次亮相的1998年，它以第9名的总成绩完赛。

在1999��，丰田又派出由片山右京、铃木利男
和土屋圭市组成的车手阵容

重回勒芒，并依靠他们的3号赛车拿到了第二名的好成绩。

尽管车队并未实现他们的终极目标，但车迷们
将会永远铭记GT-1的伟大功勋。_

entries.en:
Mercedes-Benz, renowned for its passenger vehicles,
has also made significant contributions to the commercial sector.

One such example is the Unimog.

An acronym for Universal-Motor-Gerät, its name translates to
"Universal Motorized Working Machine."

Designed in 1945, the Unimog was engineered as an all-wheel-drive
farming vehicle capable of navigating rugged terrain.

Its versatility stemmed from a range of attachments,
enabling it to perform virtually any task required.

1953 marked the debut of the 401/402, the first iteration
to bear Mercedes-Benz's iconic three-pointed star.

It was followed by the Type 411.

It featured a cabin and flatbed mounted on a ladder frame
derived from the 401.

Often hailed as "the last original Unimog,"
the 411 holds a special place in automotive history.

Having evolved beyond its agricultural roots, it is now
celebrated as a premier vintage vehicle.~
entries.zh:
在乘用车之外，梅赛德斯-奔驰还生产了多款
商用车类型的经典之作。

Unimog便是其中之一。

Unimog是德文“Universal-Motor-Gerät”的缩写，
意为“通用机动工作机器”。

Unimog于1945年设计，最初是一款四轮驱动的
农用载具，专为应对不平整的地形而打造。

通过配置各种用途的附件，几乎可以完成任何任务。

1953年，401/402型号问世，这是第一款采用
梅赛德斯三叉星标识的车型。

Type 411紧随其后推出，

采用继承自401的边梁式车架，并配有驾驶室和平板车厢……

411被誉为“最后一款原汁原味的Unimog”，因此
成为了极具收藏价值的珍贵车型。

如今，它已经超越了“农用机械”的定义，
被视为一款一流的经典车。

entries.en:
The Toyota Land Cruiser is one of the longest-running
and most respected vehicles in the world.

Its story began more than 70 years ago, in 1951.

The FJ40 series arrived in 1960, marking
the model’s third generation.

It was offered in a variety of body styles,
each designed for a specific purpose.

The 2-door hardtop, seen here, was built to conquer
the harshest off-road conditions.

Although compact at just 3.9m in length, it was
powered by a stout 3.9-liter gasoline engine.

Its rugged 4WD system with a 2-speed transfer case
made it indispensable on mountain trails.

With its distinctive charm, the FJ40 became an enduring favorite
and stayed in production for 24 years, until 1984.

In 2021, TOYOTA GAZOO Racing began producing
reproduction parts for the model.

Why? Because a legendary off-roader like this
was simply too good to let fade away.
�
entries.zh:
丰田Land Cruiser是品牌最常青
且最受景仰的车型之一。

它的故事始于70多年前的1951年。

1960推出的FJ40系列标志着该车系进入第三代，

且提供多种车款以满足不同用户的需求。

这里展示的双门硬顶版本专为应对极端越野条件而打造。

车身虽然小巧（车长约3.9m），却搭载了实力派的3.9升汽油引擎。

再加上带有两速分动箱的四驱系统，
让这台车成为山路驾驶的绝对利器。

FJ40凭借迷人外观大受欢迎，持续生产24年，
直至1984年才停产。

丰田图像赛车于2021年开始
为其生产复刻零件。

原因很简单，因为如此杰出的越野车型值得被永续传承！

entries.en:
The Skyline GT-R could may well be the most popular
Japanese car ever.

The R32 has now become a collector's item, and the last
variant of that classic was this V-Spec II.

It has wider tires than the base model. It also features
Brembo brakes and BBS aluminum wheels as standard.

The V-Spec II was built to celebrate the GT-R's success in
Group N and Group A racing, just like the V-Spec I.

Thanks to its stiffer chassis, the V-Spec II handles like a dream.
entries.zh:
Skyline GT-R是日产最著名的车型之一。

这款热门的V-Spec II型是
R32的最终生产型。

此型号的车轮比普通型号的更宽……

不仅标配布雷博制动钳
和BBS铝轮毂，

整个底盘也经过了强化。

entries.en:
This little beauty is the perfect first choice for
an aspiring sports-car driver.

The car is nice and light, with a decent amount of power,
and most importantly...

...it's rear-wheel drive! Just the thing if you're still
learning your way around sports cars.

The MX-5 Miata, as we now call it, has a long history, but the NA
is the original model, and some say the very best one!
entries.zh:
这辆小车儿非常
适合入门跑车爱好者。

它外观简洁，车身轻盈，马力适中……
而且还是后驱！

因此，它非常适合还在学习基础的车手。

这款跑车拥有悠久的历史，但自然进气引擎
才是它最原本的引擎配备。有些人觉得自然进气才是最棒的！

entries.en:
The Lancer Evolution is one of the most popular
Japanese 4WD sports cars ever produced.

The fourth-generation model—the Evolution IV—was developed
during Mitsubishi's golden age of rallying.

Its 4G3 engine, a turbo 2.0-liter inline-4, pumps out 280ps—
a voluntary limit adopted by Japanese manufacturers.

The car features the company's first Active Yaw Control system,
or AYC, which electronically controls rear-wheel torque.

This innovation significantly improved the Lancer Evo's
handling and made it favorite among rally fans.
entries.zh:
蓝瑟翼豪陆神是有史以来最具辨识度的
日产四驱跑车。

这款车的第四代——翼豪陆神IV
是在三菱的拉力赛黄金年代诞生的。

因日本车厂之间一条不成文的君子协定，
其2升直列四缸涡轮增压4G3引擎的最大马力被限制在280ps。

这款车上还首次配备了主动式舵角控制器
，能通过电子装置控制后轮扭矩……

这使得蓝瑟翼豪陆神具备优良的过弯性能。

entries.en:
The Copen is a prized example of Japan's "kei" sports cars
because of its performance and quality craftsmanship.

Its metal roof could be electronically extended or retracted
at the push of a button.

The 4-cylinder engine set it apart from other "kei cars"
in its class...

...which helped give the car a fun, sporty flavor.

The hum of the little powerplant will sing you a lovely song
when you rev it freely on your favorite mountain road.
entries.zh:
由于Copen优良的性能和制造工艺，
它成为了最受人喜爱的日本轻型车之一。

这款车还配备了能一键收展的
电动金属车顶。

不同于其他轻型跑车，
它还搭载了一台四缸发动机。

这辆车保准能为你提供既平稳又令人满足的驾驶体验。

在赛道上，
它清脆的引擎声能令你心花怒放。

entries.en:
Do you know who Bob Lutz is? He was one of the top auto
execs in the U.S. that many considered a real "car guy."

He worked for each of America's "Big Three" car companies, but
his claim to fame was the Corvette-conquering Dodge Viper.

It had a front-mounted 8.0-liter V-10, sourced from
a pickup truck no less!

The Viper saw plenty of action in endurance races at Le Mans
and the Nürburgring. The thing was a monster!
entries.zh:
你听说过鲍勃·卢茨这个人吗？
他是美国顶尖的汽车行业高管——外号“汽车狂人”。

他不仅在汽车制造业三大厂中都任过职，
他还是大名鼎鼎的道奇Viper——绰号“科尔维特杀手”的缔造者。

Viper GTS不仅搭载了前置8升V10引擎，
还换装了刚性底盘。

这款车的竞赛款参加过勒芒
和纽博格林的赛事——它不快才怪呢！|

entries.en:
The V-10 in the SRT10 Coupe is much more powerful than the
engine used in the first-generation model.

Not only did it have more displacement, it pumped out more
than 600ps, and with enough torque to wrench your neck!

Refinements were made to transform the beast
into a more luxurious sports car.

One of them was making the V-10 rev smoother than before.

Handling is much more stable and reliable as well.

And, the clutch and transmission are also more responsive
than in the previous model.
entries.zh:
SRT10轿跑搭载了一台性能大幅优于
前代引擎的V10引擎。

这台引擎的排量更大，且马力超过了600ps，
使得Viper的名号实至名归。

除此之外，
SRT10还得到了全方位的改进。

它的引擎现在顺畅无比……

操控性更加稳定可靠……

连离合和传动也的响应
也变得更加迅速了！

entries.en:
BMW poured their heart and soul into the development of
this R50 Mini.

This version has an FF layout, which in our world stands
for front-engine/front-wheel drive.

Like its predecessor, this car is light and agile, able to
tackle the sharpest of corners like a rail car.

The engine in this Cooper S comes with a supercharger...

...meaning it delivers excellent power at 170ps with
plenty of pop in both low- and mid-rpm ranges. x
entries.zh:
R50 MINI是宝马生产的新世代MINI Hatch的
首款车型。

这辆车采用了前置前驱布局。

它继承了前代车型轻便、灵活的特性，
能轻松应对急弯。

这一Cooper S款还额外安装了机械增压装置，
进一步提升了性能。

它中低转速区间的出力
定能让你大吃一惊！

entries.en:
The F430 represented a turning point for Ferrari.

For one, its mid-mounted V-8 engine had a complete makeover
and generated more power.

It churned out 90ps more than its predecessor,
the 360's engine.

The styling was inspired by both the 250 TR and the Enzo,
which accounts for its jaw-dropping good looks.

Owning this car is the ideal way to experience the long
and storied history of Ferrari on a daily basis!
entries.zh:
F430标志了法拉利设计理念的一个转折点。

最值得注意的是，它搭载的中置V8引擎是
完全重新设计的。

这台引擎让这辆车的马力
比前代360 Modena高了90ps。

F430还吸收了250 TR和Enzo的
设计元素。

总而言之，这辆车承载着法拉利
悠久且传奇的历史！

entries.en:
The Berlinetta Boxer was the first Ferrari production car
with a mid-mounted 12-cylinder engine.

This coupe combined the beauty of a berlinetta body
with the power of a race car.

We in the biz refer this machine as the "BB."

Its top speed of <302km/h> made it the fastest car in the
world when it was first introduced.

Pininfarina, the company that penned the design,
continues to work closely with Ferrari to this day.
entries.zh:
法拉利的BB系列是首次采用中置12缸引擎
的量产车型。

这些双门跑车将双座线条优美的车身
和水平对卧十二缸的动力结合在了一起。

“BB”即为“Berlinetta Boxer”的缩写。

凭借高达<302km/h>的最高时速，
这辆车一经问世便成为了世界上最快的车。

它那由宾尼法利纳设计的车体仍然是法拉利设计的灵感来源。

entries.en:
This FIAT 500 F is one of the most recognizable and
best-selling Italian cars ever.

It came with an air-cooled 2-cylinder engine.

And it had a rear-engine/rear-wheel-drive layout, what we
call "RR," just like the Porsche 911!

This later model had conventional front-hinged doors.

Despite making its debut half a century ago, this iconic
car's legacy lives on in the modern FIAT 500.^
entries.zh:
菲亚特500 F是历史上最著名的
意大利车之一。

它采用了后置后驱布局，
并搭载了一台风冷双气缸引擎。

从这个角度上看，这辆车其实和
保时捷911差不多！

此款后期的型号安装了便捷的前开式车门。

虽已是年过半百的老车，
这款标志性车型的设计精神在现代的菲亚特500中得以延续。

entries.en:
The Lancia Delta has to be one of the most notable rally
cars in automotive history.

And little wonder—the Group A rally machine won the World Rally
Championship an incredible six times!

The production version of the Italian race car is still
highly sought after by collectors.

This HF Integrale Evoluzione is one of the last variants
to be produced.

Not only does it boast 4WD and wider tires, but power
was upped to more than 200ps.
entries.zh:
意大利产的蓝旗亚Delta是世界上最
传奇的拉力赛车之一。

它的名号并非徒有虚名——这款A组别拉力赛车在
世界拉力锦标赛中夺冠了六次！

这款车的基础量产车型在今天依然
备受收藏家的追捧。

这辆HF Integrale Evoluzione是这款车最后的
生产型号之一。

它不仅是四驱，马力也被
提升至了200ps以上。]

entries.en:
This thing may look like an average hatchback, but the mid-mounted
3.0-liter V-6 makes it a genuine sports car.

The design was based on Renault's beloved R5 Turbo of
the 1980s.

While the Clio V6 was originally conceived as a one-make
race model, this is one is street legal.

And that sweet V-6 has gobs of power, with torque to spare!
entries.zh:
这车或许看起来就是辆普通的掀背车，但这款搭载了
后置3升V6引擎的车子可是实打实的跑车型赛车！

该车的设计理念据说来自于80年代
的热门车雷诺R5 Turbo。

这款车原本是作为统一规格赛车而设计的，
但这款车为公路版。

等你体验到那后置3升V6引擎的马力和扭矩后，
你立马就能感受到其中的区别！

entries.en:
The TVR Tuscan Speed Six is a particularly striking
race car, don't you agree?

Under its hood is the Speed Six, a 4.0-liter inline-6
developed in-house.

With its magnificent roar and gobs of torque, it's no wonder
the car was named after its engine.

Power output is 360ps, but weighs only 1100kg,
so it's fast.
entries.zh:
特维尔Tuscan Speed Six这款赛车能把赛道本身的刺激
体现得淋漓尽致。

它搭载了由特维尔自主开发的
“六速”4升直列六缸引擎。

该款引擎能发出巨大的轰鸣声，拥有非凡的扭矩，
难怪这款车型冠名了它的名字！

尽管拥有高达360ps的最大马力，
这辆车却只重1100kg。

entries.en:
Those in the market for a rotary-engine car need look no further
than Mazda's RX-7.

This model, the FD3S "Spirit R," was the last RX-7 version
produced.

Its twin-rotor twin-turbocharged Wankel engine—another name
for the rotary engine—can generate up to 280ps.

The tires and suspension were upgraded, too, and this
"Type A" 2-seater weighed only 2800 lb....

...making it a virtual race car for the street.

Many years have passed since production of the FD RX-7 ended,
but it remains the pinnacle of rotary-engine sports cars.
entries.zh:
转子引擎的爱好者会对
这宝贝爱不释手。

FD3S“Spirit R”是RX-7款的最终生产型。

这辆车搭载的双转子双涡轮增压引擎可以产生高达
280ps。

它还换装了更好的
轮胎和悬挂。

此外，这辆“Type A”还是辆双座跑车。

虽然早已停产，这款车仍被许多人认为是
转子引擎跑车的巅峰之作。

entries.en:
Some say the reboot of the legendary GT40 that made history
at Le Mans has become more popular than the original.

It's beautiful to look at, with retro styling cues that
rekindle the spirit of the 1960s.

From the unique yet melodic roar of the supercharged V-8 to the
amazing chassis that delivered remarkable handling...

the Ford GT looks and acts like its legendary predecessor,
with more than 500ps on tap.

Do you think you have what it takes to handle it?
entries.zh:
这款车型是在勒芒创下记录的GT40
的重制版。

它复古的线条令人大饱眼福，
完美地将60年代的精神带到了今天！

不管是独特的机械增压V8引擎，
还是动力澎湃的刚劲底盘……

GT40的设计者真的顾及
到了一切。

这真是辆举世无双的车！_

entries.en:
The first-generation Audi R8 is a powerful-yet-highly refined
mid-engine sports car, but you probably knew that already.

Its quattro 4WD system gives it amazing traction and
grip on all kinds of driving surfaces.

Wet roads are nothing to fear when driving this car.

Step on the throttle, and you'll be jolted in the back of your
seat, but once you get to speed, it's surprisingly smooth.

This is indeed the consummate gentleman's sport car.
entries.zh:
初代奥迪R8是一款中置引擎跑车，
拥有无出其右的操控性。

它搭载的“夸德罗”四驱系统给它带来了出众的
稳定性。

潮湿的路面对于这辆车来说也只是小菜一碟。

这款车灵敏的油门和顺畅的操控性保证了
愉悦的驾驶体验。

这是辆里程碑式的跑车，为超跑操控性
立下了新的标杆。

entries.en:
This final limited-edition R34 GT-R went by the name,
"V-Spec II Nür."

As you probably guessed, its moniker refers to the Nürburgring
track where the car was developed.

The engine's internal components were further refined and
calibrated specifically for this model.

Only 1000 of these beauties were constructed in the R34's
final production year.
entries.zh:
R34 GT-R的最终限量版，
型号名为“V-Spec II Nür”。

这个名字的由来是用于开发GT-R的
纽博格林赛道。

为了达到比前代更加优异的性能，
该款车型的引擎部件得到了专门升级。

在该款车型生产线运作的最后一年里，
这款珍贵的R34只有1000辆被生产出来。

entries.en:
Just so you know, the R33 GT-R is faster and a more stable
handling machine than the R32.

Credit here goes to the R33's longer body.

I mean, just look at the wheelbase. It's more than 100mm
longer than that of the R32.

This difference can really be felt when driving hard
on a race track.

Also, this V-Spec version doesn't understeer as much
as the R32 V-Spec.

This is because Nissan fine-tuned the ATTESA E-TS 4-wheel-drive
system to make it behave as neutrally as possible.
entries.zh:
相较R32 GT-R，R33的最高时速更高，稳定性更好，
综合性能更加优秀。

这有一部分要归功于其更长、更重的车体。

具体来讲，这辆车的轴距比其前代
R32长了100mm。

这项改进对行车稳定性带来了
巨大的提升。

除此之外，这辆V-spec版不像R32那样容易遇到
转向不足的情况。

毕竟，这辆车还搭载了先进的ATTESA E-TS
四轮驱动系统。

entries.en:
The Nissan 350Z—known as the Fairlady Z (Z33) in Japan—
is impressive on both road and track.

With a naturally-aspirated engine that sends power to the
rear wheels, balance is the name of its game.

The 3.5-liter V-6 was retuned for this 2007 model.

So it possesses better top-end performance, partly because
the redline was raised.

The end result was the company's first naturally-aspirated
V-6 capable of producing more than 300ps.
entries.zh:
日产350Z——这款在日本本土被称为“Fairlady Z（Z33）”
的车子，几乎就是为赛道而生的。

这要归功于它搭载的大排量自然吸气引擎和
后驱系统。

2007年版的350Z搭载了重新设计的V6引擎。

改进版引擎的动力更强，转速区间更高。

这也是日产生产的第一款马力达到300ps
以上的自然吸气V6引擎。

entries.en:
The fourth-generation M3 was the first to utilize
a naturally-aspirated V-8.

And this engine was as impressive as it gets.

It revved like a monster, redlining at 8400rpm!

Most of the technology that made this thing so special trickled
down from the company's Formula 1 program in the 2000s.

You can tell, too, by just listening to it.
It sounds like a race car, doesn't it?

While it's not as powerful as some of the more recent models,
this V-8 still makes the car great fun to drive.#
entries.zh:
第四代M3是该系列中首次搭载
自然吸气V8引擎的车型。

这引擎可不得了！

它的转速红线竟然达到了8400rpm！

这款引擎的许多技术都来自宝马在2000年代
于F1赛事中积累的经验。

因此，它发出的金属声浪更接近赛车，
而非量产车。

虽然这辆车的动力不如最新的
型号，它依然是一辆充满驾驶乐趣的车。

entries.en:
Released in 2002, this baby is an updated version of the
first-generation NSX Type R.

It uses the NA2 model NSX as a base, which means that it
came powered by a 3.2-liter V-6.

One of this car's charms was its refined aerodynamic profile.

Modifications were made to its underside to improve air flow,
and several major aerodynamic components were added.

So you can bet that its handling and stability at high speeds
were impressive, to say the least.

The naturally-aspirated V-6 revs like a dream — and its power
will have you comfortable attacking any circuit.
entries.zh:
该车型为初代NSX Type R的改进版，
于2002年上市。

它以NA2型NSX为基础，
搭载了3.2升V6引擎。

它的主要卖点是经过优化的空气动力设计。

经过改造的底盘获得了更优秀的空气流动性，
并装上了数个轻量化组件。

这些改进使此型号的高速操控性和稳定性达到了
优越的水准。

大马力自然吸气V6引擎
有着令人满意的动力，并赋予了这辆车足以攻克任何赛道的性能。

entries.en:
If you're shopping around for a FF hot hatch, you'd be smart
to take a close look at the Swift Sport.

Its 1.6-liter naturally-aspirated engine transitions well to
high speeds, and its handling is as sharp as a katana.

This particular model marks a real evolution in chassis
construction, with more rigidity than ever before.

The year 2007 was a special one for the Swift because it made
a name for itself by winning the Junior World Rally Cup.
entries.zh:
如果你在找一辆前置前驱的高性能掀背车，
速翼特运动版是个不错的选择。

它搭载的1.6升自然吸气引擎完全能应对高速行驶，
而它的操控性能更是无与伦比。

凭借其大幅提升的底盘刚性，这款车型标志了
速翼特底盘制作工艺的进化。

这辆车也因在2007年世界青年拉力锦标赛中夺冠
而声名大噪。

entries.en:
If you're looking for a car that handles like it's on rails,
then you can't go wrong with any of the RX-7s.

This second-generation "FC" has a lower center of gravity than
many of its competitors, and it's lighter, too.

Even today, people rave about its amazing on-road prowess,
which comes via its unique rotary engine.

Properly tuned, it'll run circles around some of the
newer models out there today.
entries.zh:
想找一辆操控性出色的车子吗？
那么RX-7系列车型肯定适合你。

在第二代“FC”上市时，它的重量更轻，
重心也比当时的竞争者要低。

即使放在今天，这辆车优良的过弯性能
也并不常见。

在经过适当调校后，这辆车完全可以与
最新款的车型一较高下。

entries.en:
The Nissan Silvia is known for its front-engine/rear-wheel-drive
layout, and its powerful turbocharged engine.

The S15 spec-R Silvia is more compact than the S14 and
boasts a strengthened chassis.

Like other Nissan sports cars, it is fitted with an SR20
turbocharged inline-4 capable of 250ps.

This Silvia really is the quintessential FR sports car
of its class.
entries.zh:
日产Silvia因其前置后驱布局和强劲的
涡轮增压而闻名。

S15 spec-R Silvia相比S14更加紧凑，
而且换装了强化底盘。

与同厂其他跑车一样，它搭载一台马力为250ps的
SR20四缸涡轮增压引擎。

这辆Silvia不愧为同类车型中前置
后驱跑车的典范。

entries.en:
The 370Z, called the Fairlady Z in Japan, is shorter than
its predecessor, the 350Z, but just as good looking.

Its shortened wheelbase helps it to be more agile, making it
easy to control on the race track.

But don't worry if you think that its small body results
in less stability, because that isn't the case at all.

In fact, the car actually feels more solid through corners
and remains composed in a straight line at high speeds.

And don't forget about the powerful 3.7-liter naturally-aspirated
V-6 under its hood, which pumps out more than 330ps.
entries.zh:
370Z——在日本本土被为“Fairlady Z Z34”的车型。
相较350Z，它的轴距和车长更短。

这不仅使得该车的外观显得更加圆润、灵巧，
还令这辆车的过弯性能变得更迅敏。

别担心，这辆车的稳定性并没有
因此减退分毫。

它搭载的3.7升自然吸气V6引擎动力澎湃，
能产生超过330ps。

如果这是你的第一辆后驱车，
那你大可放心开着它驰骋！

entries.sourceName: Lancer Evolution VI GSR T.M. EDITION Special Color Package '00
entries.en:
Looking for a collectable rally-bred performance car? Then look
no further than the Tommi Mäkinen Edition Lancer Evolution.

Named for the legendary driver who won four consecutive
WRC titles with the Lancer Evo race car...

...this special-edition model from Mitsubishi celebrates
his historic accomplishment.

Serving as the foundation was the Lancer Evo VI. Mitsubishi
then added a stiffer suspension, among other things.

Of all the models in the series, this car and the Evo V are
noted as being "the most thrilling tarmac specialists."
entries.zh:
蓝瑟翼豪陆神VI汤米·马基宁版是蓝瑟系列
的巅峰车型。

它的名字来自汤米·马基宁，一位驾驶着蓝瑟翼豪陆神
在世界拉力锦标赛中四度夺冠的传奇车手。

三菱生产此车型的目的便是为了
向他的成就致敬。

这辆车基于蓝瑟翼豪陆神VI，但配备了
更硬的悬挂。

纵观该系列所有车型，只有这辆车和翼豪陆神V被
认为是“最刺激的柏油路面克星”。8

entries.en:
Not many sports cars in the world can boast a history
spanning 50 years, especially from Japan.

But one of them is the Nissan Z, called the Fairlady Z
in its home market.

In 1989, Nissan introduced the fourth-generation model,
the 300ZX, which came powered by...

...a twin-turbocharged V-6, making it the first Z to
be offered with forced induction.

This resulted in the engine becoming the first to reach the
280ps limit adopted by Japanese manufacturers.
entries.zh:
世界上很少有跑车的历史
能超过50年。

日产Z型车，或者说“Fairlady Z”——
就是罕见的例外之一。

这辆第四代300ZX于1989
年上市。

它搭载的双涡轮增压V6引擎
不可小觑。

这也是在日本厂商达成不成文的280ps君子协定
后上市的第一款引擎。

entries.en:
Of all Alfa Romeo cars in the past few decades, I would
rate this 8C Competizione at the top of the list.

Race car manufacturer Dallara collaborated with Alfa Romeo
in this car's design and development...

...with the assembly of the precious few units overseen
by none other than Maserati.

And the constructor of the V-8 engine? Ferrari.

Also, its front-engine/rear-drive layout included a transaxle.

With such a dream team working behind the scenes, this car
was destined to be the quintessential Italian exotic.<
entries.zh:
8C Competizione绝对算得上阿尔法罗密欧跑车
中的佼佼者。

赛车车厂达拉拉与阿尔法罗密欧合作设计、
打造出了这辆车。

它的有限生产是交给玛莎拉蒂
负责的……

而搭载的V8引擎是法拉利打造的。

光听起来就非同凡响！

此外，它的跨轴前置后驱布局还赋予了它
梦幻般的操控性。

entries.en:
The chassis might be based on the FIAT Grande Punto, but make
no mistake: this is an Alfa Romeo through and through.

Its excellent suspension provided predictable, sharp turning.

The turbocharged 1.4-liter engine was quick and responsive.

It certainly provided quite a thrill when you revved
that engine into the meat of its power band!8
entries.zh:
它的底盘虽然是基于菲亚特第三代朋多的，
但这是一辆彻头彻尾的阿尔法罗密欧。

它出色的悬架使其能够平稳、敏锐地转过弯道……

它搭载的1.4升涡轮增压发动机出力快，
响应灵敏。

只要你一脚踩下油门，你就会知道这车
不是闹着玩的！

entries.en:
When it comes to sheer performance, the Corvette C6 ZR1
belongs among the elite supercars in the world.

Not only is the OHV V-8 powerful enough on its own, Chevy
raised the stakes by bolting a supercharger to it!

With power output of 646ps, combined with a lightweight body,
you can imagine how this car went in a straight line.

The suspension system was also upgraded, so its handling
was on par with the supercars of its day.

There's a small window on the hood, providing a view of the
supercharger in all its glory.

Yes, this ZR1 proved that America could still build supercars.
entries.zh:
科尔维特C6 ZR1的速度至今都称得上是
世界顶级。

给顶置气门V8引擎安装机械增压器是美国人提升
马力的传统方法。

作为一款在当时鲜见的轻量车，
ZR1依然能输出647ps。

就连经验丰富的车手都对它的加速性能
大吃一惊！

另外，设计师在引擎盖上开小窗口就是为了让你能
瞥见涡轮增压器。

这小细节挺有意思的，你不觉得么？

entries.en:
The FIAT 500 is the quintessential Italian compact.

The design is based on that of the famed 1950s
second-generation model of the same name.

The car utilizes a front-engine/front-wheel-drive layout
that we refer to as "FF."

The FIAT 500's "FIRE" is one in a long line of inline-4 engines
that have been in use since the first Pandas.

While it may not look like much...

...it handles well for a front-drive compact car, and its engine
note is pleasing to the ear.
entries.zh:
菲亚特500是意大利小型车的代表作。

它的设计基于20世纪50年代著名的
同名第二代车型。

这辆车采用了传统的前置
前驱系统……

它搭载的直列四缸燃火引擎是从第一代
Panda车型上沿用下来的。

确实，这辆车看起来中规中矩……

但是它的操控性不错，
而且引擎声浪非常悦耳。

entries.en:
Abarth is an Italian race car builder that rose to
global prominence in the 1950s and 1960s.

The brand was resurrected in 2007, and a little later,
it introduced the Abarth 500 you see here.

It's a hot hatch, and it has a front-engine/front-wheel-drive
layout that we in the industry refer to as "FF."

Abarth really injected its DNA into the 500, which is evident
everywhere, from its styling to the powered-up engine.
entries.zh:
意大利赛车制造商阿巴斯于20世纪50年代和60年代在
全球范围内声名鹊起。

此品牌在2007年获得了重生。很快，这家新公司
就推出了这款阿巴斯500。

这是一款采用前置前驱布局的
高性能掀背车。

从它的引擎到悬挂，这辆车上的一切都承袭了
阿巴斯的风格！

entries.en:
You can't have a discussion about great American sports cars
without mentioning the Mustang Mach 1.

Its fastback body, where the roof slopes towards the rear
of the car, is one of the Mach 1's signature elements.

Originally introduced in 1968, it featured a front-engine,
rear-wheel-drive layout that we call "FR."

Its performance was awesome, especially in a straight line.

The 1971 model had a 7.0-liter V-8 429 Cobra Jet engine, still
one of the most powerful engines Ford has ever produced!

And the wide tires ensured that the car had plenty of traction
when you stomped on the throttle. &
entries.zh:
在讨论最出色的美国跑车时，
你不可能不提到Mustang Mach 1。

有谁能忘记那极度倾斜的斜背式“快背”车身呢？

Mach 1被认为是这种设计的
范例车型。

自然，它的性能也
非常出众。

1971年版的Mach 1搭载了一台7升V8 429 Cobra喷射引擎
——这款引擎至今仍是福特生产过的最强大的引擎之一！

宽大的轮胎进一步强化了这辆车优秀的
加速性能。

entries.en:
Even when compared to Lamborghini's other mid-engine V-12
models, this Murciélago stands out.

It came equipped with the final iteration of the V-12,
first developed for the legendary Countach.

The company's pride in its engine is evident in the name:
the LP 640 refers to the V-12's 640ps (640ps) output.

Power is transferred to all four tires, ensuring maximum
traction and grip when you're ready to get serious.6
entries.zh:
Murciélago在兰博基尼的中置V12引擎跑车中
占据了一个特殊的地位。

知道为什么吗？因为这款车是搭载了V12引擎的Countach的
最后一款有着正派血统的后继车型。

除此之外，这辆车还是纵向后置640，一款能输出
640ps的高性能型号。

凭借其四轮驱动系统，Murciélago的
稳定性也毫不逊色。{

entries.en:
Maserati has long represented the standard for luxury Italian
sports cars.

And this model, called the Gran Turismo, inherited
the company's best qualities.

Its sweet-sounding V-8 was assembled by Ferrari...

...and its front-engine/rear-wheel-drive chassis, what we call FR,
possesses lots of race car DNA.

Also, allow me to point out that the transmission was moved
for this S model to ensure optimal weight distribution...

...resulting in absolutely flawless handling, as one
would expect from a Maserati sports car.:
entries.zh:
玛莎拉蒂是意大利豪华跑车实际意义上的
标杆品牌。

这款超级跑车更是代表了此公司的
最佳品质。

它所搭载的V8引擎做工精细，由法拉利组装……

其后驱底盘的制造也是
不计成本的。

此外，S型的传动位置也作了更改，
以达成理想的前后重量分布。

这辆车的操控性无与伦比——延续玛莎拉蒂的
一贯风格。|

entries.en:
It's no secret that Mercedes-Benz and McLaren have enjoyed a
long and fruitful Formula 1 partnership.

The SLR supercar was yet another result of the two companies
working together to achieve great things.

Mercedes-Benz's 300 SLR served as the inspiration for its
development.

While the styling had a definite retro feel to it, the monocoque
structure was all high tech, composed of carbon-fiber.

Under the hood resided a supercharged V-8
that pumped out more than 600ps.

All this, and more, made this amazing machine
a true race car for the street.
entries.zh:
众所周知，梅赛德斯和迈凯伦有一段长期的
F1合作关系。

这款SLR超跑，则又是一款这两家汽车制造商的
合作结晶。

梅赛德斯的300 SLR是这款车的
开发灵感来源。

虽然整体造型只是沿用了经典设计，但其底盘采用了
现代碳纤维单体车壳。

这种设计在现代赛车中
更为常见。

它那超长的车头里装着
一台机械增压V8。

entries.en:
The Nissan Silvia went by the name 240SX in the U.S.

Among the more popular variants of this beloved Japanese
sports car was the S13, introduced in the 1980s.

In Japan, the sleek 2-door car gained many fans,
especially from the younger crowd.

The 1990 "K's" model came equipped with a turbocharged
1.8-liter inline-4 that sent power to the rear wheels.

And because all Silvias came with a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive
layout, or what we refer to as FR...

...they handled like true sports cars and felt at home on
both winding roads and the race track.
entries.zh:
日产的Silvia拥有一段悠久而著名的历史。

20世纪80年代上市的S13
是Silvia中最受欢迎的车型之一。

这款双门轿跑一经亮相便在日本流行了起来，
尤其受年轻人的追捧。

1990年的“K's”型搭载了前置1.8升
直列四缸涡轮增压引擎。

凭借其可靠的后驱性能，它将是
车手的理想之选。

此外，其紧凑的车身使得它在蜿蜒的道路和传统的赛道上
都非常具有竞争力。

entries.en:
This third-generation Prius is arguably the world's
best known hybrid car.

Its 1.8-liter engine and electric motor work together to deliver
better fuel economy and fewer harmful emissions.

This particular model features the third iteration of
Toyota's Hybrid Synergy Drive.

Thanks to the torque from the electric motor, this Prius
is surprisingly quick off the line.

Never thought you could have fun driving the Prius, did you?
entries.zh:
这是一辆第三代普锐斯——它可能是世界上最知名的
混合动力车。

它的动力来源于一个由1.8升发动机、电动马达和
电池组构成的动力系统。

此型号还搭载了第三代丰田
混合动力系统。

这辆车的引擎-马达控制得到了强化，其加速
性能也得到了提升。

这真是一辆潜力无穷的普锐斯！

entries.en:
The Toyota Supra has always been popular with racers, whether
it's grassroots racing, GT competition or rally events.

Take for example this 3.0GT Turbo A of the A70 model that was
homologated for Group A competition.

Its inline-6 M-variant engine was originally developed
for the 2000GT.

And thanks to its exclusive turbochargers, it produces
more than 270ps of power.

Only 500 units were manufactured, making this rare and unique
car one of the most collectable Supras ever.
entries.zh:
A70 Supra在房车赛和拉力赛
中都亮相过。

这辆3.0GT Turbo A甚至获得了参加A组别
竞赛的许可！

它搭载了一台原本为2000GT开发的
直列六缸M系引擎。

Turbo A的独有涡轮使其能输出超过
270ps。

这款车型最终只有500辆出厂上市。
可以说，每一辆都是Supra历史中的无价之宝。

entries.en:
This unique Countach commemorated Lamborghini's
25th anniversary in 1988.

The Diablo, introduced two years later, was meant to be
the anniversary car, but it wasn't ready in time.

So, the company asked a young Horacio Pagani, who worked for
Lambo at the time, to extensively rework the exterior.

And yes, we're talking about the same Horacio Pagani who
founded Pagani Automobili S.p.A.

Despite the slight change in looks, the car is still a beast, thanks
to its mid-mounted 5.0-liter V-12 that produced 455ps.
entries.zh:
请看，这就是Countach的最终形态——被称为
“25周年版”的车型！

这辆车上市于1988年，以庆祝兰博基尼这25年中
达成的辉煌成就。

它的再设计是在大名鼎鼎的奥拉西欧·帕加尼
的监督下进行的。

没错，他就是那个创立了
帕加尼汽车公司的人。

这辆车是集合了Countach数十年的发展经验的巅峰之作，
能为你带来近乎完美的驾驶体验。

entries.en:
This BMW sports car is, in many ways, an expression of the
manufacturer's passion for automobiles.

The chassis was redesigned from scratch, with attention
paid to every aspect of the interior and exterior.

This Z8 came only with a manual transmission...

...meaning it was intended for true driving enthusiasts
like you and me.

And when unleashed on a race track, it brought new meaning
to the phrase, "The Ultimate Driving Machine."
entries.zh:
这款宝马跑车彰显了该汽车制造商对世界各地的汽车爱好者的
许下的承诺和投入。

它的底盘是从零开始重新设计的，
车内车外的每一个细节都经过了推敲和考量。

值得注意的是，这款车型只配备了
手动变速箱。

这辆车纤细的方向盘赋予了它
出众的手感。

不过它最大的优点还是其在高速下能给你
带来的那一番狂野的体验！

entries.en:
You probably know this car as the Beetle, but its official
name is the Volkswagen Type 1.

It has a RR layout, meaning its air-cooled flat-4 engine
sits behind the rear axle and powers the rear tires.

The Beetle's unique strengths have made it a frequent
participant in drag racing and other motorsports...

...because when properly tuned, this round compact coupe
can be surprisingly quick.
entries.zh:
人们亲切地称它为“甲壳虫”。这款标志性汽车
在世界范围内都备受喜爱。

它以后置后驱的布局搭载了一台风冷平置四缸发动机，
使得其后轮能够产生大量牵引力。

这种特性让它成为了直线加速赛以及
其他汽车竞赛中的常客。

由于这款车不缺替换零件，
你可以常常在赛道上遇到飞驰的改装款甲壳虫！

entries.en:
Volkswagen has a number of famous models aside from
the Beetle, such as the "Camper."

Officially known as the Type 2, it's based on the Type 1,
which we all know better as the Beetle.

Like the Type 1, it has a rear-engine/rear-drive layout,
which we refer to as RR.

Because the designers kept the air-cooled flat-4 engine low,
there's a surprising amount of interior space.

Like the Beetle, plenty of tuning parts are available, allowing
owners to customize the car to their heart's content.
entries.zh:
这又是一款闻名世界的大众车——人们
亲切地称它为“露营者”。

它的官方代号为2型，是
基于1型——“甲壳虫”而开发的车型。

这辆车采用了后置后驱布局，搭载了一台风冷平置
四缸发动机。

较小的引擎尺寸为搭载货物让出了空间。

由于它的调校件非常好找，这辆车
开起来非常有意思。

entries.en:
The Nissan 180SX was based on the S13 Silvia.

Unlike the notchback Silvia, this car features an
exquisite fastback design.

Thanks to its rear-wheel-drive layout, it handles like a true
sports car, making it a favorite among the drift crowd.

The engine is a turbocharged 1.8-liter inline-4 that produces
175ps, so it had plenty of punch off the line.
entries.zh:
日产180SX是S13 Silvia的衍生车型。

不同于凹背的Silvia，这款双门跑车
采用了掀背风格。

作为一款后驱车，它的操控性优良，
调校得当后的牵引力也十足。

它还是一台可靠的漂移车，许多喜欢漂移的车手都对它情有独钟。

entries.en:
The R5 Turbo was among the hottest rally cars in the 1980s.

While the base R5 came as a front-engine car, Renault
converted the R5 Turbo into a mid-engine machine.

This improved the car's off-road balance, resulting in numerous
rallying championships all over the world.

It's fair to say that the heavy rear could be
a bit jittery at times...

...but its unique driving character makes it more appealing
to many tarmac rally drivers!
entries.zh:
R5 Turbo是80年代拉力赛事中的明星。

近年来，参赛队伍把量产车改成
中置引擎布局也不是什么新鲜事……

但在80年代，这一做法还相当新颖。

虽然这车的后端确实比较重，而且
偶尔不太稳……

但是柏油路拉力赛才是它
展现实力的地方！

entries.en:
The first Civic Type R appeared with the EK model.

Despite its size and weight, it boasts a high-revving
naturally-aspirated engine that produced 185ps.

To match the extra power, Honda increased the rigidity
of the overall structure, while reducing weight.

The result is a true pocket rocket that's able to keep
up with genuine sports cars costing way more.

This particular variant is a late-model release.

Once you drive it, you won't be surprise to learn that the
"R" in its name stood for racing.
entries.zh:
这款EK是最早的思域“Type R”。

虽然它尺寸小，重量轻，但仍搭载了一台能产生185ps的高转速自然
吸气引擎。

它的底盘也经过了大幅改造，减轻了重量，
增强了刚性。

这辆车的基础底盘比第一款型格Type R
先进了一代。

虽然体量小，但它的速度是毋容置疑的。

这款车是较晚推出的款型，保险杠和车灯的细节
与先前推出的款型稍有不同。?

entries.en:
The Chevrolet Corvette really came into its own with the C4
model, especially with the ZR-1 performance package.

Its 32-valve V-8 pumped out an impressive 380ps...

...making it as powerful as many V-12-powered supercars of
its day, including the incredible Ferrari Testarossa!

Interestingly, the car was designed by Lotus, which was part of
General Motors at the time, and here's another fun fact:

The C4 ZR-1 was the first Corvette to be equipped with a 6-speed
manual transmission.
entries.zh:
现今最强劲的科尔维特都发源于这款
第四代科尔维特，C4 ZR-1。

它搭载了一台32阀V8双顶置凸轮轴引擎，马力高达380ps。

这台引擎的马力能与当时名声显赫的
法拉利Testarossa搭载的V12一比高低！

有趣的是，这台引擎是由当时仍是通用汽车子公司的
莲花跑车所设计的。

C4 ZR-1也是第一款配备了
六速手动变速箱的科尔维特。

entries.en:
Many Japanese sports-car enthusiasts refer to the original
Datsun 240Z by its in-house codename, the S30.

Powering the car is a 2.4-liter inline-6, mounted up front
and powering the rear wheels.

One of the more intriguing examples is the 240ZG, which has
a slightly different front-end from the base car.

Called the G-nose, the extended hood lengthened the car by
about 190mm and gives it a more exotic presence.

The car's revised profile isn't only for looks. It improves its
aerodynamics, raising its top speed by about <5km/h>.
entries.zh:
日产S30是有史以来最优秀、
最受欢迎的日产跑车之一。

这款高性能的240Z衍生型——240ZG，搭载了一台
2.4升直列六缸引擎。

这辆车的加长车头是最明显的变化之一，
许多人亲切地称之为“G鼻”。

相比240Z，这一改动使车辆的
总长度延伸了190mm。

它的“大鼻子”不单是为了好看——这一改动还优化了
车身的空气动力特性，使240ZG的最高时速提升了大约<5km/h>。

entries.sourceName: Impreza Coupe WRX Type R STi Version VI '99
entries.en:
This first-generation Impreza Type R STi Version Vi is known
among Subaru fans as the "ultimate GC8."

GC8 was the in-house name of the first-gen Impreza, with
the "C" representing the chassis code.

The Type R STi is special because it possesses way more rigidity
than the base model, thanks partly to its coupe design.

The accessories are also simple and effective, making
the car look rally-race ready.

Because of its compact nature, its all-wheel-drive system and
remarkable agility, this machine shines on tight circuits!
entries.zh:
初代翼豹也被称作GC8。
C是底盘代号。

有许多人将Type R STi Version VI
称为“终极GC8”。

这个称号的由来之一便是双门车体
所带来的刚性提升。

该车的内饰相当简洁，非常符合
赛车的定位。

翼豹特别适合狭窄的赛道——没有其他车比它更适合用来
感受曲折道路的刺激魅力！

entries.en:
When it comes to front-drive performance cars, Honda is
among the world's elites.

One of its FF jewels was the Integra Type R, the second 'Type R'
to ever appear after the incredible NSX Type R.

Under its hood is a 1.8-liter naturally-aspirated inline-4,
that revs all the way up to an incredible 8500rpm!

Did you know the technology that went into this engine trickled
down from Honda's participation in Formula 1 racing?

It possesses a special undercarriage too, making the car
super stable at high speeds.

Thanks to its power and razor-sharp handling, this 1998 Spec R
is totally at home at the race track.;
entries.zh:
形格Type R是一款相当有名的
前驱跑车。

这是继NSX Type R之后上市的
第二款Type R车型。

它搭载了一台性能优异的1.8升自然吸气
直列四缸引擎。

这台引擎的红线达到了8500rpm，能在高转速区间
产出强大的动力。

得益于其轻量的车体和坚硬的悬挂，
这辆车有能力攻克任何急弯。

这款车型是98年Spec R，该晚期车款的底盘得到了改进，
稳定性更佳。

entries.en:
There have been many Lancer Evolution models over the years,
and among the most popular of all was the Evo V.

In fact, today, its a highly sought after collectible, with people
all over the world clamoring to get their hands on one.

The sport-tuned suspension really shines when you
whip the car around a race track.

Its turbocharged engine has power to spare, and the aerodynamic
body makes the car look race-ready as ever, don't you think?
entries.zh:
这款翼豪陆神V是有史以来最受欢迎
的蓝瑟翼豪陆神车型。

实际上，现在仍有许多人想
拥有这款车。

开着它上赛道时，
你便会体验到它的硬悬挂所带来的优势。

这些专为A组别赛事认证规定而设计的空气动力车身部件
一定会吸引许多眼球！

entries.en:
Toyota's Corolla Levin, aka AE86, has become the stuff of legends,
especially after being featured in manga and the movies!

It isn't the most powerful car around, with 130ps coming
from its 4-cylinder engine, but it does rev to 7000rpm!

What most fans love about it is that it has a front-engine/
rear-wheel-drive layout, or FR as we say in the industry.

It's light and agile, and wonderfully fun to drive. I would
recommend that you put one in your garage!
entries.zh:
AE86卡罗拉Levin是一款由丰田制造的紧凑型前置后驱车，
亦是一项工程杰作——这辆车一年比一年受欢迎。

虽然130ps的输出功率不高，
但它的自然吸气四缸引擎能达到7000rpm的转速！

除此之外，它轻巧的车身和后驱布局也使
得它很适合在赛道上疾驰。

在经过适当的调校后，Levin有能力在各种赛事中比拼，
所以在车库里备一辆有利无弊！

entries.en:
You don't see many affordable mid-engine sports cars, but
Toyota threw caution to the wind and produced the MR2.

While the first-gen model had quirky styling, this final revision,
called in-house as the SW20, looks like a mini exotic.

It handles like an exotic too, thanks to a sport-tuned
suspension system and quick steering responses.

The engine, mounted behind the GT-S' cockpit, is a turbo
2.0-liter inline-4 that pumps out an impressive 245ps.
entries.zh:
丰田MR2是一款中置引擎跑车。

SW20是对此的第二次也是最后一次修订
模型，以其先进的处理而闻名。

此GT-S等级配备2升直列四缸涡轮增压
引擎能够达到245ps。

更重要的是，这辆车的后备箱超大！
非常适合用来装一大堆行李。

entries.en:
Nowadays, when you see "Type R," it means that you're looking
at a Honda sports car with over-the-top performance.

And, the first to wear this badge was the first-gen NSX,
considered the company's premiere super sports car.

With the Acura NSX Type R, Honda created something that was
virtually race ready, brimming with Formula 1 technology.

One of the more notable aspects of the NSX Type R is its curb
weight, which is 120kg lighter than the base model.

The special Acura exotic also possesses a custom-tuned
suspension system, as well as special sports tires.
entries.zh:
这款NSX Type R是本田Type R车系中的第一款车型，
同时也是最传奇的车型之一。

初代NSX就已经是性能极为
强悍的跑车了。

而这辆Type R更是专门针对赛道性能而
做出优化的衍生车型。

具体来讲，这辆车的重量被尽可能地削减了，
比基础车型还轻了120kg。

其配备的悬挂和轮胎也为
Type R进行了量身定制。[

entries.en:
Honda was nice enough to celebrate its 50th birthday
by giving us the S2000 sports car.

It was the company's first front-engine/rear-drive roadster, or
FR as we say in the biz, since the S800 we last saw in 1970.

Born from the company's Formula 1 experience was the car's
amazing 2.0-liter inline-4 engine.

It is naturally aspirated and revved to an incredible 9000rpm,
but some complained that it lacked low-end torque.

That wasn't enough to deter fans from owning this wonderful
convertible, because Honda sold the car for 10 years.

Another cool tidbit about the S2000 is that it was one of the
first production cars to feature an "Engine Start" button.
entries.zh:
S2000车型发布于本田公司50周年庆之际。

它是该公司自S800以来推出的第一台前置后驱双座敞篷跑车，
堪称呕心沥血之作。

该车采用顶级的自然进气直列四缸引擎。

它的专属定制配置使其转速能在眨眼间
达到惊人的9000rpm之高。

在当时，这款早期版本的汽车引擎曾一度
被一些人批评为“太过极端”...

但在其停产后的数年里，S2000标志性的
灵敏反应性让它收获了很多粉丝。

entries.en:
Not many people know that Honda has been in the sports car
business for a long time, since the 1960s actually.

Back then, the company produced the S600, which evolved
to become the S800, a compact open-top sports car.

Under its hood is a DOHC 4-cylinder engine that sends power
to the rear wheels, meaning that it has an FR layout.

Beginning with the S600, the size of the engine grew over time,
from the prototype's 360cc to 500cc, then to 600cc.

As you might guess from the S800's name, this one came with
a 791cc engine that produced 70ps.
entries.zh:
S系列跑车是本田跑车的起源。

它是一款后轮驱动的敞篷双座跑车，
配备了直列四缸双顶置凸轮轴引擎。

随着时间的推移，S车系的引擎排量逐渐
增加，从原型车的360cc到500cc再到600cc。

S800的排量还要更大一些，达到了791cc，
使其能够拥有70ps。

显然，它是S2000车型的灵感来源，
且在本质上一脉相承。

entries.en:
How familiar are you with the SilEighty?

This unique Japanese entity emerged from the 1990s' street-racing
scene, courtesy of Japanese aftermarket specialists.

The reason this car existed at all was because the Nissan Silvia S13
and the 180SX shared the same front end.

Therefore, it was easy to stick the Silvia's face onto the
body of an 180SX, thus combining the "Sil" and "Eighty."

While not an official Nissan offering, the car did manage to
gain a certain amount of popularity back in the day.
entries.zh:
你熟悉Sileighty吗？

这款独特的日本车诞生于20世纪90年代
的街头赛车现场。

因为S13 Silvia和180SX有相同的底盘，
和相同的前部结构，所以这才造就了这款车型的诞生。

“用180SX的车身搭配Silvia的车头。”
这样简单的改装非常容易实现。

Sileighty这款独特的改装车就这样在
人们追求趣味创新的过程中诞生。

entries.en:
Toyota has produced some very cool sports cars over the years,
but one of the most memorable could be the Sports 800.

Introduced in 1965, it was called the "Yota-Hachi."

It was the first Japanese production model to feature aluminum
bodywork, so the car is extremely lightweight.

Weighing only 580kg, it's half the size of today's cars.

While its air-cooled flat-2 produces only 45ps, you can be
sure that it's a true sports car, thanks to its FR layout.8
