entries.zh:
Sports 800是丰田跑车设计制造史上
一大杰作，诞生于20世纪60年代。

在日本，它以“田8”的昵称
为人们所熟知...

Sports 800是首款采用铝制面板的
日产车型。

因此它的车身极为轻巧。

尽管它的风冷水平对置双缸引擎只能产生45ps，
但它开起来就像是一辆真正的跑车。!

entries.en:
One of the most popular "retro" sports cars today is the
4th-generation Toyota Supra, also called the "80 Supra".

At a recent auction, one went for sale for a half-million dollars.
That's more than ten times the car's original price tag!

This car is all about performance, armed with the 2JZ-GTE
engine that's easy to tune for more power.
entries.zh:
丰田Supra RZ，又称“80 Supra”，
是日本前置后驱跑车工程技术上的杰作。

只要调校得当，它的涡轮增压直列六缸
2JZ-GTE引擎能够发挥出不凡的性能。

无论是比赛、直线加速还是漂移，
它都不会让你失望。

entries.en:
There were two versions of the Toyota AE86 that were released
at the same time: the Trueno and the Levin.

Do you know which was the more popular one? If you guessed
the Levin, you're absolutely right.

But this means that there are fewer used Truenos around today,
making them more of a collector's car than the Levin.

You can tell the difference between the cars by the headlights.
The Trueno has retractable ones, while the Levin's are fixed.

Under the hood is the 4A-G, a reliable 1.6-liter inline-4.

The front-engine/rear-drive sports car, or FR, weighs only
900kg, making it a fun car to toss around corners.
entries.zh:
哪一款AE86车型在发售时更受欢迎，
Trueno还是Levin？

不管你是否相信，Levin更受欢迎。
但不用为Trueno感到遗憾！

由于在发售之初缺乏人气，二手Trueno数量现在非常稀少，
如今已经成为了人们梦寐以求的收藏品。

Trueno的4A-G引擎是一款久经考验的1.6升直列四缸引擎...

它在过渡到更高转速范围时非常强劲
有力，也因此而闻名。

对于想要提高车技的车手来说，
Trueno作为一款车重约900kg的前置后驱跑车，正是他们的绝佳之选。

entries.sourceName: Sprinter Trueno 3door 1600GT APEX (AE86 Shuichi Shigeno Version) '00
entries.en:
I'm sure you know the Japanese manga called "Initial D."
If not, you might want to check out the anime series.

The automotive star of the show was the Toyota AE86, and
this exposure increased the car's popularity tenfold.

Initial D creator, Shuichi Shigeno, was a big fan of the car and
wanted the main character, Takumi Fujiwara, to own one.

The manga was first published in 1995 and an anime series
soon followed, reaching a huge global audience.
entries.zh:
AE86的人气经久不衰，众多原因之一
就是它在《头文字D》系列漫画中有着重要的地位。

头文字D的作者重野秀一是这款车的
死忠粉。

它采用自然进气引擎，是能够体现
高超调校技术的典型代表。

驾驶这款车就仿佛是在驾驶藤原拓海的
AE86，给人一种穿越到漫画中的感觉！

entries.en:
AMG was once an independent tuner of Mercedes-Benz vehicles,
but after being purchased by the German automaker...

...it's now the company's in-house performance division. Among
the cool cars it has produced recently is the SLS AMG.

It came equipped with the AMG-developed M159 V-8 mated to
a quick-shifting 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox.

The body featured gullwing doors, like the original 300SL,
giving the SLS AMG a link to Mercedes-Benz's past.
entries.zh:
德国汽车制造公司AMG一直长期致力于
生产高性能的梅赛德斯-奔驰车辆。

而他们的技术实力在这款SLS AMG前置后驱
超级跑车的底盘上得到了充分体现。

它采用AMG研发的M159自然进气V8引擎，
在过渡到更高转速时会发出轰鸣。

尽管它的驾驶体验朴实无华，
但驾驶者一定会发现其专注的性能非常令人满意。]

entries.en:
Mechanical music for the soul. Yeah, that's what Ferrari V8s
are all about. No sound is more pleasant to the ears.

The beautiful 458 Italia introduced in 2010 came equipped
with one of Ferrari's sweetest-sounding engines.

Equipped with direct injection, the naturally-aspirated 4.5-liter
produced 570ps and redlined at an incredible 9000rpm.

It came mated to an F1-inspired 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox.

The rest of the car handled like a dream, with amazing cornering
balance befitting of a mid-engine/rear-drive exotic.

Taking on a race track with that Ferrari V8 singing behind
your ear is as close as you'll get to automotive nirvana.
entries.zh:
热爱法拉利自然进气V8引擎的人
绝不该错过458 Italia。

其引擎的全新设计采用了燃油喷射，
最高能够产生570ps。

它配有高转速单元，转速红线高达
9000rpm，使得引擎性能更上一层楼，其轰鸣声也无与伦比。

可想而知，它的操作十分快速且反应性灵敏。

它也确实几乎能够在你看到弯道的瞬间
就开始转向。

此外，它的七速双离合变速箱也是一项
令人极为印象深刻的技术。

entries.en:
The third-generation Corvette, also known as the C3, is one
of the most recognizable American cars in history.

One look and you know immediately that it's a 'Vette, right?

Inspired by the Mako Shark II concept vehicle designed by
Larry Shinoda, the C3 epitomized 1960s and 1970s style.

Under its hood was a no-nonsense V-8, whose displacement
was dependent on the model you chose.

In the 1970s, engine power was reduced to comply with
environmental regulations that resulted from the oil crisis.

But those changes predated this 1969 model, allowing drivers
to enjoy the Corvette C3 the way it was meant to be enjoyed.
entries.zh:
第三代科尔维特，又称“C3”，是该系列
迄今为止最受欢迎的一款车型。

它的车身采用玻璃纤维增强塑料制成...

克尔维特充分利用这种柔性材料的优势
创造出了绝妙的设计，一经推出便即刻走红。

人们曾将其独特的轮廓比作一个可乐瓶！

在20世纪70年代石油危机期间，为了遵守
环境法规，C3的动力性能遭到了削减。

这款1969年的车型生产于削减之前，因此
鉴赏家们能够尽情享受到这个“美人”全速下的速度与激情。

entries.en:
When you think of McLaren road cars, the 3-seat F1 might come
to mind, but the MP4-12C is also pretty impressive.

Standing for "McLaren Project 4" from a merger with Project 4
headed by McLaren's former race director Ron Dennis...

...the MP4-12C comes equipped with a twin-turbo V-8
mounted amidships in a carbon-fiber chassis.

It also features the company's high-tech "ProActive Chassis
Control" suspension, making this car one amazing handler.

In fact, the arrival of the MP4-12C saw market share moving
from Ferrari to McLaren, kickstarting a nice little rivalry.

It was a good thing for customers because whether you went
with a British or Italian supercar, you couldn't go wrong.
entries.zh:
MP4-12C车型有着迈凯伦汽车中最具辨识度的中置引擎...

它是继传奇F1跑车之后迈凯伦设计制造的首款公路跑车。

搭载V8双涡轮增压引擎，搭配兼具高强
度和轻量化的碳纤维复合底盘。

此外，它还搭载了迈凯伦引以为傲的
“主动式底盘控制系统”悬挂。

在握住方向盘的那一刻，你就会发现它具
有非凡的抓地性能...

驾驶这款车的幸福感可谓如梦似幻。
[

entries.en:
For those who wanted to drive a sporty German car, but didn't
want a sedan or boxy coupe, Audi created the TT.

The round compact body made it stand out in a crowd,
blending sportiness with elegance.

And when you stepped into its cabin, you were
greeted with a stylish interior.

Under the car's hood was a smooth-revving 3.2-liter V-6
that produced 250ps.

The torquey engine sent power to either the front wheels
or all four tires via Audi's signature quattro system.

This version is one of the most popular of the first-gen TTs.
entries.zh:
初代奥迪TT是奥迪历史上厥功至伟的杰作。

它是奥迪第一款真正的跑车，车厂在它的
研发中倾注了大量的心血。

一言以蔽之，他们研发出的这款双门跑车
是一台绝对的上品...

而奥迪在工艺上的极致追求也在这其中
得到了充分体现。

搭载的3.2升V6 quattro是一款令人
生畏的引擎，能够产生高达250ps。

这是初代TT中最受欢迎的版本之一。

entries.en:
Looking for help improving your track-driving skills? Then
look no further than this front-wheel-drive Honda.

This EK version of the Civic Type R was made for people like
you to shred on the race track.

And because it has a low center of gravity, the car has
very predictable handling, keeping you out of trouble.

Its 4-cylinder engine delivers seamless power, making it
easy for anyone to look like a pro on the circuit.
entries.zh:
想要提高你的赛车技巧？那么你应该考虑
选择一辆高性能汽车。

这款EK思域Type R就是专为赛道驾驶所调校设计。

EK思域以它的轻量化和低重心闻名，是
一款底子扎实的基础车型。

这也是为什么它成为新手
在摸索阶段的可靠之选。

entries.en:
There aren't many front-engine/front-wheel-drive cars out there
that you can call sporty, but the Scirocco R is one of them.

With its low height and wide body, you can tell that the
2-door coupe is all business just by looking at it.

Hidden under the sheet metal is a custom sport-tuned suspension
that gives the Scirocco R real sports-car handling.

And the car's turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 packs a mean
250ps punch, making it a monster on the race track.8
entries.zh:
想要一款前置前驱跑车来帮助你从人群中脱颖而出？
大众尚酷R就能够满足你的需求。

尚酷R具有低高度、宽车架的特点，其设计
自豪宣称专为赛车运动而生。

专属定制的悬挂和刹车设计使得它能够在
弯道拥有卓越表现...

它的2升直列四缸涡轮增压引擎能够产生最高250ps，
使它远比一般车辆的动力更为强大。2

entries.en:
Although Alpine isn't well known in the U.S., this French
company has built some great cars, notably the A110.

This vehicle was one of the great rally cars of the 1970s.

Its RR layout made it an instant rival of the Porsche 911,
which it beat on multiple occasions.

Its fiber-glass construction made it extremely lightweight,
which was the secret to its speed and handling.

And it was instantly recognizable by its unique face.

Take the time to study its cockpit and the exquisitely
arranged five gauges mounted on its dashboard.
entries.zh:
这款雷诺阿尔派A110跑车是汽车史上最闪耀的明星之一。

它的名气很大程度上归功于其在拉力赛中的表现。

更具体地说，它曾多次击败另一款备受
赞誉的后置后驱跑车——保时捷911。

由纤维强化塑料制成的轻量化车身结构
可以说是它最大的优势之一。

而它在弯道上的表现也首屈一指。

它的驾驶舱和仪表盘上精致排列的五个仪
表也非常值得花些时间去研究。

entries.en:
Perhaps the most famous of all rally race cars is the
Lancia Stratos. It's also one of the best looking.

This mid-engine marvel first emerged on the rally scene
in the 1970s.

Thanks to its amazing power and handling, it won several world
championship titles.

The car was designed by Marcello Gandini, who also penned
a number of classic Lamborghinis.

Powering the car was the same engine as the Ferrari Dino.

The Stratos has already become a highly sought collector's car
with a six-figure price tag!
entries.zh:
Stratos是一款优秀的双座敞篷车，由备受
敬仰的拉力赛车制造商蓝旗亚推出。

这款奇妙的中置引擎车型于20世纪70年代
在拉力赛场上首度亮相。

它的速度和动力使它夺得了多项世界冠军。

这款车的风格设计由汽车设计的传奇性
人物马塞罗·甘迪尼负责。

它的引擎采用了和法拉利Dino 246相同的V6。

要知道，没有多少车的性能能比它更出色了！

entries.en:
The Pontiac Firebird was built to compete with the Mustang.

The high-performance version, called the Trans Am, gained
widespread fame in the movie "Smokey and the Bandit."

Despite the oil crisis of the 1970s, Pontiac elected to
retain the large V-8 engine in subsequent designs.

This particular model is the second-generation Firebird
Trans Am that came equipped with a 6.6-liter V-8.

You can call it the Chevrolet Camaro's brother because both
were built by General Motors.

The two cars were historically called the F-body pony cars.~
entries.zh:
庞蒂亚克火鸟是福特Mustang的最著名的竞争对手之一。

它的高性能版本Trans Am永远地改写了
美国跑车历史的进程。

尽管选择了在后续设计中保留大排量的V8引擎。

这个特殊的车型就是第二代
火鸟Trans Am。

它发布于1978年，搭载前置6.6升V8引擎。

对于许多人来说，
庞蒂亚克仍然经典的“肌肉车”。]

entries.en:
The Diablo is the direct successor of the Lamborghini Countach.

Like its predecessor, it comes with a V-12 and scissor doors.

There was a GTR model that was developed exclusively
for GT racing.

And there was this GT model, a road-going version of the GTR,
designed for public roads.

The car's engine is awesome, delivering 575ps, making it
the most powerful in the Diablo lineup.

And when you rev the thing to near its redline,
it sings in a sweet melodic voice.

Only 80 units of the Diablo GT were made, making it one of
the rarest and most spectacular Lamborghinis in history.
entries.zh:
Diablo是兰博基尼Countach的直系继承者。

搭载V12引擎，继承了Countach的剪刀门设计。

Diablo意为恶魔，车如其名，其顶尖的技术和性能近乎鬼怪。
Diablo GTR版本专为超跑赛事设计。

而其超跑车型是GTR车型的公路版本。

超跑车型能够产生最大575ps，
是Diablo马力最强劲的量产车型。

如你所料，它有着绝对悦耳的赛车引擎音。

这款车总共只生产了80台，成为了有史以
来最为稀有和最引人关注的兰博基尼车型之一。

entries.en:
The Toyota Aqua is one of the most fuel-efficient cars
on the planet, thanks to its hybrid drivetrain.

It comes powered by a 1.5-liter inline-4 and an electric motor.

The Aqua's system is called Hybrid Synergy Drive, which is
similar to the one used in the Prius.

The battery, which is the usually the heaviest component
of the system, is placed under the rear seats.

This results in lots of interior space and excellent weight
distribution, making this vehicle surprising fun to drive.
entries.zh:
丰田致享由1.5升四缸引擎搭配电机驱动。

这样的车被称为“混合动力汽车”。

致享的混合动力系统是基于普锐斯动力系统
特别设计。

为它提供动力的沉重电池位于后排座椅
下方，接近车的中心位置。

它绝佳的重量分配使得其能够实现精准的
转向，并提供稳定的驾驶体验。

entries.en:
The Impreza 22B made quite a splash in the World Rally
Championship in the 1990s.

This replica model is based on the Impreza that
dominated the series.

Its price tag was set at roughly twice of the
Impreza WRX's...

...but the 400 units produced sold out immediately!

The car not only looks meaner than the original WRX, it comes
with a custom 2.2-liter boxer engine.

Because it provides more torque than the turbocharged 2.0-liter
engine of the base model, the 22B is noticeably quicker.
entries.zh:
20世纪90年代世界拉力锦标赛的所有粉丝
都会把翼豹22B列入他们的必买汽车清单。

翼豹在拉力赛的黄金时代取得了巨大的成
功，而这款车型正是它的复刻版。

它在发售时的价格几乎是翼豹WRX的两倍...

但当时生产的400台还是瞬间就被抢购一空！

这个版本的特别之处不仅在于外观上的
升级，还有专属定制的2.2升引擎。

它能够产生比2升涡轮增压引擎更大的
扭矩，保证了扎实的加速性能和令人满意的速度。

entries.en:
The Dino 246 GT remains one of the most famous creations
from the great Italian car maker.

This compact 2-seater was equipped with a mid-mounted V-6.

I've heard it affectionately referred to as "the piccolo,"
which means "little one" in Italian.

The lovely lines of the car were penned by Pininfarina.

It was named after company founder Enzo Ferrari's eldest
son, Alfredo, who was nicknamed Dino.

Today, the Dino 246GT is a highly sought collector's car
that fetches at least a six-figure sum.
entries.zh:
Dino 246 GT是20世纪60年代所生产的
最优秀的法拉利汽车之一。

这款紧凑型双座跑车采用了中置V6引擎。

我听过有人亲切地叫它“piccolo”，
在意大利语里是“小不点”的意思。

这款车的优美设计出自宾尼法利纳公司之手。

哦，如果你好奇Dino系列名字的起源...

它的命名是为了纪念恩佐·法拉利的长子，
阿尔弗雷多·迪诺·法拉利。

entries.en:
For many, this car represents the quintessential Japanese
high-performance car of the 1990s.

Mitsubishi's GTO Twin Turbo was marketed as a "super
4WD sports vehicle."

And it is. It has both all-wheel drive and 4-wheel steering,
not to mention active aerodynamics.

It came powered by a twin-turbocharged V-6.

The high-tech nature of the GTO, called the 3000GT in
the U.S., truly made it a car before its time.+
entries.zh:
对于许多人来说，三菱GTO Twin Turbo是
20世纪90年代最典型的日产高性能车。

它在营销时被称为“超级四驱跑车”。

这款车结合了四轮驱动和四轮转向系统，
同时运用了主动式空气动力学系统……

它可以说是满载了各类先进技术。

而其采用的前置V6双涡轮增压引擎让人尤为惊喜。

entries.en:
Those in the market for a reasonable mid-engine sports car
won't be disappointed with this one.

The Honda Beat was built in accordance with Japanese "kei
car" specifications.

It features a naturally-aspirated inline-3 engine, with
individual throttle-bodies on all three cylinders.

There's some motorcycle technology in this unit because
it can rev to 8000rpm.

Because of its sporty nature and mid-engine layout,
it was often referred to as a baby NSX.

Although it was marketed only in Japan, the car
developed a following around the world.
entries.zh:
如果想在市场上寻觅价格合理的中置引擎
跑车，那么这款车必定不会让你失望。

本田Beat按照日本轻型车标准制造。

它采用自然进气三缸引擎，且三个气缸
全部带有独立节流阀。

这款惊艳的车型能够在日常使用中将转速
提高到超过8000rpm。

这样的轻型跑车在20世纪90年的日本
格外受欢迎...

而本田Beat则因身处这一潮流的最前沿而闻名。

entries.en:
When it comes to Japanese compact cars, the Honda Fit
is one of the best of the bunch.

This is the third-generation Fit, a hybrid model that’s
powered by electric motors as well as an engine.

What's more, the motors in this model are twice as powerful
as those in the second-generation version.

The vehicle really gets going as soon as you put your foot down,
thanks to its abundance of low-end torque.
entries.zh:
说到日本小型汽车，很难有车能够超越
本田飞度。

这是第三代飞度，是一款搭载电机和燃气动
力引擎的混合动力汽车。

此外，第三代汽车电机的功率是第二代汽车的两倍。

在你踩下油门的瞬间扭矩就会开始运转，
这使它成为一款动力十足而又易于操作的小车。

entries.en:
The BMW M3 is truly an ultimate driving machine.

The Sport Evolution of the first-gen model was really special.

It was homologated for the Deutsche Tourenwagen
Masters.

The displacement of the engine was increased to 2.5 liters.

It also sported a custom spoiler and other aerodynamic parts
that made it look meaner than the stock M3.

If you're looking for a classic front-engine/rear-wheel-drive
touring car, you won't find many better than this one.
entries.zh:
第一代M3是最受欢迎的宝马汽车之一...

而运动进化版则是其格外引人瞩目的一个版本。

该车型经由德国房车大师赛认证。

其引擎排量在M3基础上被增加到2.5升。

它在外观上也有一些改变，例如，它配备
的专属定制扰流器使它看起来和普通的M3略有不同。

大部分M3系列车型都很受欢迎，而其中这款车型，事实证明，
在众多M3车型中尤为热门。8

entries.en:
This third-generation E46 M3 remains one of the best-loved
models since BMW created the "M" division in 1972.

It came with an inline-6 under its hood, produced and
tuned by the company's motorsports division.

The engine was flawlessly matched to the chassis,
which combined, resulted in excellent handling.

Not only was it a capable performer, it was a great
touring car as well.
entries.zh:
第三代E46 M3是二手车市场上最炙手可热
的车型。

它所搭载的定制直列六缸引擎由宝马M
生产，属于该公司的室内赛车系列。

这次工程技术上的胜利爆发出大鸣大放的马力，
产生出的引擎声使人精神为之一振。

其紧凑的车身在当时也相当时尚。

entries.en:
If you're looking for something that'll give you a sense of what
a muscle car was, then give the Dodge Super Bee a look.

The size of the car was modest compared to its rivals,
billed back then as an "intermediate sedan."

But there was nothing intermediate about its power.
It came with a massive 6.0-liter V-8!

The thing rumbled like thunder when provoked, making the car
one of the fastest of its day.
entries.zh:
如果你要寻求纯粹的肌肉车体验，
那么道奇Super Bee无疑可以满足你。

这款车身稍偏小的
所谓“中型”轿车之下...

隐藏着一个巨大的V8引擎，
排气量高达6升以上！

毋庸赘言，其动力之充足，
不会让车手有丝毫怨言。.

entries.en:
The fourth-generation Demio, which made its debut in 2014,
is perhaps best known for its diesel engine.

It's a turbocharged 1.5-liter inline-4 developed especially for
compact cars.

It delivers 20kgm of torque in the low-RPM range that results
in a gratifying sensation when you take off from a standstill.

The car’s stable handling was also a major selling point, thanks
to the wheelbase that’s longer than the previous model.
entries.zh:
第四代Demio于2014年首次亮相，
最出名的可能就是它的汽油引擎。

这个1.5升直列四缸涡轮引擎，
专为紧凑型的车款而研制。

在低转速范围内能够超过20kgm，
真正运转起来时感觉很棒。

与上一型号相比轴距明显加长，
使其操控更加稳定。

entries.en:
The tradition of Ferrari's mid-engine V-8 began with
the 308.

The car's elegant wedge-shaped design, penned
by Pininfarina, made it instantly popular.

And its basic proportions were inherited by later V-8 models.

Thanks to its head-turning looks, the 308 also appeared
in many movies and TV series.

Its compact body made it lightweight and agile, while
the V-8 let out a truly melodic roar.

This 1975 model came equipped with both fuel injectors and
carburetors.

The wonderful engine and the responsive chassis
made this car as fun to drive as it was to look at.
entries.zh:
传统的法拉利中置引擎V8车型始于
308系列。

确实，这一车型无疑具有真正的
历史价值。

它的设计正是出自宾尼法利纳之手。

随后的V8车型继承了其
时尚的比例。

它的紧凑型车身轻盈而敏捷，
性感的引擎音非常悦耳。

这款1975年的车型同时采用燃油喷射和
化油器。

灵敏的油门使得这款车型更趋完美，
让你真正享受引擎的咆哮。

entries.en:
Ruf is a German automotive manufacturer that uses Porsche
components to construct high-performance vehicles.

Their most impressive production line is the CTR series.

The first-generation CTR, dubbed the Yellowbird, was based
on the Porsche 911.

This CTR3 is the third-generation model which debuted
in 2007.

It uses the longest mid-engine chassis that Ruf have
developed.

The 3.8L flat-six twin turbo can generate
up to 700ps of power.
entries.zh:
如虎是一家德国汽车车厂，使用保时捷
零部件来打造高性能车辆。

他们最出名的生产线是CTR系列。

基于保时捷911开发的第一代CTR，
也获得了黄鸟这个称号。

这款CTR3是第三代车型，
于2007年首度亮相。

它使用了最长的中置引擎底盘，
由如虎研制。

3.8升的水平对置六缸双涡轮引擎能够产生
高达700ps。

entries.en:
No historical account of 4WD vehicles would be
complete without mentioning the Willys MB.

It is, simply put, the granddaddy of
the modern-day Jeep.

The Willy MB was developed in 1940, at the start of WWII,
at the behest of the U.S. Army.

The task? To build a sturdy, compact machine
with superior off-road performance.

As you know by now, the Willys MB
successfully rose to the challenge.

After the war, Willys started selling the MB
as a general-purpose vehicles.

It was around this time that the term Jeep
came into common use.

Thanks to its efficiency off the beaten path, the original Jeep
remains the epitome of off-road vehicles to this day.
entries.zh:
如果要讲述四驱车的历史，威利斯MB
绝对是绕不过去的存在。

事实上，它才是人气持久的Jeep车型的“鼻祖”。

这辆车于二次世界大战初期
按照美国陆军指定的规格开发。

开发的目的？当然是打造一辆具有超强越野性能，
但又皮实紧凑的车辆。

可以想象，威利斯MB完美地达成了这一目标。

战后，威利斯开始将MB作为“通用型”车辆投入市场。

也正是在这一时期，“Jeep”这个称呼开始被广泛接受。

由于出色的设计和越野性能，吉普在今天
仍然是四驱车的典范。

entries.en:
Many consider the Maserati Merak as one of the most beautiful
mid-engine supercars of the 1970s.

Introduced in 1975, the Merak SS was the high-performance
grade in the lineup.

This 1980 version of the SS came with a 220ps V-6 engine.

And, it was true 2+2, meaning although it was a 2-door,
it came with rear seats.

The elegant lines of the car still look fresh today, a testament
to the genius of Giorgetto Giugiaro, who designed the car.
entries.zh:
玛莎拉蒂Merak是1970年代最漂亮最独特的
中置引擎超跑之一。

Merak SS问世于1975年，
是高性能版车款。

这款1980年发售的车型搭载
马力为220ps的V6引擎。

像所有2+2车型一样，它配备
两个小型后座以备不时之需。

强大的马力与完美的样式，
Merak完美诠释了内外兼备。

entries.en:
The De Tomaso Pantera is what I consider to be
an underappreciated American supercar.

The Italian maker Carrozzeria Ghia designed the body.

It came powered by a Ford-built 5.7-liter V-8 engine.

Its look is reminiscent of Italian exotics of its day, and it
still looks as fresh today as it did in 1971.
entries.zh:
德托马索Pantera是一款概念赛车，
与公路版福特GT40不同。

车身由意大利制造商
车身制造公司吉亚设计。

它配备福特自有的5.7升V8引擎。

意大利超跑的优美感与美国肌肉车的
原始动力，两者皆集大成于Pantera。

entries.en:
The first-generation Golf GTI has become a true classic because
it ushered in a new generation of European hot hatches.

Like many hatchbacks of its day, it employs an FF layout,
or front-engine/front-wheel drive.

The car's 1.6-liter inline-4 produces 110ps.

Its rock-solid stability on straights, combined with its balanced
handling, make it a fun car on winding roads.

The Golf's styling was penned by acclaimed designer
Giorgetto Giugiaro.

Thanks to his amazing talents, the Golf has become one of
the most recognized cars on the road.
entries.zh:
第一代高尔夫GTI是真正的经典，它是
现代传统高性能掀背车的先驱。

它采用前置前驱布局：
前置引擎前轮驱动系统。

1.6升的直列四缸引擎可产生
高达110ps。

它在直道上坚如磐石的稳定性，结合稳固
的操作性，使它成为车手最可靠的选择。

高尔夫的造型出自备受赞誉的设计师
乔治·亚罗。

他的设计使得这款车成为最具辨识度的
公路车之一。

entries.en:
Cooper Car Co. is a British firm that revolutionized Formula
1 vehicle construction.

The sportier Mini variants that the company designed
have become true classics.

The cars with the "S" designation came with a more
powerful engine.

This model, the 970 S, was extra special.

Its name referred to the size of the engine, which was 970cc.
It was an inline design that delivered 66ps.

Its limited production run means that this is one of
the most sought-after Cooper S models out there!
entries.zh:
Cooper是一家彻底革新F1车辆构造的
英国公司。

他们设计的MINI衍生跑车是真正的经典。

这些带有“S”名称的车型搭载
具备更高动力的引擎。

这款车型中尤其昂贵的是970 S。

前置970cc直列四缸引擎可以产生
高达66ps的动力。

由于其限量生产，这就意味着它会是这里
最受欢迎的Cooper S车型之一。

entries.en:
The Porsche 911 GT3 came into being with the Type 996, and
it has since become a mainstay of the brand.

Its car's flat-6 engine is packed with power, allowing the car
to get from zero to 60 mph in about 4.5 seconds.

Because the 996 was the first 911 powered by a water-cooled
engine, the GT3 represents a first on a few fronts.

It comes packed with the race technology accrued by Porsche's
long history in motorsports.

And because of this, it remains one of the finest vehicles
Porsche ever produced.=
entries.zh:
这是保时捷911系列中996车型的
GT3版。

搭载水平对置六缸引擎提供超强马力，
让你完全沉浸于驾驶体验中。

坚固的车身和引擎响应速度
像是回到有点复古的风冷时代。

但是也正是这些品质使得GT3
别具一格。

无论从哪个方向看，它都是保时捷
生产的最经典的车型之一。

entries.en:
This 930 version of the 911 is the first Porsche production
car to include turbocharging technology.

Turbocharging was originally a standard feature of
Porsche race cars in the 1970s.

But it wasn't long before the company decided to incorporate
forced-induction into its flagship vehicles.

Thanks to the added boost supplied from the turbocharger,
the engine pumps out 300ps.

The wide rear tires help transfer this power to the driving
surface, making this thing a beast on the race track.#
entries.zh:
这款基于911车型的930是第一款搭载涡轮
增压技术的保时捷产车。

涡轮增压是1970年代保时捷
最初的标准特色。

但不久之后公司就决定将
这一特色融入他们的旗舰线。

当时引擎最多只能产生300ps，而
涡轮产生的增压大大弥补了这一缺失。

宽大的后轮满足了人们对后置后驱车型
预期的稳固抓地力。

entries.en:
If you're a fan of sports cars, you'll love the Porsche
911 Carrera RS.

The Type 964 was successful in the "Carrera Cup," helping
to popularize racing at the grassroots level.

This 911 Carrera RS was a road-going model of the
iconic race car.

The designers went to great lengths to get the most out of
the engine while keeping the car as light as possible.

Therefore, the 911 RS is quick in a straight line, but it's
the car's amazing handling that sets it apart from others..
entries.zh:
如果你是跑车爱好者，那你会爱上964系列
保时捷911 Carrera RS。

964系列在“Carrera杯”中非常成功，让
大量的消费者对赛车产生了兴趣。

这款Carrera RS因此成为代表性赛车锦标赛
的合法公路版。

设计师在保持车身尽量轻盈的同时加长了
车身，让引擎发挥出最大的优势。

它看起来可能没那么强大，但就操作性
而言，没有其他车辆可与之媲美。

entries.en:
The Type 993 will go down in history as the last
of the air-cooled 911s.

And the RS Clubsport is perhaps the most special,
and collectable, in the 993 lineup.

The carpets and soundproofing have been removed to reduce weight,
and a roll cage added for safety and structural support.

The naturally-aspirated 3.8-liter flat-6 pumps out 300ps,
while its 1200kg curb weight keeps the rear planted.

The suspension leans toward the firm side, but on the track,
the handling is nothing short of exceptional.6
entries.zh:
993系列是911的最后一个风冷车型，
也因此而闻名于世。

即使在RS车型中，Clubsport版也算是特别之作，
深受世界各地收藏家的喜爱。

为了减轻重量，车内的地毯和隔音材料都被拆除，
还加装了防滚架以提高坚固性。

3.8升自然进气水平对置引擎提供，300ps1200kg的车重则保障了后端的稳定性。

虽然悬挂系统的调校略硬，但丝毫无损赛道上的操作性。

entries.en:
Like the 911 GT3 that came before it, the 997 version is
essentially a race car made for the street.

The car's normally-aspirated 3.6-liter flat-6 packs
a massive 400ps punch.

The boxer engine comes mated to a 6-speed manual transmission
that manages the power sent to the rear wheels.

The suspension system was tuned to provide race car-like
handling, but still deliver an even ride.

While the 911 Turbo is more powerful, true race enthusiasts
prefer this car because of its amazing balance.
entries.zh:
997系列保时捷911 GT3引擎盖下的马力
可能超过400ps，但是操作性非常梦幻。

实际上，这款车搭载的引擎与早期车型
相比，马力增加了20ps。

悬挂系统与先前的GT3相比也更精良，
所以驾驶体验更显舒适。

别担心，即使这样，它在性能方面也
没有牺牲分毫！

这款车可以说是真正实现了
保时捷工程师的愿景。-

entries.en:
The Porsche 911 Type 993 will always be remembered as
the last of the air-cooled 911s.

The base Carrera models come with a naturally-aspirated
flat-6 engine, which is mounted aft of the rear axle.

This includes the venerable RS, which is based on a
racing version of the car.

The lightweight body and more responsive engine make this
particular machine stand out from the other 911s.

Although it isn't as fast in a straight line as the 911 Turbo,
many enthusiasts prefer taking this one out on the track.
entries.zh:
这款保时捷993作为911系列最后一款使用
风冷式引擎的车型，多次获得嘉奖。

它是体验搭载自然进气引擎的911车型的
完美方式。

与其他RS车型一样，这一名称表示该车型
是基于跑车版本。

轻量级车身结合响应速度更快的引擎，
与经典保时捷后置后驱布局相得益彰。

驾驶这款911时间越长，
就会越欣赏它。2

entries.en:
This magnificent BMW continued the company's long tradition
as a great maker of fantastic race cars.

Based on the 3.0 CS, the CSL was significantly lighter.

So you can probably guess what that extra letter stands for, right?

Yep, the "L" stands for "light," or "leicht" as they say in German.

This later version features a powerful 3.2-liter engine,
with wider fenders and a large wing.

The prominent aerodynamic parts made an impact on the car's
appearance, prompting some to call it the "Batmobile."`
entries.zh:
这辆华丽的宝马把公司的形象定位为
高级赛车车厂。

这款基于3.0 CS的车型非常轻盈。

L的名号即为了强调这个事实。

实际上，L确实是表示“轻量型”。

之后的版本搭载了强大的3.2升引擎、宽阔
的挡泥板和庞大的尾翼。

出色的空气动力学零部件赋予了它
“蝙蝠战车”的名号。

entries.en:
The Ferrari Testarossa was a V-12-powered exotic that was
introduced in 1984.

It's considered one of the company's great creations, along
with its contemporaries, the GTO and the F40.

The Testarossa inherited its basic layout from Ferrari's
512BB.

This included the engine, dubbed a 'flat-12' because the pistons
are horizontally opposed, but technically it's a V-12.

The Testarossa name, which means "red head" in Italian,
came from Ferrari's legendary 250 Testa Rossa race car.

The car's styling was penned by none other than Pininfarina.

The distinctive strakes on the body sides made this car
instantly recognizable on both the road and track.
entries.zh:
法拉利Testarossa是一款高端车型，
首次问世于1984年。

被认为是公司最伟大的杰作之一，与之齐名的
还有其80年代同期车型、GTO和F40。

Testarossa继承了法拉利的BB 512系列的
基本布局。

最重要的是搭载了V12中置引擎。

此款车根据公司的传奇性跑车
250特斯塔洛萨而命名。

由最具盛名的意大利公司
宾尼法利纳所设计。

Testarossa车门两侧独特的边条翼
是法拉利V8车型所继承的设计特色。

entries.en:
Many consider the early 1960s as Abarth's golden era.

A big part of the reason is because of the 500 Esseesse.

Although it only produces a mere 32ps, which might
lead you to think it's underpowered...

...but in fact, its small, light construction gave it
a surprising amount of pep.

In fact, its performance is nothing short of incredible.

Esseesse, incidentally, is the Italian pronunciation
of SS, which stands for Super Sport.
entries.zh:
许多人认为1960年代是阿巴斯的
黄金年代。

500 Esseesse就是该时期的标志。

只能输出32ps，这可能会让人觉得
马力不足。

然而，这样小型而轻量的构造却会产生
惊人的速度。

实际上，它的性能非常魔幻。

顺便说一句，Esseesse是意大利语
SS的发音，代表超级跑车。

entries.en:
The Subaru Impreza is a legendary Japanese car that made its name
at the World Rally Championship, the pinnacle of rally racing.

Defined by its compact body, a mighty turbo engine and4WD system,
it never failed to impress on every kind of terrain.

The road-going Impreza WRX STi is admired by sports-car
enthusiasts from all over the world.

This model is the second-generation WRX STi that came equipped
with a powerful 2.0-liter powerplant.

This 2004 model saw its engine receive further upgrades, along
with a new suspension and wider tires.

It was the first Impreza to run the Nürburgring’s old track in
less than eight minutes!
entries.zh:
斯巴鲁翼豹是一辆在拉力赛领域巅峰赛事——
世界拉力锦标赛上闯出名号的传奇日本赛车。

这款车型采用紧凑型车身设计，装备有强大的涡轮增压引擎，
并配备四轮驱动系统，在速度方面的表现从不会令人失望！

而其公路车型翼豹WRX STi受到了
来自全世界跑车爱好者的倾慕。

这里的这一辆车是第二代WRX STi，2升排量级别，
拥有当时最强大的引擎之一。

而到了2004款车型上，引擎获得了进一步的升级，
此外还采用了全新的悬挂和宽胎。

它是第一款在纽博格林赛道旧布局上跑进八分钟的翼豹！

entries.en:
You might say that the Evo IX MR represented a new milestone
for the Lancer Evolution series.

After all, it was the last of its kind to come equipped with
the Mitsubishi 4G63 4-cylinder turbo engine.

Although the 4G63 would prove to be no match for its
successor, the 4B11, in terms of power and torque...

...it offered more power and better engine response in the
low rev range.

A gem of an engine, it's sure to stand the test of time!
entries.zh:
这台翼豪陆神IX MR可以说标志着蓝瑟翼豪陆神系列的
一道里程碑。

毕竟，它是最后一款搭载三菱
4G63 4缸涡轮引擎的车型。

尽管4G63确实无法在功率和扭矩方面与其后继
产品4B11匹敌……

但在低转速区间，它的动力更大，响应也更优秀。

像这样的宝藏引擎，定能经受住时间的考验！

entries.en:
The A112 Abarth may be small, but it has a proven
reputation as being one exciting car to drive.

What everyone loves about it is the feel of its engine.

You might think at first that the OHV 4-cylinder is a bit tame.

But once you get behind the wheel, you'll be impressed.

The final model pumped out 70ps, which is quite adequate
when you consider the car weighs only 700kg.

It just goes to show that the Italians are capable of producing
fun compacts and not just glorious high-priced exotics. 6
entries.zh:
A112阿巴斯可能比较娇小，
但以驾驶体验刺激而闻名。

尤其是引擎感经常受到表扬。

以顶置阀门四缸引擎车来说，
可能设计上有些复古。

但性能却是无可匹敌。

最终车型具备高达70ps，这对
一辆重量只有700kg的车来说完全足够。

绝对是意大利汽车工艺的优秀典范。

entries.en:
The Audi TT is a well-known model that proved to be
a hit from the get-go.

This second-gen TTS is the "sports" variant,
an absolute fan favorite!

A stylish 4WD sports coupe, its turbocharged 2.0-liter engine
really packs a punch!
entries.zh:
奥迪TT是一款从初代便一举成名的热门车型。

这辆第二代TTS“跑车”车型也非常有人气！

身为一辆时尚的4轮驱动双门跑车，2升涡轮引擎的
出力绝对让人喜出望外！

entries.en:
The Ferrari 430 Scuderia represented the epitome
of driving exhilaration...

...whether it was tasked with a scenic coastal road
or attacking a racetrack.

Building on the performance of the F430 series, the Scuderia offered
a better experience with reduced weight and improved dynamics.

This incredible sports machine is an advanced evolution of the
F430's electronic stability system, tuned for track performance.

The 430 Scuderia was a genuine road-going racer
that really took its special concept to heart.
entries.zh:
430 Scuderia是追求驾驶乐趣或渴望征服赛道的车迷们
的理想之选。

这款车型基于超高性能的法拉利F430系列打造，在大幅
减轻车重的同时提供了更强劲的动力输出。

此外，它还搭载了专为赛道优化的F430电子稳定系统
的升级版。

值得一提的是，在430 Scuderia之前，360系列就曾推
出过Challenge Stradale，单一品牌赛事用车的公路版本……

而430 Scuderia则是一款真正意义上的公路赛车，它将
这一特殊理念贯彻到了极致。

entries.en:
The Gallardo was the first car by Lamborghini
to be powered by a V-10 engine.

While Lambos were generally known for having V-12s under their
hoods, the Gallardo proved to be extremely popular.

In fact, it became the first Lamborghini production car
to sell more than 10,000 units!

This LP 560-4 was introduced in 2008, five years after
the original Gallardo made its debut.

The LP 560-4 boasted a larger engine, more power
and lighter body.

It even looked different than its predecessor. Indeed, the
LP 560-4 was a better car in every sense of the word.
entries.zh:
Gallard是兰博基尼历史上第一款采用V10引擎
提供动力的车型。

尽管不是品牌赖以成名的V12车型，但它的人气和
知名度也丝毫不逊色。

要知道，这可是兰博基尼第一款卖出超过10000台
的量产车型。

这辆纵向后置560-4新版本于2008年发布，也就是2003年
初代Gallard推出的五年之后，

拥有更大的排量、更强的动力以及更轻的车身。

它与前代车型的外观也略有不同，因此从各个角度来说，
纵向后置560-4都呈现出了全面的升级进化。

entries.sourceName: Lancer GSR Evolution VIII MR GSR '04
entries.en:
This car was the first Lancer Evolution to receive
Mitsubishi’s high-performance MR badge.

Thanks to its 4G63 turbocharged inline-4, this rally-inspired
machine accelerated like a sports car.

The Lancer Evolution VIII marked a major leap from  the
previous model, thanks to its Super AYC torque control system.

Over any driving surface, the sedan was fast and easy to control.

The MR version did away with many luxury comforts, instead
placing a high priority on speed.

Not only did it boast a sportier suspension and lightweight
aluminum roof, the engine had more punch in the low-to-mid range.

With the company's excellent all-wheel-drive system and Super AYC,
the Lancer Evolution VIII was indeed a rally car for the street.
entries.zh:
这款车型是第一辆获得三菱运动级“MR”命名的
蓝瑟翼豪陆神。

它不仅能在各种路面上达到惊人的速度，还拥有梦幻般出色
的转弯性能。

蓝瑟翼豪陆神VIII相较于翼豪陆神VII实现了重大突破，
配备了主动偏航控制扭矩控制系统……

以及强劲的4G63涡轮增压引擎。

这款MR版本的设计更加简洁，与其高性能的定位相符。

除了改进的悬挂系统和更换为铝合金车顶外，MR版本
在低中转速范围内响应更为灵敏……

其四轮驱动系统和主动偏航控制系统也经过了精心调校，
达到了近乎完美的状态。

entries.en:
The 1990s marked a golden era for Japanese sports cars,
and perhaps none was more iconic than the RX-7.

This is the third-generation ɛ̃fini RX-7, introduced in 1991. It
is often referred to as the “FD,” a nod to its chassis code.

With its wide body and tires, the globally positioned FD was
never constrained by Japan’s strict size regulations.

Like the model before it, it runs on a 13B rotary engine, this time
paired with a sequential twin-turbo producing 255ps.

Equipped with a fine-tuned double-wishbone suspension system,
the FD weighs 1260kg and boasts a 5kg/hp ratio.

At launch, the most focused variant, the Type R, featured shorter
gearing and suspension tuned for sharper acceleration.

A breathtaking machine that seems untouched by time, the FD
stands as a rotary sports car legend for the history books.*
entries.zh:
20世纪90年代是日本跑车的黄金时代，
而其中最具传奇色彩的，或许当属RX-7。

眼前这台便是1991年首发的第三代ɛ̃fini RX-7。
车迷们常以其底盘代号“FD”来亲切称呼它。

FD拥有宽体设计与大尺寸轮胎，
其全球化的定位让它得以摆脱日本严苛的尺寸法规束缚。

它继承了前代的13B转子引擎，
但辅以一套可输出255ps的串列式双涡轮增压系统。

得益于高性能双叉臂悬架，FD的车重被控制在1260kg，
重量推力比达到5kg/马力。

作为最初也最极端的版本，Type R车型
配备了专为迅猛加速而调校的终传比与悬架。

FD之美，历久弥新，惊艳如初。
它无疑是转子跑车史上一位值得大书特书的杰出代表。<

entries.en:
Despite belonging to Japan's kei-car class, the Suzuki
Cappuccino is a genuine sports car.

It's a lightweight vehicle with a compact body and an
FR layout.

The engine is a highly efficient and reliable turbocharged
inline-3 with 657cc of displacement.

Although it only produces 64ps, the Cappuccino's weight
of 700kg means it possesses decent acceleration.

The chassis was also specially developed, so the front/rear
weight distribution is ideally balanced.

The car's 'tossable' nature makes it a delight to drive,
even for hardcore enthusiasts!
entries.zh:
虽然是日本轻型车中的一款，铃木Cappuccino
仍是一辆货真价实的跑车。

这是一辆采用前置后驱布局的轻型车辆。

它搭载了一台排量为657cc的直列三缸涡轮增压引擎，
秉承了铃木一贯的可靠性。

尽管它只能输出64ps，但它700kg的重量
意味着这辆车拥有不错的加速性能。

此车的底盘也是专门开发的，
所以前后的重量分配绝对均衡。

这辆车的操控性无与伦比，非常好开！

entries.en:
The Ford Sierra RS 500 Cosworth is a truly legendary car,
one that all race fans especially like.

It's a special model, built with the globally popular Gr.A
races in mind, which are for cars based on production models.

The original Sierra is a rear-wheel-drive car,
developed by Ford's European operation.

The RS Cosworth was then created to compete in
1985's Gr.A races.

The car was notable for its 2.0-liter front-mounted turbo
engine, created by the esteemed English company Cosworth.

Its suspension and body were specially tuned.

An even more powerful evolution model based on the
RS Cosworth was released in 1987.

That is this car, the Sierra RS 500 Cosworth.
Everything has been upgraded, including the engine.

Its exploits in the Gr.A races of the late 1980s and early
1990s are still talked about to this day!�
entries.zh:
福特Sierra RS 500 Cosworth是一辆货真价实的传奇汽车，
是许多赛车车迷的心头好。

眼前的这台特殊车型在设计时就考虑参加全球高人气的
组别A比赛——一项基于零售车型的改装赛车参加的比赛。

原版的Sierra是后轮驱动的车型，由福特的欧洲部门开发。

而RS Cosworth的诞生则是专门为了1985年的组别A比赛。

它的亮点包括一台2升的前置涡轮增压引擎，
由备受推崇的英国公司考斯沃斯设计打造。

悬挂和车身也经过了特别调试。

1987年，一个基于RS Cosworth开发，性能更强的
进化车型发布。

也就是我们现在看到的这辆Sierra RS 500 Cosworth！
它接受了包括引擎在内的全面升级。

在二十世纪八十年代晚期到九十年代早期的组别A比赛中，
它的出色表现至今令人津津乐道！`

entries.en:
Whether you're looking to cruise around town or refine your track
skills, the M3 E36 was the ideal car for driving enthusiasts.

The M3 legacy began with the iconic first-generation E30,
designed for Group A homologation.

But it's the second-gen E36 that truly cemented the model's
reputation for performance.

This iteration introduced BMW's now-legendary inline-6 engine.

Even more enticing, this particular model came from
a later release after a series of refinements.

The combination of the 3.2-liter inline-6 mated to a 6-speed
manual gearbox made it a favorite among sports-car fans.

After all, it offered power and precision at the low revs,
and exceptional notes at the high.
entries.zh:
无论是市内道路驾驶还是提升赛道技艺，M3 E36都是
您的理想之选。

M3系列以其传奇的首代E30车型而闻名，那是一款为满
足A组别赛事规则而生产的认证车型。

而这里介绍的是第二代E36车型。

正是从这一代起，M3开启了搭载宝马引以为傲的直列6缸
引擎的先河。

值得一提的是，它属于该系列的后期产品，经过了小幅
改款后推出。

它配备了经过扩容的3.2升直列6缸引擎，搭配6速手动变
速箱，因此广受欢迎。

这样的组合在低转速区间就能提供充沛动力和精准控制，
而在高转速时更能呈现出令人陶醉的引擎咆哮声。

entries.en:
Looking for a sports car that was developed specially for
motorsports?

Then the Toyota Celica GT-Four should be right up
your alley.

It's a 4WD sports car, developed by Toyota in the 1990s
to win the World Rally Championship.

The model name, GT-Four, reflects its character.

The original Celica was a 2-wheel-drive coupe, but the
GT-Four is a 4-wheel-drive rally machine.

The engine is quite powerful .

It's a 2.0-liter 3S-GTE, developed in conjunction with the
GT-Four over successive generations.

It packs a massive 255ps of power!
entries.zh:
想找一辆专门为赛车运动而开发的跑车吗？

那么丰田赛利卡GT-Four应该能满足您的需求！

这是一辆丰田在上世纪90年代，
为了在世界拉力锦标赛中夺胜而专门开发出的四驱跑车。

它名字中的等级GT-Four见证了这段历史。

原版赛利卡是一辆双轮驱动的双门轿车，
而GT-Four是一辆四驱拉力赛车。

它还搭载了一台动力澎湃的引擎。

这台引擎是2升的3S-GTE，与GT-Four共同经历了数个世代的开发。

这台引擎能输出255ps的强大动力！

entries.en:
This NISMO is the elusive Skyline GT-R R32,
a car of near-mythic status.

It is the evolution of a production car designed
to win Group A touring car races.

Only 500 units were sold for its limited release in 1990.
But how did it differ from the standard model?

For starters, it featured a front-bumper air duct to improve
engine cooling...

...and a metal turbine to overcome high boost
pressure.

The addition of aerodynamic parts and the cutting of frills
ensured it was faster and more lightweight.

No doubt about it, this special edition was designed
to win races.

Built by NISMO, Nissan’s very own motorsports division,
this venomous beauty is a true fan favorite.
entries.zh:
这辆NISMO是一辆极为难得的Skyline GT-R R32，
堪称一代神车。

它是基于为赢得A组别房车比赛而设计的量产车改装而成的
衍生车型，

在1990年限量销售，仅售500辆。但它与标准车型
有什么不同呢？

它在前保险杠处增加了风道，以改善引擎冷却……

选用金属材质的涡轮内壁来承载高增压带来的压力。

空气动力学部件的添置和外观装饰物的削减
有效实现车身减重并提升速度。

毋庸置疑，这台特别版的设计初衷就是冲着赢得比赛去的。

这辆漂亮的双排气管跑车由日产自己的赛车部门NISMO打造，
是真爱车迷的心头好。

entries.en:
The Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution, more commonly known as
the "Evo," is an iconic Japanese car from the 1990s.

It was developed for competing in the World Rally Championship,
the pinnacle of rally racing.

This is the third-generation model from 1995,
called the "Evo III."

It's a truly historic machine because it handed Mitsubishi ace Tommi
Mäkinen his first world rally drivers title.

From its wide front bumper to the flamboyant rear spoiler,
everything on the Evo III was rally-spec.

And, it represented an evolutionary leap from the previous models,
thanks mainly to its incredible performance.

What’s more, the production Evo III came with an anti-lag
system, which was usually reserved just for race cars.
entries.zh:
三菱蓝瑟翼豪陆神是
二十世纪九十年代最具标志性的日式车之一。

它是为了参加世界拉力锦标赛
所开发的一款基础车型。

这辆车是1995年推出的第三代型号，俗称“翼豪陆神III”。

这款车型因帮助三菱的王牌车手托米·马基宁
拿下了他的第一个世界拉力车手冠军而名声斐然。

从宽大的开口式前保险杠到帅气的后扰流板，
它车身上的每一个配件都完全符合拉力赛规格。

这个型号与一代和二代型号翼豪陆神相比堪称是革命性的飞跃，
比前两代速度更快、性能更强。

此外，翼豪陆神III还从量产阶段就设计了一套偏时点火系统。

entries.en:
The Silvia is an iconic sports coupe,
produced by Nissan.

This example is the 6th-generation model, which first
appeared in the 1990s and is known as the S14.

This specific car is actually the very last of the S14s
that came out in 1996.

Its design is notably different from earlier models,
with a distinctively sharp look.

The power and torque remained the same as those of its
predecessor, but this K's grade car features a turbo.

And what about the Silvia's drivetrain, you ask?
Well, it's real-wheel-drive, giving it an FR layout.

The turbo engine's max output of 220ps and the FR layout
makes it suitable for both track racing and drifting.
entries.zh:
Silvia是一款标志性的、优雅的双门跑车，由日产生产。

该车型来自于二十世纪九十年代初次推出的第六代，
被命名为S14。

我们看到的这一台事实上是S14的最后一作，于1996年推出。

其设计与早期车型有着明显的不同，更加棱角分明。

动力和扭矩数据都和老款相同，但这辆S-14 K's
拥有一台涡轮增压引擎。

那么Silvia的传动系统又如何呢？你可能会问。
好吧，它是一台后驱车，确切地说，是前置后驱。

搭载涡轮增压器的引擎的最大输出马力是220ps，
这使它在赛道竞速和漂移中都能游刃有余。

entries.en:
Among Japanese 2-door sports coupes, the Nissan Silvia
is one with particularly deep roots.

Bowing in 1965, the legendary first-gen model is remembered
as an indispensable part of Japanese automotive history.

This model here, affectionately known as the S14,
dates back to 1993.

The direct successor to the S13, it marked the arrival
of the sixth-generation car.

Compared to its predecessor, it was a bit wider, with a
longer body and wheelbase.

In line with its pedigree, it featured a front-engine/
rear-wheel-drive, or FR, layout.

And its sleek and simple proportions gave it a
look that makes it instantly recognizable as a Silvia.

Contributing to its excellent performance was
an evolved undercarriage.

This came with reinforced brakes and a stiffer suspension
resulted in improved handling.

This K’s Type S Grade was the top-of-the-line model. It came with
a turbocharged 4-cylinder engine and rear spoiler.%
entries.zh:
在日本的双门运动型轿跑车中，日产Silvia是一个
历史渊源尤为深厚的系列。

这个传奇车型在1965年首次亮相的第一款车
已成为了日本汽车史上不可缺少的一部分。

眼前的这款车型被亲切地称为“S14”，
它的历史可以追溯到1993年。

作为S13的继任者，它标志着Silvia第六代车型的到来。

与它的前辈相比，它的车身略宽，车身和轴距更长。

其他方面则与之前的车型一致，
采用了前置引擎、后轮驱动，亦即“前置后驱”的布局……

其圆润的造型和简单的比例被称作“Silvia外观风格”
并受到全世界车迷的推崇。

改进后的底盘为其卓越的性能贡献不少……

强化的刹车和提升后的悬架刚性则改善了操控性。

这款K’s中的Type S配置是顶配，
配备了涡轮增压4缸引擎和后扰流板。

entries.sourceName: Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint GT Veloce '67
entries.en:
If you're in the market for an Alfa, may I suggest
something from the 1960s Giulia series?

The Giulia Sprint GTs in particular have long been
coveted as masterpieces of the compact-coupe genre.

They combine a lightweight body with Alfa Romeo’s
sporty DOHC engine.

When it comes to design, they are genuine works of art.

They were penned by Giorgetto Giugiaro, who was then
working for the legendary Italian studio Bertone.

The Veloce is a slightly powered-up version
of its GT siblings.#
entries.zh:
如果你想买一辆埃尔法，要不要考虑下1960年代
的朱丽叶系列？

特别是朱丽叶Sprint GT系列，它们是人们长期以来
一直梦寐以求的小型双门跑车杰作。

它的设计结合了轻巧紧凑的车身和阿尔法罗密欧的
双凸轮轴跑车引擎。

毫不例外，它们也是由乔盖托·乔治亚罗设计的，当时他正在为
传奇的意大利博通工作室工作。

从设计上讲，绝对是真正的艺术作品。

Veloce是其众多GT系列兄弟姐妹中的动力进阶版本。

entries.en:
The DeLorean DMC-12 became world famous after it appeared
in the movie "Back to the Future."

This niche car's futuristic look made it the perfect choice
to be converted into a time machine

The car employed an RR layout, similar to that of the Porsche
911, but power from the V-6 was rated at only 130ps.

Later versions would get an improved engine that delivered
up to 200ps.

While the production run of this sports car was short, it
remains one of the most recognized American cars ever.
entries.zh:
德罗宁是永恒的经典，
备受世人推崇。

它在电影《回到未来》中强势出镜，
令许多电影发烧友一见倾心。

采用与保时捷911相同的后置后驱布局，
V6引擎在发售时原本马力只有130ps。

“系列2”车型采用经过改良的引擎，
将马力升至高达200ps。

绝对能让你的驾驶体验乐趣无穷！

entries.en:
This S13 Silvia Q's came with a naturally-aspirated engine.

It was among the more popular special S13 models.

The multi-link rear suspension was one of several
enhancements made to the chassis.

Combined with the smooth power delivery, this Silvia was
a delight when both driving hard and just cruising.
entries.zh:
这辆S13 Silvia Q's配备自然进气引擎。

它在特别版S13设计中是比较受欢迎的
车型。

多连杆后悬挂系统是对底盘进行的诸多改进
之一。

与NA引擎的可靠动力相结合，坚固的车身
可以驾驭最强悍的驾驶风格。

entries.en:
No matter the year or model, the Honda Civic has always
been a popular choice for young driving enthusiasts.

But perhaps among the most appreciated of all the Civics
was the EK Type R.

Its naturally-aspirated VTEC powerplant revved like a race car
engine and delivered excellent torque.

Armed with VTEC, it packed an incredible 185ps punch
for a 1.6 liter inline-4.

The engine was so durable that some aftermarket firms powered
it up even more by adding forced induction.

Combine this engine with the car's lightweight body, and you
had one of the most potent cars on the planet.
entries.zh:
很多不同型号的本田思域受欢迎程度
经年不衰。

但是说到纯粹的驾驶体验，
这辆EK Type R就少有对手。

它的超高扭矩自然进气VTEC引擎是
本田最伟大的成就之一。

排气量只有1.6升，
却提供足足185ps！

即使是引擎转动的方式都令人着迷：
锋利又轻盈，几乎像是越野摩托！

轻量级的低高度车身使得它成为一款
操控性优良的车型。

entries.en:
Also known as the E9, this fabulous BMW coupe was introduced
in the 1960s.

This CSL version was based on the 3.0 CS. And as the letter "L"
suggests, it was lighter, by 200kg.

The change was made to homologate the car for
the European Touring Championship.

While it might not look all that different from a 3.0 CS at
first glance, the doors and hood are actually aluminum.{
entries.zh:
这款神话般的宝马库佩也被称为E9，
于1960年代首度亮相。

这辆轻量化运动轿跑衍生版基于3.0 CS，
但是比它还轻200kg。

这对于欧洲房车锦标赛的赛事认证
来说是必需品质。

一眼看去可能在外形上和3.0 CS没有
差异，但车门和引擎盖实际上是铝制的。

entries.en:
This third-generation Corvette went by the designation of C3.

Back in the 1960s and 1970s, American V-8 engines
were categorized by their size.

Those with a displacement of 5.7 liters and less were called
"small block" V-8s.

Those with larger displacements were aptly called "big block"
V-8s. In fact, some people still use these terms.

The L46 in this 1969 Corvette C3 was one of the more
famous cars with a "small block" V-8.

It was a high-output engine, which packed around 50 HP
more than standard models.

If you want to really go old school, you can refer to the
engine's size in cubic inches.

In this case, 5.7 liters works out to 350 cubic inches.

Now you know where the "350" in its name comes from!0
entries.zh:
这款第三代雪佛兰科尔维特也称C3。

美产V8引擎倾向于根据排气量来分类。

排气量5.7升左右的引擎为
“小缸体引擎”...

排气量更大的则称为“大缸体引擎”。

这款1969年的科尔维特C3中搭载的L46
引擎是最有名的“小缸体”引擎之一。

属于高马力引擎，比标准车型
高50马力。

顺便一说，引擎排量在美国是用
立方英尺度量的。

5.7升等同于350立方英尺...

这也是车型名称350的出处。

entries.en:
The Honda Integra was the second car to get a Type R model,
after the brand was introduced on the NSX.

The Type R moniker is reserved for the company's most
performance-oriented cars.

Sold as an Acura in the U.S., this was front-wheel-drive car.

Its naturally aspirated 1.8-liter B18C engine screamed at
high rpms, providing 200ps at 8000 rpm.

While its suspension was a bit softer than later versions,
many still prefer the more nimble '96 Spec.
entries.zh:
这款车型是广大车友爱好者眼中的
本田Type R。

这款备受喜爱的Type R车型基于
前轮驱动的形格。

它是一款早期的车型，通常称为'96 Spec。

它的自然进气1.8升B18C引擎可以达到超高
转速，释放出强大的马力。

虽然它的悬挂系统可能比后期版本更加脆弱，
但很多人仍然更喜欢灵活性更高的'96 Spec。

entries.en:
The BMW M3 has represented the ultimate sports sedan/coupe
in the marketplace since it was created in 1989.

This car here started it all, the first-gen M3 dubbed the E30.

BMW's motorsports division fine-tuned every inch of this car—
engine, suspension, body—to make it perform better.

This homologation model was born out of a desire to triumph
in Gr.A category racing.

Though its design might seem simple, you'll realize its
potent nature once you get behind the steering wheel.
entries.zh:
毫无疑问，宝马M3被认为是世界上最好的
后驱跑车之一。

这款车型是第一代E30 M3。

室内赛车专家宝马M精细调整了每个细节：
引擎、悬挂系统和车身，同时也没有忘记性能。

这款赛事认证车型的诞生就是为了在
组别A类赛车中取得胜利。

虽然设计看上去比较简单，挑剃的爱车人士
却可以立即识别而出，也喜欢它带来的感受。

entries.en:
Are you looking for a convertible with elegance and performance?
If so, the first-gen BMW Z4 is the car for you!

The successor to the Z3, it only came equipped with an inline-6,
which replaced its predecessor's 4-cylinder engine.

Its long hood exudes plenty of grace—the car's silhouette
embraces the term "long nose/short deck proportions."

True to BMW tradition, it embodies the brand's hallmark traits of
optimal weight distribution and enhanced structural rigidity.

The Z4’s suspension builds on the design refined in the E46,
and its 231ps inline-6 engine embodies BMW refinement.

Having proven its mettle at the Nürburgring 24 Hours, the Z4
earns its reputation as a top-tier machine by any standard!
entries.zh:
想要寻找一款优雅与操控性并重的敞篷车吗？那么这辆
第一代宝马Z4就是你梦寐以求的车型！

作为Z3的后继车型，它摒弃了前任的4缸引擎，改用
更强大的直列6缸。

它的长引擎盖本身便是一件美轮美奂的设计精品，
懂行的人都称其为“长车鼻短车身”比例。

身为一台宝马，它拥有品牌一脉相承的所有标志性特点，
并在车重分配和车身刚度上更进一步。

Z4的悬挂基于一款已在E46车型上久经考验的设计，
6汽缸做功时带来顺畅丝滑的体验，输出可达231ps。

Z4还曾参加过纽博格林24小时耐力赛，从各个维度来说
都堪称是“精妙绝伦”。

entries.en:
Looking for a coupe with real character?
If so, then have I got the perfect choice for you!

Built on the third-gen Renault Espace platform, the Avantime
is a unique-looking coupe that embraces minivan elements.

What truly sets it apart is the remarkable sense of freedom
it delivers, notably from its ingeniously designed rear seating.

The body, crafted from lightweight FRP, was built by Matra,
a name once synonymous with Formula 1 competition.

While it came with a range of engine options, this model packs
a 3.0-liter V-6, whose torque contributed to good handling.

A true rarity, only 8,500 units rolled off the line during
its brief two-year production run that began in 2001!
entries.zh:
你在寻找一辆独具个性的双门跑车吗？
那这款车无疑是最完美的选择！

基于第三代雷诺Espace打造的Avantime
是一款融合了多功能乘用车元素的独特双门跑车。

它最大的魅力在于通过设计所营造的强烈自由感，
尤其是其创新的后排座椅设计。

车身采用玻璃纤维强化塑料制造，
由曾参与一级方程式赛事的马特拉公司生产。

这款车型还提供多种动力配置选择，我们眼前的
这台搭载3升V6引擎，低扭输出特性带来出色的操控表现。

这是一款罕见车型，在自2001年开始的两年生产周期中，
仅制造了约8500台！

entries.en:
The R31, introduced in 1985, represented the seventh-generation of the
Nissan Skyline Brand.

The most superior version was the GTS-R that was introduced in 1987.

Built to win the Japanese Touring Car Championship (JTC),
Japan’s top touring car event at the time...

...It was a homologation model developed in accordance
with international Group A regulations.

Under the hood, Nissan added a new turbocharger to the GTS base
models' 2.0-liter inline-6.

Exterior tweaks included a large rear spoiler, along with other
aerodynamic equipment.

This R31 Skyline GTS-R had a limited production run
of about 800 units.

So, it should come as no surprise that this model has
become a true collector's item of the famous Skyline serie
entries.zh:
1985年亮相的“R31”标志着日产的Skyline品牌迈入
第7代……

而产品阵容中的终极版本就是1987年推出的GTS-R。

这辆车是专门为了当时日本最顶级的房车赛事——
日本房车锦标赛……

按照国际A组别规则所打造的认证车型。

在引擎盖下，它在基础车型GTS原本的2升直列六缸引擎上
又添加了一部涡轮增压器……

而在外观上，它的车尾添加了一部大尺寸尾翼，
车身上也多了不少空气动力学部件。

这辆R31 Skyline GTS-R仅限量生产了800余辆。

如此鲜少得见的车型，自然成了历史悠久的Skyline车系
中真正受到收藏家觊觎的车型。

entries.en:
You seem like a rally car enthusiast. If so, then this
is definitely the car for you!

The Ford Escort RS Cosworth was the successor
to the legendary Sierra Cosworth 4x4.

While the Escort had its heyday in the late 1960s and 1970s,
this car adopted the engine and 4WD layout from the Sierra.

The two-tier rear wing made quite the impression!

Needless to say, this car was fast, claiming five of 13 wins
at the 1993 World Rally Championship.

It certainly played a major role in restoring Ford to its
former rally glory.
entries.zh:
看来你是位拉力赛车爱好者。那么这款车
一定会让你心动！

福特福睿斯RS Cosworth继承了
传奇车型Sierra Cosworth 4x4的衣钵。

福睿斯在上世纪60年代末和70年代就曾登上巅峰，
而这款车又继承了塞拉的引擎与四驱系统。

其标志性的双层尾翼更是令人印象深刻！

这款性能出众的车型在1993年世界拉力锦标赛上
创下了13战5胜的骄人战绩。

它无疑为福特重返拉力赛车之巅立下了汗马功劳。`

entries.en:
Hey there! Looking for a slightly retro, rear-wheel-drive sedan?
Then how about Toyota’s sixth-generation Chaser?

With its pillarless-hardtop appearance and concealed B-pillars,
the Chaser is the sportier sibling of the Cresta and Mark II.

The Tourer V is the most serious in the lineup, powered by a
turbocharged 2.5-liter second-generation 1JZ-GTE inline-6.

With 280ps and 38.5kgm of torque, this sedan has enough
muscle to run wheel-to-wheel with genuine sports cars.

Need proof? Look no further than its storied win at
the 1998 Japanese Touring Car Championship!

Its durable, highly tunable engine also makes it an ideal
foundation for a competitive drift car.

The Chaser is a high-performance sedan with a well-concealed
wild side, and it is a perennial favorite among enthusiasts.�
entries.zh:
你好啊！在找稍微带点经典风格的前驱轿车吗？
要不要看看丰田的第6代Chaser？

Chaser是一辆风格硬朗、隐藏了B柱的硬顶车，
是Cresta、Mark II更加犀利的姐妹款。

Tourer V的配置在Chaser车型中是最硬核的，
搭载一台2.5升直列6缸第二代1JZ-GTE引擎。

其输出动力达280ps、扭矩38.5kgm，
能和纯血跑车轻松进行轮对轮的较量。

不信吗？只要看看它在1998年日本房车锦标赛上
传奇的冠军经历就知道了！

由于其结实耐用的引擎，它也是比赛用漂移赛车的理想改装平台。

Chaser在热衷改装的车迷圈子里享有经久不衰的人气，
是隐藏了狂野一面的高性能轿车。

entries.en:
The Renault 4 is a French economy car with
a long and glorious history.

After making its debut in 1961, its design has essentially remained
unchanged for more than 30 years.

A front mid-engine car, its rear is distinguished by
a large tailgate and spacious trunk.

It was the first hatchback to be a commercial success.

With more than eight million units sold around globe,
it was loved the world over as a practical car for everyday use!

This GTL model was added in the 1970s.

Its powerful engine and modern interior have made it
an especially popular model in the Renault 4 lineup.
entries.zh:
雷诺4是一款法国产经济型轿车
有着悠久而辉煌的历史。

自1961年首次亮相起，30余年来设计始终如一。

这是一款前中置引擎车型，以后部巨大的掀背车门
和宽敞的后备箱脱颖而出。

它也是第一款获得商业成功的掀背车。

作为一款日常使用的实用车型，得到全世界人民的喜爱，
销量达到令人咋舌的800多万辆！

这款GTL车型于20世纪70年代加入产品线。

凭借强劲的引擎和现代化的内饰成为
雷诺4系列中特别受欢迎的车型。

entries.en:
Hi there! Looking to buy a car? Might I suggest something
French, maybe with a lot of character?

If that sounds appealing to you, then you can’t go wrong
with this Citroën BX, a mega-hit family car of the 1980s.

The BX is packed with everything the French maker does best.
Why, even its styling recalls that of the storied GS and CX!

But the true jewel in the crown was its hydropneumatic suspension
that was so smooth, it earned the nickname "magic carpet."

Built to carry full loads on long drives, the 19 TRS was a grand
tourer model equipped with a 1.9-liter engine.

The BX’s enduring popularity fueled a 12-year production run,
securing its place as one of France’s automotive greats.
entries.zh:
你好！想买车吗？要不要考虑一款法国车，很有个性的那种？

如果这种说法听起来对你有吸引力，那么这辆雪铁龙BX
绝对不会让你失望，它可是80年代的家用车爆款。

BX集合了这家法国车厂的所有精华。
瞧，它的造型甚至让人想起传奇的GS和CX！

但最美妙的是它的液压气动悬挂系统，
平顺的行驶就像坐在“魔毯”上一样。

19 TRS是为满座长途旅行而生的豪华旅行版本，
搭载1.9升引擎。

BX经久不衰的人气让它连续热销12年，成就了法国汽车
的经典之作。

entries.en:
Are you interested in a car built to handle twisty roads?
Then, have I got the car for you—the Peugeot 205 GTI.

The 205 made its debut more than 40 years ago in 1983,
yet its design remains timeless and modern to this day.

Initially, Peugeot designated the 205 as a WRC rally car, but it
became clear that a sportier car was needed. Enter the GTI.

The true allure of the 205 GTI lies in its 1.6-liter inline-4,
paired with a chassis tipping the scales at just around 900kg!

In 1986, the engine was enlarged to 1.9L, producing 130ps,
while the chassis remained about the same weight.

On mountain roads, this car was a beast. It put the "hot" in hot
hatches and remains loyal to the spirit of sporty French cars.?
entries.zh:
想要寻找一款擅于征服蜿蜒道路的好车？我已经帮你挑
选好了——标致205 GTI！

这款205首次亮相要追溯到40多年前的1983年，不过现
在看来也毫不过时。

标致首先基于205打造了一款世界拉力锦标赛参赛
赛车，但他们也需要一款运动车型，于是GTI应运而生。

GTI的魅力毫无疑问来自于它动力充沛的1.6升引擎，
安装在整体重量仅有900kg的车身中。

在1986年，这款引擎升级为1.9升，可以输出130ps动力，
但我要强调，车重依然只有900kg！

在山路上，这辆车始终立于不败之地！它是高性能掀背车
中实力最强劲的选手之一，也是法系车精神的最佳证明。

entries.en:
Hi there. Looking for a small car with a big personality? Then
I’ve got the find for you—a first-generation Renault Twingo.

Take a look at its round headlights. Aren’t they adorable? In 1992,
this quirky monobox design took the world by storm.

Get in, and you’ll immediately see the magic of its design. At just
3.4m in length, it can comfortably seat four adults.

What’s more, the rear seats slide backward and forward,
meaning boot space can be extended for longer drives.

The interior uses a lot of plastic, but avoids feeling cheap
through a colorful aesthetic that matches its exterior.

This ’93 model runs on a 1.2-liter 4-cylinder OHV engine.
It may only have 55ps, but it’s pure joy to redline.

With a 14-year production run, the first-generation Twingo proves
that Renault is a true master of the small-car genre.�
entries.zh:
你好！想找一辆个性十足的小车？那我这里为你
准备了一个绝佳的选择——一辆初代雷诺Twingo！

瞧瞧这圆圆的大灯，可爱吧？
1992年，这款造型小巧的单厢车一经推出便风靡全球。

一坐进车内，立刻就能领略到它设计上的精妙之处。
车身长度仅3.4m，却能轻松容纳四名成年人。

更妙的是，它的后排座椅可以前后滑动，
这样一来，在长途旅行时，还能方便灵活地扩展行李空间。

内饰虽然采用了不少的塑料材质，但通过
和外观协调呼应的色彩美学设计，有效地避免了廉价感。

这里这辆93款搭载了一台1.2升的4缸顶置阀门引擎。
马力虽仅有55ps，但将它推向转速红线的过程却充满乐趣。

初代Twingo历经了长达14年的生产周期，
足以证明雷诺对小车类市场的把握堪称大师水准。�

entries.en:
Looking for a true, unapologetically American sports car?
Then look no further, we might have found your ideal car.

The Chevrolet Z06 is a revived legend for the
fifth-generation Corvette.

The Z06 name pays homage to the 1960s C2 race package.

Unveiled in 2001, this reincarnated Z06 builds on the C5 platform
with enhanced suspension and upgraded brakes, and more.

Under the hood is a 5.7-liter V-8 producing 390ps, paired with
weight-reduction measures to sharpen its edge.

Its notchback body sets it apart visually from the base model.
So, are you ready to find out what she’s really made of?
entries.zh:
想寻找一款横冲直撞的美式跑车？
巧了，我这里就有一个完美的选择！

这辆雪佛兰Z06是第五代科尔维特的重启之作，
也是货真价实的美式跑车代表。

它之所以起这个名字，是为了向1960年代的
C2赛车套件致敬。

这款重生的Z06在2001年首次公开，是一款采用了
升级版悬挂和增强刹车的C5车型。

它由一台390ps的5.7升V8引擎提供动力，并辅以
减重设计以及其他多项优化。

掀背车身外形也是这款Z06的显著特征之一。
怎么样？你要不要亲自体验一下它的操控感？/

entries.en:
Say the word "estate" to European car enthusiasts, and they're
bound to think of the Volvo 240 Estate.

This station wagon made its debut in 1974 and enjoyed a long
life, with a production run that stretched for two decades.

Although it was discontinued more than thirty years ago,
the model remains popular to this day.

Built with the philosophy of form following function,
the 240 provides excellent outward vision and superb handling.

Some users have logged several hundred-thousand kilometers on
their vehicles, so you can bet it's a reliable machine.

Sure, it may not be fast, but it's stylish and has plenty of luggage
space, making it the ideal companion for extended road trips.
entries.zh:
当你听到“旅行车”这个词时，第一个浮现在脑海里的
一定是沃尔沃240伊斯代。

在1974年首次亮相后，这一车型持续生产了近二十年。

尽管停产已超过三十年，但时至今日它的人气依然很高。

它不仅有充足、高效的宽敞储物空间，还能够提供优秀
的视野和一流的操控性。

像这样一辆设计虽然简单、但永不过时的可靠车型，安全行
驶数十万公里也不在话下！

虽然速度并不是它的优势，但无论何时、不论去哪，
你都会想与它同行。,

entries.en:
Perfect timing! I just received a little French van
that I think you might love.

It’s a first-generation Renault Kangoo from 2001.

Offering great control and ample storage, the Kangoo
was positioned as the ideal leisure vehicle.

This bold approach paid off, resulting in success not only as a
commercial van, but also as a multi-purpose vehicle (MPV).

Sure, its 1.4-liter engine produced only 75ps, but French cars
are known for making the most of what they’ve got.

With its lively suspension tuned for agile, fun cornering,
this Kangoo proved that driving isn't always about brute force.
entries.zh:
来得正是时候！我刚刚收到了一辆法国厢型车，相信你
一定也会喜欢的。

这是2001年推出的第一代雷诺Kangoo。

作为一款休闲定位的车型，Kangoo以出色的操控性和
宽敞的储物空间而闻名。

这一定位策略十分成功，使其在商用厢型车和多功能
运动休旅车市场都取得了不俗的成绩。

虽然其1.4升引擎提供的75ps动力不算强劲，但秉承
法国车的传统特色，它能够物尽其用，充分发挥实力。

搭配适合过弯的韧性弹簧悬挂系统，这款车能带来十足的
驾驶乐趣！

entries.en:
Compact, lightweight and low to the ground, with an
aggressive yet attractive body style...

...the fifth-generation Civic, introduced in 1991, is the
quintessential compact performance car.

Many consider this model to be one of the best handling FF
(front engine/front-wheel drive) cars on the planet.

The top-of-the-line SiR･II came equipped with a naturally
aspirated 1.6-liter DOHC VTEC engine.

It featured a double-wishbone suspension and quick-ratio steering
system that made the car efficient through corners.

It was, and remains, the pride of Japan. The Civic is still popular
today, thanks to predecessors like this 1991 model.
entries.zh:
小巧、轻灵、贴地，采用了高转速、自然吸气引擎

——如果你想寻找一辆特别适合运动驾驶的车，
那么这辆思域运动版就是首选！

1991年推出的第5代思域
是一款前置引擎、前轮驱动（或简称前置前驱）运动型轿车。

产品线中的顶配版本SiR･II装备了
一部1.6升双顶置凸轮轴可变气门正时和升程电子控制系统引擎……

并采用了双叉臂设计，在悬挂和转向性能之间取得了精确的平衡。

这辆紧凑型运动车款是日本的骄傲，更得到了广大车迷的青睐。
放到如今这个时代，可谓独步天下。

entries.en:
Perfect timing! I just received this little Italian gem—
a first-generation 1985 Fiat Panda.

This car made its debut in 1980, during the global oil crisis,
when small, economical cars were in high demand.

Intended as a replacement for the 126, it was penned by
none other than master designer Giorgetto Giugiaro.

To keep costs low, Giugiaro opted for a simple, boxy shape
that still managed to get across a modern sense of luxury.

The Panda came in a choice of 652cc and 903cc engines.
This one is powered by the former, making it light and zippy.

Giugiaro’s self-proclaimed masterpiece, the Panda is one car
you can’t do without!
entries.zh:
你来得正好！我刚收到这台意大利宝藏小车—
1985年的第一代菲亚特Panda。

这款车于1980年问世，当时正值全球石油危机时期，
小巧省油的车型备受青睐。

作为126的换代车型，它由设计大师乔盖托·乔治亚罗
亲自操刀设计。

为控制成本，乔治亚罗采用了简洁的方正造型，
却依然营造出精致的现代感。

Panda提供652cc和903cc两种引擎。
这辆搭载的是前者，因此车身轻巧、动力灵敏。

被乔治亚罗自称为得意之作的Panda，
绝对是一款让人爱不释手的经典车型！/

entries.en:
Good timing! I just received a stylish hot hatch—a 4th-gen
EF Civic Si, also known as the Grand Civic.

Civics are often associated with VTEC technology, but this
Si is powered by an older ZC engine.

The ZC was Honda’s first DOHC engine since the S800, which
made its debut fourteen years prior.

Although its 130 horsepower doesn't seem that impressive,
the engine's long-stroke design provides torque at low speeds.

The car's body is light and compact, and its double-wishbone
suspension is sheer perfection.

A major player in touring car races, the Civic was one
of the most iconic hot hatches of the 1980s.
entries.zh:
你来的真巧！我刚刚收了一辆风采依旧的高性能掀背车
——第4代EF思域Si，又被称作“思域辉煌”。

思域虽以VTEC系统技术闻名，但这辆Si搭载的却是
老款的ZC引擎。

它是本田自S800以来的首款双顶置凸轮轴引擎。
而S800，已经是十四年前的车了。

130马力看似平平，但其长行程设计能在低速时
提供充沛的扭矩。

车身轻巧紧凑，双叉臂悬架近乎完美。

作为房车赛场上的主力军，思域俨然是80年代
最具标志性的性能掀背车。

entries.en:
Hi there! Looking for a fine Japanese car from the 1990s?
If so, then have I got the car for you!

Check out this FTO, a compact coupe from Mitsubishi.
A speedy FF, it shares its basic parts with the Mirage.

Its biggest selling point is its 2.0-liter V-6. It is fitted with
a variable valve mechanism and can produce 200ps.

Measuring 4365mm long and 1735mm wide, this car
looks ferocious, particularly with its bulging hood.

And ferocious it was—hailed as the fastest FF machine of its era.
The sheer speed at which it takes corners is unbelievable.

Believe me, there aren’t many cars out there that have had
such a hold on young drivers as the Mitsubishi FTO!
entries.zh:
嘿！在找90年代的精品日本车吗？
那我这儿可有一款好车要推荐给你！

来看看这款三菱FTO，一款紧凑型轿跑。
作为一款速度傲人的前驱车，它与Mirage共享基础部件。

此车最大亮点是搭载可变气门机构的2升V6引擎，
可输出200ps的强劲动力。

车身长4365mm、宽1735mm，
外观极具攻击性，尤其是那隆起的引擎盖线条。

它的表现也相当凶猛——曾被誉为当时最快的前驱车！
过弯时的凌厉姿态令人难以置信。

相信我，很少有车型能像三菱FTO这样，
让年轻的车手们一见倾心！

entries.en:
Ever heard of the Toyota Mark II? It was an iconic FR car
that led Japan’s midsize sedan market for decades.

The performance version of the Mark II was the Tourer V, and
I happen to have an excellent one in stock right now.

This is an X100-series car from the model’s eighth generation.
What do you think? Looks like a regular sedan, right?

Well, wait until you see the serious hardware under the hood:
a 1JZ-GTE 2.5-liter inline-6 inherited from the A70 Supra.

The rush of its 280ps acceleration is pure madness,
and its 5-speed manual captivated enthusiasts everywhere.

With double wishbones at all four corners, the setup is supple
yet grippy, giving the car a remarkable degree of depth.

Older sedans are seeing a major resurgence right now,
so adding this one to your collection is an easy call.�
entries.zh:
听说过丰田Mark II吗？这款标志性的前置后驱车型
曾主导日本中型轿车市场数十年。

Mark II的运动版名为Tourer V，
我店里现在正好就有一台成色极好的。

是第八代的X100系列。
怎么样？看着像普通轿车，对吧？

不过等你见识过它那台凶悍的引擎再说：一台源自
A70 Supra的1JZ-GTE 2.5升直列六缸涡轮增压引擎！

它280ps的加速动力简直狂野，
5速手动变速箱更是让全球车迷为之着迷。

前后双叉臂悬挂调校偏软，
却抓地力十足，极高的可操控性令人惊叹。

如今把玩老式轿车的风潮再起，
所以把这台车收入车库，根本无需犹豫！

orphanTexts.en:
This is the 2011 model of Audi's R18 TDI prototype
racing car.

It was the overall winner in the 2011 24 Hours of Le Mans
endurance race.

This particular car was used by Audi Sport Team Joest,
an Audi satellite team.

It was driven to victory by the three-man team of Benoît
Tréluyer, André Lotterer and Marcel Fässler.
orphanTexts.zh:
这是2011款奥迪R18 TDI原型赛车。

在2011年的勒芒24小时耐力赛中，

我们眼前的这台车属于奥迪的卫星车队
奥迪Sport Joest车队。

这支由伯努瓦·戚路亚、安德烈·洛特勒和马塞尔-法斯勒
组成的三人车队就是驾驶着这辆车夺得了当年的总冠军头衔。

orphanTexts.en:
The DeLorean was and still is best known for being a time
machine in the movie "Back to the Future."

The car was built by DMC, founded by John Z. DeLorean,
a former vice president at General Motors.

This car was its first and only production model. Called the
DMC-12, DeLorean oversaw the entire creation process.

Financial woes forced DMC to close its doors after the car came
out. but it's still around today under different ownership.

The car you see here is the "Series 2," a remake proposed
by the new DMC.

Its key feature is an improved 200ps engine.
orphanTexts.zh:
这款德罗宁凭借电影《回到未来》而为大众熟识，在当时红
极一时。

打造这辆车的DMC公司由前通用汽车的副总裁
约翰Z.德罗宁创立。

DMC-12是他们的第一款，也是唯一一款量产型号，由德罗宁亲自
参与并领导了整个开发过程。

DMC在投产后只存在了短短不到两年的时间，多亏一家第
三方公司出手相助，这个品牌才得以存续。

这里的这辆德罗宁是“系列2”，是由新DMC公司提议开发的重
制版，

主打强化动力的200ps引擎。
orphanTexts.reason: RT2 label has no current DMSB vehicle row

orphanTexts.en:
This original Gran Turismo Gr.4 race car
is based on the S15 Silvia Spec-R.

Its most distinctive feature is its strikingly wide body.

About 170mm wider than the normal car's body, it
comes with wide race tires.

As the "Touring Car" name implies, this model was designed
for the race track.

Oh, and because the Silvia is also a popular drift car,
the basic handling balance has been left intact.

And, the handbrake is also still there,
in case you wanted to break the rear tires loose.

Whether you're looking for grip on the track or hoping to
drift around corners, this car is always a joy to drive!
orphanTexts.zh:
这辆原创的跑车浪漫旅组别4级别赛车基于
S15 Silvia Spec-R开发。

它最显著的特征就是那夺人眼球的宽体车身，

比一般车宽了约170mm，所以可以容纳下宽大的赛车轮胎。

顾名思义，这款“房车”是专为赛道设计的……

不过，Silvia也是漂移爱好者们追捧的车型。

事实上，为了兼顾漂移性能，这辆车甚至完整地保留了
手刹的配置。

不论是想要足够的赛道抓地力，还是追求漂移过弯时的
爽快感，这辆车一定都能够让您称心如意！
orphanTexts.reason: RT2 label has no current DMSB vehicle row

orphanTexts.en:
The DeLorean DMC-12 became world famous after
it appeared in the movie "Back to the Future."

No one expected this car to be converted into a time machine,
but its futuristic appearance made it the perfect choice.

The car employed an RR layout, similar to that of the Porsche 911,
but power from the V-6 was rated at only 130ps.

Later versions would get an improved engine
that delivered up to 200ps.

While the production run of this unique sports car was short,
it remains one of the most recognized American cars ever.
orphanTexts.zh:
德罗宁是永恒的经典，
备受世人推崇。

它在电影《回到未来》中强势出镜，
令许多电影发烧友一见倾心。

采用与保时捷911相同的后置后驱布局，
V6引擎在发售时原本只有130ps。

之后的版本采用了经过改良的引擎，
将动力提升至200ps。

掌握这样强大的动力，
为你带来乐趣无穷的驾驶体验！
orphanTexts.reason: RT2 label has no current DMSB vehicle row

orphanTexts.en:
The STi Version VI marked the final iteration of the
first-generation Impreza.

Its turbocharged flat-4 engine was further refined,
along with the crankshaft and other components.

The body also received several updates, making it slimmer
and more aerodynamic.

With its lightweight body and strong turbocharged acceleration,
this model represents the Impreza at its peak.
orphanTexts.zh:
STi Version VI是初代翼豹的
最终型号。

不仅它搭载的平置四缸涡轮增压引擎被进一步优化，
连曲轴和其他部件都得到了改进。

它的车体也经过几处改造，变得更苗条，
更具空气动力学特性。

凭借其轻量化的车体和强大的涡轮增压加速性能，
这款车型诠释出了翼豹的真谛。/
orphanTexts.reason: RT2 label has no current DMSB vehicle row

orphanTexts.en:
Bugatti is one of the world's top luxury car brands.

Its roots began with the automobile company established by
Ettore Bugatti, an engineer from a family of Italian artists.

In addition to luxurious passenger cars, Bugatti was also
known for sports and racing cars,

with a history of victories in many races including the
Monaco Grand Prix and Targa Florio.

The Type 35 was Bugatti's most successful race car
with countless victories.

The near identical-looking Type 37 substituted a four-cylinder
engine for the Type 35's inline eight.

This Type 37A is a more powerful model equipped with
a supercharger for the 4 cylinder engine.

When fitted with the two-seat sports body, a Type 37 may be
set up for racing or for exciting road use.

This example is fitted with the alloy wheels /drums standard
on a Type 35. G

orphanTexts.en:
Lancia of Italy is well known for its feats in
rally racing...

And the Lancia Delta S4 stands out as one of their
best machines.

The Delta S4 competed in the Group B category,
the top class of rally racing of the 1980s.

At the time, the Group B category only required 200 street
cars to be produced to meet homologation requirements.

Mainstream Group B machines combined midship turbo
engines with four-wheel drive.

However the Delta S4 took things a step further...

Adding a supercharger to its turbocharged engine.

Despite its remarkable debut win at the '86 World Rally
Championships...

The ultra-fast Delta S4 was involved in a fatal accident
on the Tour de Corse.

This marked the end of the Group B category.

Considering everything, including its tragic history,
the Delta S4 is a legend among Group B rally cars.�

来自意大利的蓝旗亚以其在拉力赛中的卓越成就而著称，

而在品牌旗下的众多经典拉力赛车型中脱颖而出的
蓝旗亚Delta S4，确实当得起终极拉力赛车的头衔。

Delta S4参加的是20世纪80年代拉力赛的最高级别：B组别。

在当时，B组别只需生产200辆公路车款就能满足赛事认
证要求。

主流的B组别车型大多将涡轮增压引擎安装在车身中部，
并采用四轮驱动系统。

Delta S4则在此基础上更进一步，

同时为引擎安装了涡轮增压器和机械增压器。

它在1986年的世界拉力锦标赛中首次亮相立即大获
成功。

令人遗憾的是，速度惊人的Delta S4在科西嘉岛拉力赛上
发生了致命的事故，

蓝旗亚车手亨利·托伊沃宁和副驾驶塞尔吉奥·克雷斯托都在事故中
遇难，B组别比赛也就此终止。
